[cf. कर्ण-पुट, कर्ण-रन्ध्र, &c.] —कर्ण-जप, अस्, m. ‘ear-whisperer,’ an in-former. —कर्ण-जलूका, f. an insect, Julus; a small centipede; [cf. कर्ण-कीटा।] —कर्ण-जलौका, f. or कर्ण-जलौकस्, आस्, f. the same. —कर्ण-जाप or कर्ण-जप, अस्, m. whispering in the ear, tale-bearing, calumniating. —कर्ण-जाह, अम्, n. the root of the ear. —कर्ण-जित्, त्, m. ‘the conqueror of Karṇa,’ an epithet of Arjuna; (Karṇa having taken the part of the Kurus, was killed by Arjuna in one of the great battles between them and the Pāṇḍus.) —कर्ण-तस्, ind. away from the ear. —कर्ण-ताल, अस्, m. the flapping of an elephant's ears. —कर्ण-दर्पण, अस्, m. an ear-ring, an ornament for the ear. —कर्ण-दुन्दुभि, इस्, f. a kind of worm (making a noise in the ear like a drum); see कर्ण-कीटा. —कर्ण-देव, अस्, m., N. of a king. —कर्ण-धार, अस्, m. a helmsman, a pilot. —कर्णधार-ता, f. the office of an helms-man. —कर्ण-धारिणी, f. a female elephant. —कर्ण-नाद, अस्, m. ringing in the ear. —कर्ण-नासा, f. the ears and the nose. —कर्णन्दु, उस्, f. a woman's ear-ring; see कर्णान्दु. —कर्ण-प, अस्, m., N. of a man. —कर्ण-पत्त्रक, अस्, m. the tragus, a part of the external ear. —कर्ण-पथ, अस्, m. the compass or range of hearing; कर्णपथम् आ-या or उपे (उप-इ), to come within the range of the ear, to be heard. —कर्ण-पर, अस्, m. an ornament for the ear. —कर्ण-परम्-परा, f. going from one ear to another. —कर्ण-पराक्रम, अस्, m. title of a work. —कर्ण-पर्वन्, अ, n. ‘the Karṇa section,’ title of the eighth book of the Mahā-bhārata. —कर्ण-पाक, अस्, m. inflammation of the outer ear. —कर्ण-पालि, इस्, f. the lobe of the ear; the outer and curving edge of the ear; (ई), f. an ornament of the ear, a garland or string of jewels pendent from it; N. of a river. —कर्ण-पाश, अस्, m. a beautiful ear. —कर्-ण-पुट, अम्, n. the auditory passage of the ear. —कर्ण-पुर्, ऊर्, f. or कर्ण-पुरी, f. the capital of Karṇa, i. e. Campā, the ancient N. of Bhagalpur. —कर्ण-पुष्प, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = मोरट। —कर्ण-पूर, अस्, m. an ornament of flowers worn round the ears; an ear-ring; N. of several plants, blue lotus; Acacia Sirissa; Jonesia Aśoka; N. of the father of Kavicandra, author of the Alaṅkāra Kau-stubha. —कर्ण-पूरक, अस्, m. the Kadamba tree, Nauclea Cadamba; N. of a servant. —कर्ण-पूरण, अम्, n. the act of filling the ears (with cotton &c.); any substance used for that purpose; (अस्), m. = कर्ण-पूर. —कर्ण-प्रतिनाह or कर्ण-प्रतीनाह, अस्, m. a disease of the ear, sup-pression of its excretion or wax, which is supposed to have dissolved and pass by the nose and mouth. —कर्ण-प्रयाग, अस्, m., N. of the confluence of the river Gaṅgā and Pindar. —कर्ण-प्रान्त, अस्, m. the lobe of the ear. —कर्ण-प्रावरण, अस्, आ, अम्, using the ears for a covering; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a fabulous people. —कर्ण-फल, अस्, m. a sort of fish, Ophiocephalus Kurrawey. —कर्ण-भूषण, अम्, n. or कर्ण-भूषा, f. an ear ornament. —कर्ण-मद्गुर, अस्, m. a sort of sheat fish, Silurus Unitus. —कर्ण-मल, अम्, n. the excretion or wax of the ear. —कर्ण-मुकुर, अस्, m. an ear ornament; an ear-ring. —कर्ण-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, headed by Karṇa, having Karṇa as leader. —कर्ण-मूल, अम्, n. the root of the ear. —कर्णमूलीय, अस्, आ, अम्, near the root of the ear. —कर्ण-मोटि, इस्, f. an epithet of Devī or Durgā in one of her forms or incarnations (Cāmuṇḍā). —कर्ण-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having the ear as a source or starting-point, going forth from the ear, an epithet of an arrow, because in shooting the bow-string is drawn back to the ear. —कर्ण-रन्ध्र, अस्, अम्, m. n. the orifice or auditory passage of the ear; [cf. कर्ण-च्छिद्र, कर्ण-पुट, &c.] —कर्ण-रोग, अस्, m. disease of the ear. —कर्णरोग-प्रतिषेध, अस्, m. cure of a disease of the ear. —कर्णरोग-विज्ञान, अम्, n. diagnosis of any disease of the ear. —कर्ण-लता, f. or कर्ण-लतिका, f. the lobe of the ear. —कर्ण-वंश, अस्, m. an elevated plat-form of bamboo. —कर्ण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having ears, long-eared; furnished with tendrils or hooks; having a helm. —कर्ण-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, earless; (अस्), m. a snake. —कर्णविट्क, अस्, आ, अम्, fur-nished with ear-wax. —कर्ण-विद्रधि, इस्, f. ulcer-ation of the ear. —कर्ण-विवर, अम्, n. the audi-tory passage of the ear. —कर्ण-विष्, ट्, f. ear-wax. —कर्ण-वेध, अस्, m. ‘ear-piercing,’ a religious ceremony performed to prevent a person from dying, if the birth of a third son be expected; piercing the ear to receive ear-rings. —कर्ण-वेधनी or कर्ण-वेधनिका, f. an instrument for piercing the ear of an elephant. —कर्ण-वेष्ट, अस्, m. an ear-ring; N. of a prince. —कर्ण-वेष्टक, अस्, m. the flaps of a cap protecting the ear; (अस् or अम्), m. n. (?) an ear-ring. —कर्ण-वेष्टन, अम्, n. an ear-ring. —कर्ण-शष्कुली, f. the outer part of the ear, the exterior cartilaginous portion leading to the auditory passage. —कर्ण-शिरीष, अस्, m. a Śirīṣa flower fastened to the ear as an ornament. —कर्ण-शूल, अस्, अम्, m. n. ear-ache. —कर्णशूलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having ear-ache. —कर्ण-शोभन, अम्, n., Ved. an ear ornament. —कर्ण-श्रव, अस्, आ, अम्, audible, loud. —कर्ण-श्रवस्, आस्, m., N. of a Brāhman. —कर्ण-श्रुत्, त्, m., N. of the author of several hymns of the Ṛg-veda. —कर्ण-संस्राव or कर्-ण-स्रव or कर्ण-स्राव, अस्, m. running of the ear, discharge of pus or ichorous matter from the ear. —कर्ण-सू, ऊस्, m. the father of Karṇa, an epithet of Sūrya or the sun. —कर्ण-सूचि, इस्, m. a kind of insect. —कर्ण-स्फोटा, f. a sort of creeper (com-monly काणफाटा). —कर्ण-कर्णि, ind. from ear to ear, whispering into each other's ears. —कर्-णाञ्जलि (°ण-अञ्°), इस्, m. the auditory passage of the outer ear. —कर्णाढक (°ण-आढ्°), अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of this man. —कर्णादेश (°ण-आद्°), अस्, m. an ear-ring (?). —कर्णानुज (°ण-अन्°), अस्, m. an epithet of Yudhiṣṭhira, the younger brother of Karṇa, one of the five Pāṇḍu princes. —कर्णान्तिक (°ण-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, near or close to the ear. —कर्णान्दु (°ण-अन्°), उस् or ऊ, ऊस्, f. an ornament for the ear; an ear-ring. —कर्णाभरणक (°ण-आभ्°), अस्, m. the tree Cathartocarpus (Cassia) Fistula. —कर्-णारा (°ण and rt. ऋ?), f. an instrument for perfo-rating the ear of an elephant. —कर्णारि (°ण-अरि), इस्, m. an epithet of Arjuṇa (as the enemy of Karṇa); the tree Terminalia Arjuna. —कर्णार्पण (°ण-अर्°), अम्, n. applying the ear, giving ear, paying attention, listening to. —कर्णालङ्कार (°ण-अल्°), अस्, m. or कर्णालङ्क्रिया, f. or कर्णालङ्कृति, इस्, f. an ear ornament, an ear-ring. —कर्णाश्व (°ण-अश्°?), अस्, m., N. of a man. —कर्णास्फाल (°ण-आस्°), अस्, m. the flapping to and fro of an elephant's ears. —कर्णे-चुरुचुरा, f. tale-bearing. —कर्णे-जप, अस्, आ, अम्, a slanderous whisperer, a secret traducer, a tale-bearer, an informer. —कर्णे-टिरि-टिरा, f. tale-bearing. —कर्णेन्दु (°ण-इन्°), उस्, f. a semicircular ornament of the ear, an ear-ring; [cf. कर्णान्दु।] —कर्णोत्पल (°ण-उत्°), अस्, m., N. of a poet. —कर्णोदय (°ण-उद्°), N. of a book. —कर्णोपकर्णिका (°ण-उप्°), f. a female tale-bearer or informer. —कर्णोर्ण (°ण-ऊर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having wool on the ears (as any animal).
कर्णक: कर्णक, अस्, m., Ved. a prominence, handle, or projection on the side or sides (of a vessel &c.); a tendril; applied also to the legs when spread out; N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of this man. —कर्णक-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. furnished with tendrils or side branches.
कर्णकित: कर्णकित, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with tendrils.
कर्णल: कर्णल, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with ears.
कर्णिक: कर्णिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having ears, having large or long ears; having a helm; (अस्), m. a steersman; pl., N. of a people; N. of a king in Potāla; (आ), f. an ear-ring or ornament for the ear; a knot, tubercle; round protuberance (e. g. the round protuberance at the end of a reed or cane); the pericarp of a lotus; a fruit-stalk; the tip of an elephant's trunk; the middle finger; chalk; a pen or small brush; a trowel; the plants Premna Spinosa or Longifolia, and Odina Pinnata; a bawd; N. of an Apsaras; N. of the wife of Kaṅka. —कर्णिकाचल, अस्, m. an epithet of the fabulous mountain Meru; (fr. कर्णिका, the seed vessel of a lotus, and अचल, a mountain, Meru being in the centre of the world, the divisions of which are compared to the leaves of a lotus); also कर्णि-काद्रि, &c.
कर्णिकार: कर्णिकार, अस्, m. the tree Pterospermum Aceri-folium; also Cassia Fistula; the pericarp of a lotus; (अम्), n. the flower of the tree Pterospermum Ace-rifolium and of Cassia Fistula. —कर्णिकार-प्रिय, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva.
कर्णिन्: कर्णिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having ears, relating to the ear; long-eared; (at the end of compounds) having (any-thing) attached to the ear; furnished with flaps or anything similar (said of shoes); barbed, furnished with knots &c. (as an arrow); having a helm; (ई), m. the side of the neck, the part near the ear; a steersman; N. of a mountain, one of the seven prin-cipal ranges of the mountains, dividing the universe; (इनी), f. (scil. योनि) a disease of the uterus, prolapsus or polypus uteri. —कर्णी-रथ, अस्, m. (for कर्णि-रथ), a covered car, or (according to some) a litter for the conveyance of women &c., borne on men's shoulders.
कर्णी: कर्णी, a fem. form related to कर्ण and appear-ing in compounds (e. g. अयस्-कर्णी). —कर्णी-सुत, अस्, m. an epithet of Kaṃsa, the enemy of Kṛṣṇa; according to the scholiast the author of a thieves' manual.
कर्ण्य: कर्ण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in or at the ear; suita-ble to the ear.
कर्णाट: कर्णाट कर्णाट, आस्, m. pl., N. of a country and the people inhabiting it, whence the modern Karnatic; the name, however, was anciently applied to the central districts of the peninsula, including Mysore; (ई), f. a princess of Karṇāṭa; a plant, com-monly Haṃsapadī; one of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of the musical modes, the bride of the Rāga Mālava. —कर्णाट-देश, अस्, m. the Karṇāṭa country.
कर्णाटक: कर्णाटक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a country and the people inhabiting it. —कर्णाटक-देश, अस्, m. the Karṇāṭa country. —कर्णाटक-भाषा, f. the dia-lect of Karṇāṭa.
कर्त्: कर्त् कर्त् (a various reading for कत्र्, कर्त्र्), cl. 10. P. कर्तयति, -यितुम्, to slacken or unloose, to remove.
कर्त: कर्त कर्त, अस्, m. (fr. 1. कृत्?), Ved. a hole, a cavity; (a more recent form is गर्त।)
कर्तन: कर्तन 1. कर्तन, अम्, n. (fr. 1. कृत्), cutting, cutting off or in pieces, excision; (ई), f. scissors.
कर्तन 2. कर्तन, अम्, n. (fr. 2. कृत्), spin-ning cotton or thread.
कर्तरिका: कर्तरिका, f. a knife, a small sword or cutlass; a hunter's knife or sword, a couteau de chasse; scissors.
कर्तरी: कर्तरी, f. a scissors or shears; a knife; a small sword or cutlass; the part of an arrow to which the feathers are attached.
कर्तरीय: कर्तरीय कर्तरीय, a kind of poisonous plant.
कर्तव्य: कर्तव्य कर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fut. pass. part. fr. 1. कृ), to be done, made or accomplished, what ought to be done; to be imposed (as a punishment); to be turned towards (as the mind); to be offered; to be acted; (अम्), n. what ought to be done, obliga-tion, duty, task. —कर्तव्य-ता, f. or कर्तव्य-त्व, अम्, n. necessity, obligation; propriety, fitness; suit-able measures.
कर्त्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut down, to be killed.
कर्तु: कर्तु, the base of several cases, used as infinitives of the verb कृ in the Veda (e. g. कर्तुम्, कर्तवे, कर्तवै, कर्तोस्). —कर्तु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, de-sirous or intending to do.
कर्तृ: कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a doer, a maker, one who makes or does, an agent, one who practises what he knows; one who acts in a religious ceremony, a priest; (very often at the end of compounds, e. g. भय-कर्तृ, राज्य-कर्तृ, &c.); (ता), m. the creator of the world, an epithet of Brahmā, of Viṣṇu, and of Śiva; (in gram.) an agent, one who acts of his own accord (स्व-तन्त्रः), the active noun, the nominative case. —कर्तृ-ता, f. the state of being the agent of an action. —कर्तृ-त्व, अम्, n. agency, the act or property of an agent. —कर्तृ-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —कर्तृ-वाच्य, अस्, m. the active voice. —कर्तृ-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, standing or being within the agent. —कर्तृस्थ-क्रियक, अस्, आ, अम्, any (root &c.) whose action stands within the agent. —कर्तृस्थ-भावक, अस्, आ, अम्, any (root &c.) whose state or भाव stands within the agent.
कर्तृक: कर्तृक, अस्, आ, अम्, an agent, one who does anything. —कर्तृक-त्व, अम्, n. agency, action.
कर्त्र: कर्त्र, अम्, n., Ved. an incantation, charm.
कर्त्व: कर्त्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be done or accom-plished; (अम्), n. obligation, duty; task.
कर्तित: कर्तित कर्तित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. कृत्), cut, cut off.
कर्तिष्यत्: कर्तिष्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, or कर्तिष्य-माण, अस्, आ, अम्, intending or wishing to cut.
कर्त्तव्य: कर्त्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut down, to be killed.
कर्तृका: कर्त्तृका, f. a small sword, a knife; [cf. the next.]
कर्त्तृका: कर्त्तृका, f. a small sword, a knife; [cf. the next.]
कर्त्त्री: कर्त्त्री, f. a pair of scissors.
कर्त्य: कर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut down.
कर्त्र्: कर्त्र् कर्त्र्, cl. 10. P. कर्त्रयति, -यितुम्, to unloose, remove; [cf. कर्त् and कत्र्।]
कर्द्: कर्द् कर्द्, cl. 1. P. कर्दति, -दितुम्, to rum-ble, as the bowels; to caw, as a crow; or to make any similar noise; [cf. पर्द्; Gr. χορδή.]
कर्दन: कर्दन, अम्, n. rumbling of the bowels, bor-borygmi; (ई), f. the day of full moon in the month Caitra.
कर्द: कर्द कर्द, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कर्द्), mud; clay.
कर्दट: कर्दट, अस्, m. mud, dirt; the fibrous root of the lotus (= करहाट); any aquatic weed, as Vallisneria &c.
कर्दम: कर्दम, अस्, m. mud, slime; mire, clay; dirt, filth, sin; a kind of plant; a poisonous kind of bulb; N. of a Nāga; N. of a Prajāpati, born from the shadow of Brahmā, or son of that god by Chāyā, and the husband of Devahūti and father of Kapila; a son of Prajāpati Pulaha; (ई), f., N. of a plant; (अम्), n. flesh; (अस्, आ, अम्), furnished with mud, mire, dirt, filth. —कर्दम-राज, अस्, m. or कर्दम-राजन्, आ, m., N. of a man, a son of Kṣema-gupta. —कर्दमाटक (°म-आट्°), अस्, m. a receptacle for filth, a sewer, &c.; [cf. कन्याट, पत्न्याट।]
कर्दमक: कर्दमक, अस्, m. a kind of granulous fruit; a poisonous kind of bulb; a kind of serpent.
कर्दमित: कर्दमित, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with mud, dirty.
कर्दमिल: कर्दमिल, अम्, n., N. of a region.
कर्पट: कर्पट कर्पट, अस्, अम्, m. n. old or patched or ragged garments; [cf. कार्पटिक and पञ्च-कर्पट।] —कर्पट-धारिन्, ई, m. a religious men-dicant, a beggar in patched or ragged clothes, or some-times with merely a cloth to cover the privities.
कर्पटिक: कर्पटिक, अस्, आ, अम्, or कर्पटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, covered with patched or ragged garments, clothed in beggar's raiment.
कर्पण: कर्पण कर्पण, a kind of lance or spear; [cf. कणप and कर्पर।]
कर्पर: कर्पर कर्पर, अस्, m. a cup, a pot, an iron saucepan or frying-pan (according to some also n. in this sense); the skull, the cranium; a kind of weapon; the plant Ficus Glomerata, [cf. उदुम्-बर]; (ई), f. a collyrium extracted from the Amo-mum Anthorhiza, [cf. घट-कर्पर, खर्पर।]
कर्पराल: कर्पराल, अस्, m. a tree described as a Pīlu grow-ing in the hills; (a various reading for कन्दराल।)
कर्पराश: कर्पराश, अस्, m. sand, gravel, a sandy soil; (a wrong reading for कर्परांश, a potsherd.)
कर्परिका: कर्परिका, f. (diminutive fr. कर्परी) in कर्प-रिकातुत्थ, अम्, n. a collyrium extracted from the Amomum Anthorhiza.
कर्पास: कर्पास कर्पास, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. 1. कृ), cotton, Gossypium Herbaceum; (ई), f. the cotton tree; [cf. कार्पास; cf. also Gr. κάρπασος; Lat. carbasus.]
कर्पूर: कर्पूर 1. कर्पूर, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. rt. कृप्), camphor (the plant and resinous exuda-tion and fruit); (अस्), m., N. of a poet; N. of the father of Gajamalla and uncle of Kalyāṇamalla.
2. कर्पूर, nom. P. कर्पूरति, -रितुम्, to spread like the smell of camphor.
कर्पूरकवि: कर्पूर-कवि, इस्, m., N. of a poet. —कर्पूर-खण्ड, अस्, m. a field of camphor. —कर्पूर-गौर, अम्, n., N. of a lake or pond (yellowish-white like camphor). —कर्पूरगौराख्य (°र-आख्°), अस्, आ, अम्, called Karpūragaura. —कर्पूर-तिलक, अस्, m., N. of an elephant; (आ), f. an epithet of Jayā, one of Durgā's female attendants or confi-dantes. —कर्पूर-तैल, अम्, n. camphor liniment. —कर्पूर-नालिका, f. a kind of food prepared with camphor, rice dressed with spices and camphor and ghee. —कर्पूर-प्रकरण, अम्, n. a Jaina work by Hari. —कर्पूर-मञ्जरी, f. title of a dramatic work by Rāja-śekhara. —कर्पूर-मणि, इस्, m. a white mineral used medicinally. —कर्पूर-सरस्, अस्, n., N. of a lake or pond.
कर्पूरक: कर्पूरक, अस्, m. zedoary, Curcuma Zerumbet.
कर्फर: कर्फर कर्फर, अस्, m. a mirror; [cf. कर्-कर।]
कर्ब्: कर्ब् कर्ब्, cl. 1. P. कर्बति, -बितुम्, to go, move, approach.
कर्बु: कर्बु कर्बु, उस्, उस्, उ (said to be fr. rt. कव्, to paint, colour), variegated, spotted. —कर्बु-दार, अस्, m. the tree Bauhinia Candida or Barleria Cærulea. —कर्बु-दारक, अस्, m. the tree Cordia Latifolia.
कर्बुक: कर्बुक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
कर्बुर: कर्बुर and कर्वुर, अस्, आ, अम्, variegated, of a spotted or variegated colour; white; (अस्), m. a variegated colour; sin; a Rakṣas; the plant Cur-cuma Amhaldi or Zerumbet; rice growing amidst inundation; (आ), f. the plant Bignonia Suaveolens; another plant, commonly called Varvarā; (ई), f. an epithet of the goddess Durgā; (अम्), n. gold; the plant Datura, and the fruit of it; water. —कर्बुर-फल, अस्, m. a plant, commonly called Sākuruṇḍa.
कर्बूर: कर्बूर or कर्वूर, अस्, m. a Rakṣas; the plant Curcuma Amhaldi or Zerumbet; (आ), f. a leech; (अम्), n. gold; a yellow orpiment.
कर्बूरक: कर्बूरक, अस्, m. the plant Curcuma Amhaldi or Zerumbet.
कर्बूरित: कर्बूरित, अस्, आ, अम्, variegated, many-coloured.
कर्बेल: कर्बेल कर्बेल, अस्, m. an epithet of the copyist Viṣṇu-bhaṭṭa.
कर्मन्: कर्मन् कर्मन्, अ, n. (fr. rt. 1. कृ; according to some also m.), action, work, deed; performance, business; office; specific action, moral duty, the obligation imposed by peculiarities of tribe, occupa-tion, &c.; labour (as opposed to rest, प्रशान्ति); any religious action or rite (as sacrifice, ablution, &c., especially as originating in the hope of future re-compense and as opposed to speculative religion or knowledge of spirit); action consisting in motion as the third among the seven categories of the Nyāya philosophy, (of these motions there are five, viz. उत्-क्षेपण, throwing upwards; अव-क्षेपण, throwing downwards; आ-कुञ्चन, contraction; प्र-सारण, extension or dilatation; and गमन, going or motion in general); product, result, effect; organ of sense [cf. कर्मेन्द्रिय]; natural or active pro-perty (as maturity, of heat; support, of earth; disper-sion, of wind, &c.); the immediate object of an agent or act; (in grammar) the idea or notion expressed by the acc. case, (this object is of four kinds, viz. a. निर्वर्त्य, when anything new is produced, e. g. कटं करोति, ‘he makes a mat;’ पुत्रम् प्रसूते, ‘she bears a son:’ b. विकार्य, when change is implied either of the substance and form, e. g. काष्ठम् भस्म करोति, ‘he makes ashes out of fuel;’ or of the form only, e. g. सुवर्णं कुण्डलं क-रोति, ‘he fashions gold into an ear-ring:’ c. प्राप्य, when any desired object is attained, e. g. ग्रामं गच्छति, ‘he goes to the village;’ चन्द्रम् पश्यति, ‘he sees the moon:’ d. अनीप्सित, when an undesired object is abandoned, e. g. पापं त्यजति, ‘he leaves the wicked’); fate, the certain consequence of previous acts [cf. कर्म-पाक and कर्म-विपाक]; (in as-tronomy) the tenth lunar mansion. —कर्म-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, working for other people, a hired labourer, a servant of any kind (as a pupil &c.) who is not a slave, an agent, any one who does work or business; (अस्), m. an epithet of Yama, the regent of the dead; (ई), f. the plant Sanseviera Zeylonica; the plant Momor-dica Monadelpha. —कर्म-कर्तृ, ता, m. ‘an object-agent’ or ‘object-containing agent,’ i. e. an agent which is at the same time the object of an act on (this is the idea expressed by the reflexive passive, as in ओदनः पच्यते, ‘the mashed grain cooks of itself,’ see Gram. 461. c); कर्म-कर्तारौ, m. du. the work and the person accomplishing it. —कर्म-काण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. that department of the Veda which relates to ceremonial acts and sacrificial rites; N. of a Jaina work. —कर्म-कार, अस्, ई, अम्, a worker, one who does any business, an artisan, a mechanic; one who performs any act (without receiving wages for it, according to native lexicographers); (अस्), m. a bull; a blacksmith (forming a mixed caste re-garded as the progeny of the divine artist Viśva-karman and a Śūdrā woman); (ई), f. the plants Sanseviera Zeylonica and Momordica Monadelpha. —कर्म-कारक, अस्, आ, अम्, one who does any act or work. —कर्मकारापय, nom. (fr. कर्म-कार) A. कर्मकारापयते, -यितुम्, to cause any one to work as a servant. —कर्म-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, working, doing any work or act, (in compounds preceded by an adjective or pronoun, e. g. शुभ-कर्म-कारिन्, doing good works; तत्-कर्म-का-रिन्, performing the same business.) —कर्म-कार्-मुक, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. ‘the bow of action,’ i. e. an efficacious or strong bow. —कर्म-कीलक, अस्, m. a washerman. —कर्म-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, performing any work, skilful in work (e. g. तीक्ष्ण-कर्म-कृत्, working with zeal); a workman, an artisan; a servant; one who has done any work. —कर्म-कृतवत्, आन्, m. the director of a religious rite, the reciter of Mantras or formularies. —कर्म-कृत्य, अम्, n., Ved. activity, the state of active exertion. —कर्म-क्षम, अस्, आ, अम्, competent to per-form an act, able to do it. —कर्म-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. the district or region of religious acts; [cf. कर्म-भूमि।] —कर्म-ग्रन्थि-प्रथम-विचार, title of a Jaina work. —कर्म-घात, अस्, m. lit. ‘the killing of work,’ i. e. the act of leaving off work. —कर्म-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a prince of Mā-lava. —कर्म-चित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. collected or accom-plished by work. —कर्म-चेष्टा, f. active exertion, action. —कर्म-चोदना, f. the motive impelling to ritual acts. —कर्म-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, resulting from or produced by any act whether religious or immoral; (अस्), m. the holy fig tree, Ficus Religiosa; the Kali-yuga or fourth and present age of the world, the age of iniquity. —कर्मज-गुण, अस्, m. a property resulting from human acts (as separation, reunion, &c.). —कर्म-जित्, त्, m., N. of a prince. —कर्म-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in any work; acquainted with religious rites. —कर्मणि-वाच्य, अस्, m. the passive voice in grammar, (but according to Pāṇini the passive is an Ātmane-pada verb with the affix यक् in four tenses, and कर्मन् expresses only one idea of the passive.) —कर्म-त्याग, अस्, m. abandonment of worldly duties or ceremonial rites. —कर्म-त्व, अम्, n. or कर्म-ता, f. state of action, any act, the active discharge of the duties and functions of life. —कर्म-दुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, corrupt in action, wicked in practice, immoral, dis-reputable. —कर्म-देव, अस्, m., Ved. a god by actions (opposed to आजान-देव, a god by birth). —कर्म-दोष, अस्, m. a sinful work, sin, vice; error, blunder; the evil consequence of human acts, discreditable conduct or business. —कर्म-धारय, अस्, m., N. of a class of compounds (see Gram. 755); according to native grammarians a subdivision of the Tat-puruṣa class, the members of which are in the same relationship either as adjective and substan-tive or as two substantives in apposition (e. g. श्वे-ताश्व, ‘a white horse;’ Pāṇini I. 2, 42, calls a Karma-dhāraya comp. a Samānādhikaraṇa-tatpu-rusha; cf. अधि-करण). —कर्म-ध्वंस, अस्, m. loss of benefit arising from religious acts, destruc-tion of any work, disappointment. —कर्म-नामन्, अ, n. a participle. —कर्म-नाशा, f., N. of a river between Kāśī and Vihāra, contact with which destroys the merit of works. —कर्म-निबन्ध, अस्, m. necessary consequence of works. —कर्म-निर्हार, अस्, m. removal of (bad) deeds or their effects. —कर्म-निष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. diligent in religious actions, engaged in active duties; (अस्), m. a Brāhman who performs sacrifices &c. —कर्म-पथ, अस्, m. the way or direction of an action. —कर्म-पद्धति, इस्, f. title of a work. —कर्-म-पाक, अस्, m. the ripening of actions, i. e. re-compense for actions done in a former life; [cf. कर्म-विपाक।] —कर्म-प्रदीप, अस्, m. title of a work of Kātyāyana; N. of a work of Miśra. —कर्मप्रदीप-विवृति, N. of Śivarāma's com-mentary on the Karmapradīpa. —कर्म-प्रदीपिका, f. title of a work of Kāma-deva. —कर्म-प्रव-चनीय, employed for the definition of an action; (अस्), m. (scil. शब्दस्) a term for certain preposi-tions, particles, or adverbs, not connected with a verb, but with a case of a noun; (according to Pāṇini the first and general category to which prepositions belong is that of Nipātas or particles; they are Upasargas and Gatis when they are in connection with verbal action, i. e. with the tenses of a verb; but the term गति is more comprehensive than उपसर्ग, and is applicable also when the verbal root becomes de-veloped into a noun substantive, adjective, or parti-ciple. Moreover, the term उपसर्ग is confined to the prepositions with सु and दुस्, whereas the Gatis include many other adverbial prefixes such as अलम् and the nouns and adjectives which take the affix च्वि &c. Lastly, prepositions are Karmapravacanīyas if they are unconnected with verbs and govern a noun either separated from it or forming a compound with it. A Karmapravacanīya never loses its accent, and exercises no euphonic influence on the initial letters of a fol-lowing verb.) —कर्म-प्रवाद, अस्, m., N. of the eighth of the fourteen Pūrvas or oldest religious writings of the Jainas. —कर्म-फल, अम्, n. the fruit or recompense of actions; pain, pleasure, &c., considered as the consequence of acts; the fruit of the tree Averrhoa Carambola; [cf. कर्मरङ्ग।] —कर्मफलोदय (°ल-उद्°), अस्, m. the occur-rence of consequences. —कर्म-बन्ध, अस्, m. the tie of works (by which the soul is attached to pleasure &c.). —कर्म-बन्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, bound by acts; (अम्), n. confinement to repeated existence, as the consequence of acts. —कर्म-भू, ऊस्, f. tilled or cultivated ground. —कर्म-भूमि, इस्, f. the land or region of religious actions, i. e. where such actions are performed; (according to Hemacandra the Karmabhūmis are Bharata, Airāvata, and Videha, but not the district of the Kurus; the other Varṣas are फल-भूमयस्, i. e. lands of recompense; cf. कर्म-क्षेत्र।) —कर्म-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, con-sisting of works, resulting from works. —कर्म-मार्ग, अस्, m. the way of work; a technical term used by thieves for the breaking of walls &c. —कर्-म-मीमांसा, see s. v. मीमांसा. —कर्म-मूल, अम्, n. Kuśa or sacrificial grass, used as an essential part in many religious and sacred rites. —कर्म-युग, अम्, n. the fourth and present age of the world, the iron age, the Kali-yuga. —कर्म-योग, अस्, m. performance of a work or business or of worldly functions and religious duties; active exer-tion, industry; connection with a sacrifice. —कर्म-योनि, इस्, m. f. source of action. —कर्मर्घ, अस्, m. (fr. कर्मन् and ऋघ in ऋघाय), N. of a teacher. —कर्म-वचन, अम्, n. (with Buddhists) the ritual. —कर्म-वज्र, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘whose thunderbolt is work;’ an epithet of the Śūdra. —कर्म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, busy with a work, em-ployed in it. —कर्म-वश, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the power of or subject to former actions; (अस्), m. the necessary influence of acts; fate, considered as the inevitable consequence of actions done in a former life. —कर्मवशि-ता, f. the condition of having power over works, a quality of a Bodhi-sattva. —कर्म-वशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having power over works. —कर्म-वाटी, f. a lunar day or the thirtieth division of a lunar month (regulating all ceremonies, observances, religious actions, &c.). —कर्म-विघ्न, अस्, m. an impediment to work, obstruction. —कर्-म-विधि, इस्, m. rule of action, observance, practice, mode of conducting any ceremony. —कर्म-वि-पर्यय, अस्, m. succession of office or employment, revolving or alternating duty; contrariety or reverse of any act or business. —कर्म-विपाक, अस्, m. ‘the ripening of actions,’ i. e. the good or evil consequences in this life of human acts performed in previous births; title of a work on this subject, explaining ex-piatory rites to be performed in cases of disease &c., supposed to be the punishment of offences committed in a previous existence (written in Ślokas in the form of a dialogue between Śakuntalā-Bharata and Śātā-tapa-Bhṛgu), a work of Viśveśvara-bhaṭṭa. —कर्म-विपाक-सङ्ग्रह, title of a book. —कर्मविपाक-सार, title of a book composed by Dinakara, the brother of Kamalākara-bhaṭṭa. —कर्म-विशेष, अस्, m. variety of act or actions. —कर्म-वीज, अम्, n. the seed of works. —कर्म-शाला, f. a workshop, a house of business. —कर्म-शाली, f., N. of a river in Caturgrāma. —कर्म-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, assiduous, laborious, one who perseveres in his duties without looking to their reward. —कर्म-शुद्ध (?), अम्, n. approved occupation. —कर्म-शूर, अस्, आ, अम्, assiduous, laborious; (अस्), m. a skilful or clever work-man. —कर्म-शौच, अम्, n. humility. —कर्म-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, m., N. of a son of Pulaha by Gati. —कर्म-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. assemblage of acts, com-prising the act, its performance and the performer. —कर्म-सचिव, अस्, m. a minister, any officer employed upon active duties, as a judge, a deputy, &c. —कर्म-सन्न्यासिक, अस्, m. an ascetic, a religious person who has withdrawn from works. —कर्म-समाधि, इस्, m. devotion, abstraction (?) . —कर्म-सम्भव, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by or resulting from acts. —कर्म-साक्षिन्, ई, m. ‘the witness of all acts,’ epithet of the sun. —कर्म-साधक, अस्, इका, अम्, accomplishing a work. —कर्म-साधन, अम्, n. implement, means; articles essential to the perform-ance of any religious act. —कर्म-सिद्धि, इस्, f. accomplishment of an act, success. —कर्म-सेन, अस्, m., N. of the father of Rāma-candra. —कर्म-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, standing or being within the object. —कर्मस्थ-क्रियक, अस्, आ, अम्, any (root) whose action stands within the object. —कर्मस्थ-भावक, अस्, आ, अम्, any (root &c.) whose state (भाव) stands within the object. —कर्म-स्थान, अम्, n. a public office or place of business. —कर्म-हेतु, उस्, उस्, उ, caused by acts, arising from acts. —कर्माक्षम (°म-अक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, incapable of business. —कर्माङ्ग (°म-अङ्°), अस्, m. part of any act, part of a sacrificial rite. —कर्मात्मन् (°म-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, one whose character is action, endowed with principles of action, active, acting. —कर्मादित्य (°म-आद्°), अस्, m., N. of a king. —कर्माधिकार (°म-अध्°), अस्, m. the right of action (in the Mīmāṃsa philosophy). —कर्मानु-बन्ध (°म-अन्°), अस्, m. connection with or de-pendance upon acts. —कर्मानुबन्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, connected with or involved in works. —कर्मानु-रूप (°म-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, according to action, according to function or duty. —कर्मानुरूपतस्, ind. conformably to act, function &c. —कर्मानु-ष्ठान (°म-अन्°), अम्, n. practising one's duties, discharging peculiar functions. —कर्मानुष्ठायिन् (°म-अन्°), ई, इनी, इ, practising duties, performing rites &c. —कर्मानुसार (°म-अन्°), अस्, m. conse-quence of or conformity to acts. —कर्मानुसारतस्, ind. according to one's deeds. —कर्मान्त (°म-अन्°), अस्, m. work, business, administration of an office; management of any business; the end of any task or act; the end or abandonment of ritual acts; tilled or cultivated ground. —कर्मान्तर (°म-अन्°), अम्, n. interval between religious actions, suspense of such an action; difference or contrariety of action; penance, expiation. —कर्मान्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, final, completing; (अस्), m. a workman, a servant, one who finishes a work. —कर्माभिधायक, अस्, आ, अम्, or कर्माभिधायिन् (°म-अभ्°), ई, इनी, इ, enjoining or prescribing duties or acts. —कर्मा-रम्भ (°म-आर्°), अस्, m. commencement of any act. —कर्मार्ह (°म-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, fit for work, able to do any work, suitable to any rite; (अस्), m. a man. —कर्मेन्द्रिय (°म-इन्°), अम्, n. an organ of action (opposed to the बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि or perceptive organs of sense; five are reckoned, viz. the hand, the foot, the larynx or organ of the voice, the organ of generation and of excretion). —कर्मो-दार (°म-उद्°), अम्, n. any honourable or valiant act, magnanimity, prowess. —कर्मोद्युक्त (°म-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, actively labouring, busily engaged. —कर्मोद्योग (°म-उद्°), अस्, m. engaging actively in any work.
कर्म: कर्म, अस्, अम्, m. n. according to some lexico-graphers = कर्मन्।
कर्मक: कर्मक (at the end of some compounds) = कर्-मन्, q. v.
कर्मठ: कर्मठ, अस्, आ, अम्, skilful or clever in work, clever; working diligently, accomplishing any rite, anxious to perform anything; (अस्), m. the director and performer of a sacrifice.
कर्मण्य: कर्मण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. skilful in work, clever, diligent; proper or fit for any act, suitable to it; (at the end of compounds) relating to any business or to the accomplishment of anything; (आ), f. wages, hire; (अम्), n. energy, activity. —कर्मण्य-ता, f. skil-fulness, cleverness. —कर्मण्य-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, re-ceiving wages, working for hire; (a various reading for भरण्य-भुज्।)
कर्मार: कर्मार, अस्, m., Ved. an artificer, a mechanic, a blacksmith, a brazier, a carpenter, &c.; a bamboo; the plant Averrhoa Carambola, = कर्मरङ्ग below. —कर्मार-वन, अम्, n., N. of a place.
कर्मारक: कर्मारक, अस्, m. the plant Averrhoa Carambola.
कर्मिक: कर्मिक, अस्, आ, अम्, acting, active.
कर्मिन्: कर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, acting, active, busy; performing a religious action; engaged in any work or business; belonging or relating to any act.
कर्मिष्ठ: कर्मिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be a superlative of the last), very active, assiduous, diligent.
कर्मीण: कर्मीण = कर्मन् at the end of a compound; [cf. अलङ्कर्मीण।]
कर्मन्द: कर्मन्द कर्मन्द, अस्, m., N. of a man, author of a Bhikṣu-sūtra.
कर्मन्दिन्: कर्मन्दिन्, ई, m. a beggar, a religious mendi-cant, a member of the fourth order (lit. ‘a follower of Karmanda’).
कर्मर: कर्मर कर्मर and कर्मरक, अस्, m. the plant Averrhoa Carambola.
कर्मरङ्ग: कर्मरङ्ग, अस्, m., N. of the same plant; (अम्), n. the acid fruit of this plant.
कर्मरी: कर्मरी कर्मरी, f. the manna of the bam-boo; [cf. वंश-रोचना।]
कर्मस: कर्मस कर्मस, अस्, m., N. of a son of Pulaha and Kṣamā; [cf. कर्म-श्रेष्ठ।]
कर्मीर: कर्मीर कर्मीर, अस्, आ, अम्, variegated; (a various reading for किर्मीर।)
कर्मीरक: कर्मीरक, अस्, m. a small tree, Trophis Aspera.
कर्व्: कर्व् कर्व्, cl. 1. P. कर्वति, -वितुम्, to be proud, to boast; [cf. खर्व् and गर्व्।]
कर्व: कर्व कर्व, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. कॄ), love, desire; a rat.
कर्वट: कर्वट कर्वट, अस्, अम्, m. n. declivity of a mountain; a village, market-town, the capital of a district (of two or four hundred villages) in a pleasant site and of handsome construction; (अस्), m., N. of a country or a people; (ई), f., N. of a river; (अम्), n. a city.
कर्वटक: कर्वटक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?) declivity of a mountain.
कर्वर: कर्वर 1. कर्वर, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. कृ), Ved. a deed, action.

कर्वर 2. कर्वर or कर्बर, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. 1. कॄ), variegated, spotted; (अस्), m. sin; a tiger; a Rakṣas; a sort of medicament; (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā; night; a Rākṣasī; a tigress; the leaf of the plant Asa Fœtida; [cf. करवी, कवरी, कारवी।] See कर्बुर।
कर्शन: कर्शन कर्शन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. कृश्), ren-dering lean, attenuating, causing emaciation; (अस्), m. fire; [cf. कृशानु।]
कर्शफ: कर्शफ कर्शफ, अस्, m., Ved. an epithet of imps or goblins.
कर्श्य: कर्श्य कर्श्य, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = कर्-चूर; [cf. कार्श्य and कार्ष्य।]
कर्ष: कर्ष कर्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कृष्), drawing, dragging, pulling; attracting; ploughing; a furrow, a trench; a scratch; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a weight of gold or silver, equal to 16 Māṣas = (1/4) Pala = (1/400) of a Tulā = 11, 375 French grains; according to the ancient division of 5 Rettis to the Māṣa the Karṣa would be equal to about 176 grains troy; in common use 8 Rettis are given to the Māṣa, and the Karṣa is then about 280 grains troy. —कर्ष-फल, अस्, m. the tree Terminalia Bellerica; this tree is also called Akṣa, because its fruits are used as dice; (आ), f. the plant Emblica Officinalis. —कर्षार्ध (°ष-अर्°), अम्, n. a Tolaka, a weight of 16 Māṣas (according to some calculations).
कर्ष, कर्षण, &c. See s. v. at p. 210.
कर्षक: कर्षक, अस्, आ, अम्, a cultivator of the soil, one who ploughs or lives by tillage; a husbandman; who or what draws or drags, attractive, what attracts.
कर्षण: कर्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, pulling to and fro, drag-ging, attracting, overpowering, injuring; tormenting; harassed; extending (in time); (अम्), n. the act of dragging or pulling; drawing to and fro; removing, hurting, injuring; bending (a bow); ploughing, cul-tivating the ground; cultivated land.
कर्षणि: कर्षणि, इस्, f. an unchaste woman (attracting the men).
कर्षणी: कर्षणी, f., N. of a plant; [cf. कर्षिणी and क्षीरिणी।]
कर्षणीय: कर्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be drawn or pulled; to be attracted; to be conciliated or won.
कर्षयत्: कर्षयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dragging, pulling; at-tracting; harassing, annoying.
कर्षित: कर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn, attracted; distracted, tormented, harassed; worn out; ploughed.
कर्षिन्: कर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, who or what pulls or draws or attracts; attractive; inviting; who or what ploughs or furrows, a ploughman, peasant; (इणी), f. the bit of a bridle; a medicinal moon-plant; [cf. कर्षणी, क्षीरिणी।]
कर्षू: कर्षू, ऊस्, f. a furrow, trench, incision; a river; a canal; a shallow trench for receiving the sacrificial fire; (ऊस्), m. a fire of dried cow-dung; agriculture, cultivation; livelihood.
कर्हि: कर्हि कर्हि, ind. (fr. 2. क), Ved. when? at what time? (followed by the future or present tense) कर्हि-चिद् or कर्ह्य्-अपि, at any time; [cf. Goth. hvar, ‘where?’ Eng. where? Germ. war and wor in warum, woraus, &c.; Lith. kur.]
कल्: कल् 1. कल्, cl. 1. A. कलते, -लितुम्, to sound; to count; [Gr. καλέω ? Lat. calculo.]
कल् 2. कल्, cl. 10. P. कालयति, -यितुम्, to push on, drive forward, drive away; carry off; to drive together, collect; to throw; to announce the time.

कल् 3. कल्, cl. 10. P. कलयति, -यितुम्, to impel, incite, urge on; to bear, carry; to do, make, accomplish; to tie on, attach, affix; to utter a sound, murmur; to furnish with; to observe, perceive, take notice of; to regard, consider, count, reckon, calculate; to go; to take hold of the die called Kali (in this last sense कल् may be considered as a nom. fr. कलि).
कल: कल, अस्, आ, अम्, dumb, hoarse, indistinct, inarticu-late (especially in composition with वाष्प and अश्रु, e. g. वाष्प-कल, अश्रु-कल, having the speech impeded by tears, sobbing); emitting a low or soft tone, as humming, buzzing, &c.; weak; crude, undigested; (अस्), m. (scil. स्वर) a low or soft and inarticulate tone, as humming, buzzing, &c.; the tree Shorea Robusta; (in poetry) time equal to four Mātras or instants; (आस्), m. pl. a class of manes or deceased ancestors; (अम्), n. semen virile; the ju-jube, Zizyphus Jujuba; (for कला see below, s. v.) —कल-कण्ठ, अस्, m. a pleasing tone or note; a low murmuring tone; having a sweet voice, N. of several birds, as of the Indian cuckoo; a dove, a pigeon; a goose. —कल-कल, अस्, m. a confused noise, the murmuring or buz of a crowd; resin, pitch, the resinous exudation of the tree Shorea Robusta; an epithet of Śiva; [cf. कटकट, कटङ्-कट।] —कलकल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, causing hum-ming or murmuring. —कल-कीट, अस्, m., N. of a Grāma. —कल-कूजिका, f. a wanton, a lascivious woman. —कल-कूट, अस्, m., N. of a warrior-tribe and the country inhabited by it. —कल-कूणिका, f. a wanton, a lascivious woman. —कल-घोष, अस्, m. the Kokila or Indian cuckoo. —कलङ्-कष, अस्, m. a lion; a musical instrument; see कर-ताली। —कलङ्-कुर, अस्, m. an eddy, a whirlpool. —कल-ता, f. or कल-त्व, अम्, n. melody, music. —कल-तूलिका, f. a wanton or lascivious woman; [cf. कल-कूणिका।] —कल-धूत, अम्, n. silver; (wrong read-ing for कल-धौत?). —कल-धौत, अम्, n. gold and silver (sounding and shining); (अस्, अम्), m. n. a low or pleasing tone. —कलधौत-लिपि, इस्, f. a streak of gold, illumination of a manuscript with gold. —कल-ध्वनि, इस्, m. a low sweet tone; the Ko-kila or Indian cuckoo; the turtle-dove; a peacock. —कल-नाद, अस्, m. a sort of goose; see कल-हंस. —कल-भाषण, अम्, n. the prattle of childhood. —कल-भैरव, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a deep ravine in the mountains between the rivers Tāpī and Narmadā. —कल-रव, अस्, m. a low sweet tone; a dove; the Indian cuckoo; [cf. Lat. columba.] —कल-वचस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, speaking sweetly, singing. —कल-स्वन, अस्, आ, अम्, having a charming voice (a bird). —कल-स्वर, अम्, n. a low musical sound. —कल-हंस, अस्, m. a kind of duck or goose; a gander; another bird, Gallinula Porphyria; a drake or (according to some) a teal; an excellent king; Brahma or the supreme spirit; N. of a metre consisting of four lines of thirteen sylla-bles each. —कलानुनादिन् (°ल-अन्°), ई, m. a sparrow; a bee, but particularly one of a very large kind; the Cātaka bird. —कलालाप (°ल-आल्°), अस्, m. a sweet humming sound, discourse; a bee. —कलोत्ताल (°ल-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, high, sharp.
कलन: कलन, अस्, आ, अम् (at the end of compounds), causing, effecting; (अस्), m. a sort of cane; (आ), f. doing, making, effecting; subjection, submission; emitting (?); काल-कलना, fulfilling one's time, dying; (अम्), n. an embryo at the first stage after conception; a spot, a stain; an offence, fault, defect; murmuring, sounding.
कलित: कलित, अस्, आ, अम्, impelled, driven, borne on-wards; held, laid hold of; attached, affixed, furnished, endowed with; gained, acquired; considered, known, understood; numbered, counted, reckoned; separated, divided; sounded indistinctly, buzzed, murmured.
कलक: कलक कलक, अस्, m. a kind of fish; a kind of prose.
कलङ्क: कलङ्क कलङ्क, अस्, m. a spot, a mark; the rust of iron; a fault, defamation, abuse. —कलङ्क-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, censorious, calumniating, defaming; spotting, staining. —कलङ्क-कला, f. a digit of the moon in shadow. —कलङ्क-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, spot-ted, stained; calumniated, defamed. —कलङ्क-हृत्, त्, m. an epithet of Śiva.
कलङ्कय: कलङ्कय, nom. P. कलङ्कयति, -यितुम्, to spot, defame.
कलङ्कित: कलङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, spotted, soiled, stained; calumniated, defamed.
कलङ्किन्: कलङ्किन्, ई, इनी, इ, soiled, stained; disgraced, reviled, rusty.
कलञ्ज: कलञ्ज कलञ्ज, अस्, m. an animal struck with a poisoned weapon; tobacco.
कलट: कलट कलट, अम्, n. the thatch of a house; (other works read this कुटल, q. v.)
कलत: कलत कलत, अस्, आ, अम्, = खलति, bald-headed.
कलत्र: कलत्र कलत्र, अम्, n. (see कडत्र), a wife; any female; the hip and loins; pudendum muliebre; a royal citadel, a strong hold or fastness; the seventh lunar mansion in astronomy. —क-लत्र-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, or कलत्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having a wife, united to a wife.
कलन्तक: कलन्तक कलन्तक or कलन्दक, अस्, m. a species of bird.
कलन्दन: कलन्दन कलन्दन, अस्, m., N. of a man.
कलन्दर: कलन्दर कलन्दर, अस्, m. a man of a mixed caste, the son of a Leṭa (?) man and a Tīvara woman.
कलन्दिका: कलन्दिका कलन्दिका, f. knowledge, intel-ligence, wisdom in general; (a various reading for कलिन्दिका, q. v.)
कलन्धु: कलन्धु कलन्धु, उस्, m. a kind of vegetable; [cf. घोली।]
कलभ: कलभ कलभ, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 3. कल्), a young elephant; an elephant thirty years old; a young camel (perhaps also the young of other animals); the tree Datura Fastuosa [cf. धुस्तूर]; (ई), f. a sort of Ricinus (चञ्चु). —कलभ-वल्लभ, अस्, m., N. of a tree; [cf. पीलु।]
कलम: कलम कलम, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 3. कल्), rice, which is sown in May and June, and ripens in December or January; a white rice growing in deep water; a pen, a reed for writing with; a thief, a rogue; [cf. Gr. κάλαμος Lat. calamus, culmus; and Arab. قلم]
कलम्ब: कलम्ब कलम्ब, अस्, m. the stalk of a pot-herb; an arrow; the tree Nauclea Cadamba; (ई), f. (according to a scholiast also m.), the pot-herb Convol-vulus Repens; (अम्), n. Calumba root, Menispermum Calumba; [cf. कडम्ब, कदम्ब।]
कलम्बक: कलम्बक, अस्, m., N. of a plant; [cf. धारा-कदम्ब।]
कलम्बिका: कलम्बिका, f. the nape of the neck (in this sense usually used in du.); the pot-herb Convolvulus Repens; [cf. कलम्बी।]
कलम्बू: कलम्बू, ऊस्, f. the same pot-herb.
कलम्बुट: कलम्बुट कलम्बुट, अम्, n. fresh butter.
कलल: कलल कलल, अस्, अम्, m. n. the womb, the uterus; a small round lump, a term for the embryo a short time after conception; [cf. कलन।]
कललज: कललज कललज, अस्, m. the resinous ex-udation of the Shorea Robusta; [cf. कल-कल।] —कललजोद्भव (°ज-उद्°), अस्, m. the tree Shorea Robusta.
कलविङ्क: कलविङ्क कलविङ्क, अस्, m. a sparrow; a spot, a stain [cf. कलङ्क]; a white Cāmara; the plant Echites Antidysenterica [cf. कलिङ्गक]; N. of a Tīrtha.
कलश: कलश कलश, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. a water-pot, a pitcher, a jar, a dish; (अस्), m., N. of a poet; (ई), f. the plant Hemionitis Cordifolia; N. of a Tīrtha; a churn; [cf. कलस and द्रोण-कलश; Gr. κάλιξ Lat. calix.] —कलश-दिर्, ईर्, m., Ved. one whose pot or pitcher is broken. —कलश-पोतक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga. —कलशी-कण्ठ, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of this man. —कलशी-पदी, f. having feet like a water-jar. —कलशी-मुख, अस्, m. a sort of musical instru-ment. —कलशी-सुत, अस्, m. an epithet of Agastya. —कलशोदर (°श-उद्°), अस्, m., N. of a Daitya.
कलशि: कलशि, इस्, f. a water-pot, pitcher, dish, water-jar; the plant Hemionitis Cordifolia.
कलस: कलस, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. a pot, a water-jar; (अस्), m. a Droṇa measure; a rounded pinnacle or ball on the top of a temple; (ई), f. the plant Hemionitis Cordifolia. —कलसोदधि (°स-उद्°), इस्, m. the ocean.
कलह: कलह कलह, अस्, अम्, m. n. strife, conten-tion, quarrel, war, battle; the sheath of a sword, a scabbard; a road, a way; deceit, falsehood; violence without murderous weapons, abuse, beating, kicking, &c. —कलह-कन्दल, अस्, m., N. of an actor. —कलह-कार, अस्, ई, अम्, quarrelsome, turbulent; contentious, pugnacious; (ई), f., N. of the wife of Vikramacaṇḍa. —कलह-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, quarrel-some, contentious. —कलह-नाशन, अस्, m. the tree Cæsalpina Bonducella. —कलह-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of contention, quarrelsome, turbulent; (अस्), m. an epithet of Nārada; (आ), f. the bird Gracula Religiosa. —कलहान्तरिता (°ह-अन्°), f. a heroine separated from her lover in consequence of a quarrel; an appeased wife, one who has been angry and is sorry for it. —कलहापहृत (°ह-अप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, taken away by force.
कलहाय: कलहाय, nom. A. कलहायते, -यितुम्, to quarrel, contend.
कलहिन्: कलहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, contentious, quarrelsome.
कलहु: कलहु कलहु, a particular high number; [cf. करफु।]
कला: कला कला, f. (said to be fr. 3. कल्), a small part of anything, any single part or portion of a whole, but especially a sixteenth part; a digit or one sixteenth of the moon's diameter (personified as a daughter of Kardama and wife of Marīci); interest on capital, considered as a certain part of it; a division of time (according to some (1/900) of a day, i. e. 1 minute and 36 seconds; according to others (1/1800) of a day, i. e. 48 seconds; according to others 20(1/10) Kalās = 1 Muhūrta or (1/30) of a day, therefore 1 Kalā = 2 minutes and 26(54/201) seconds; according to others 30(1/10) Kalās = 1 Muhūrta, therefore 1 Kalā = 1 minute and 35(205/301) seconds; according to others 1 Kalā = 8 seconds); the sixtieth part of one thirtieth of a zodiacal sign, a minute of a degree; (in prosody) a syllabic instant; a term for the seven substrata of the elements or Dhātus of the human body (which according to one reckoning are seven, as follows, flesh, blood, fat, phlegm, urine, bile, and semen; but according to Hemacandra रस ‘chyle,’ अस्थि ‘bone,’ and मज्ज ‘marrow,’ take the place of phlegm, urine, and bile); an atom (there are 3015 Kalās or atoms in every one of the six Dhātus, not counting the रस, therefore in all 18090); a small round lump, a term for the embryo shortly after conception [cf. कलन]; the menstrual discharge; any practical art, any mechanical or fine art (sixty-four such are enu-merated, as carpentering, architecture, jewellery, far-riery, acting, dancing, music, medicine, poetry, &c.); skill, ingenuity, contrivance, fraud, deceit; a boat; title of a grammatical commentary; N. of a deity; [cf. अ-कल, निष्कल, सकल।] —कला-कुशल, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in the elegant arts, singing, dancing, &c. —कला-केलि, इस्, इस्, इ, gay, frolicsome, wanton; (इस्), m. an epithet of Kāma, the god of love. —कला-धर, अस्, m. ‘bearing a digit of the moon;’ an epithet of Śiva; N. of a copyist. —कला-निधि, इस्, m. ‘a treasure or storehouse of digits,’ the moon. —कलान्तर (°ला-अन्°), अम्, n. interest, profit. —कलाप (°ला + आप fr. rt. आप्), अस्, m. ‘that which holds together the single parts,’ a band, a bundle (e. g. मुक्ता-कलाप, an ornament consisting of several strings of pearls; रशना-कलाप, a zone consisting of several strings, worn by women round the waist; जटा-कलाप, a tuft or knot of braided hair); totality, whole body or collection of a number of separate things, a zone, a string of bells worn by women round the waist; the rope round an elephant's neck; a bundle of arrows, a quiver with arrows, a quiver; a peacock's tail (as consisting of a multitude of single feathers); an ornament in general; N. of a grammar, supposed to be revealed by the god Kumāra or Kārttikeya to Sarva-varman; a village where the destroyer Kalki is to be born; the moon; a clever and intelligent man; a poem written in one metre; (ई), f. a bundle of grass. —कलापक, अस्, m. a band, a bundle; a string of pearls; the rope round an ele-phant's neck; a sectarian mark on the forehead; (अम्), n. a number of verses in one metre; a series of four stanzas on one subject; the eye in a peacock's feather?; (अस्, इका, अम्), to be repaid when the peacocks spread their tails. —कलाप-ग्राम, अस्, m., N. of a Grāma or village. —कलाप-च्छन्द, अस्, m. an ornament of pearls consisting of twenty-four strings. —कलाप-तत्त्वार्णव (°व-अर्°), title of a commentary on the Kalāpa grammar. —कलाप-द्वीप, N. of a place, perhaps the same as कलाप-ग्राम. —कलाप-शिरस्, आस्, m., N. of a Muni; (a various reading for कपाल-शिरस्।) —कलापानुसारिन् (°प-अन्°), ई, m. a follower of the Kalāpa grammar. —कलापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, furnished with a bundle of arrows, bearing a quiver with arrows; spreading its tail (said of a peacock &c.); (ई), m. a peacock; the Indian cuckoo; the waved-leaf fig tree, Ficus Infec-toria; N. of an old teacher, a pupil of Vaiśampāyana; (according to some) the author of the Kalāpa grammar; the time (scil. कालः) when peacocks spread their tails; (इनी), f. night; the moon; a species of Cyperus. —कला-पूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, filled up by single or separate parts; (अस्), m. the moon. —कला-भृत्, त्, m. ‘digit-bearer,’ the moon; an artist, a mechanic, &c. —कलायन (°ला-अय्°), अस्, m. a tumbler, a dancer, but especially one who dances or walks on a sharp edge, as the edge of a sword &c. —कला-वत्, आन्, m. ‘having digits,’ the moon; (ती), f. a mystical ceremony, the initiation of the Tantrika student, in which the goddess Durgā is supposed to be transferred from the water-jar to the body of the novice; N. of an Apsaras; N. of the mother of Rādhā; N. of the wife of Kṛta-varman, king of Ayodhyā; N. of the wife of Dāśārha; N. of the lute of the Gandharva Tumburu. —कला-वाद-तन्त्र, कला-विधि-तन्त्र, कला-सार-तन्त्र, names of Tantras. —कला-विलास, अस्, m. a work on rhetoric. —कला-शास्त्र, अम्, n. a work by Viśākhila.
कलिका: कलिका, f. a digit of the moon. See below, s. v.

कलिका कलिका, f. (fr. कला), a digit or the sixteenth part of the moon; an unblown flower [cf. कलि]; the bottom or peg of the Indian lute, made of cane; N. of several metres, a metre con-taining 4 × 8 + 16 syllabic instants; a metre of four lines, each containing fifteen syllables; a metre con-sisting of 12 + 8 + 16 + 20 syllables; title of a work on medicine.
कलाकन्द: कलाकन्द कलाकन्द = कन्द, a species of the Atijagatī metre.
कलाकुल: कलाकुल कलाकुल, अम्, n. poison; [cf. हलाहल।]
कलाङ्कुर: कलाङ्कुर कलाङ्कुर, अस्, m. the bird Ardea Sibirica, a crane; an epithet of the Asura Kaṃsa.
कलाङ्गल: कलाङ्गल कलाङ्गल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?) a kind of weapon (?).
कलाचिक: कलाचिक कलाचिक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?) a ladle; (आ), f. or कलाची, f. the fore-arm, the arm below the elbow.
कलाटीन: कलाटीन कलाटीन, अस्, m. the white water wagtail.
कलाद: कलाद कलाद, अस्, m. a goldsmith.
कलाधिक: कलाधिक कलाधिक, अस्, m. (fr. कल and अधिक ?), a cock; [cf. कलाविक and उषाकल।]
कलानक: कलानक कलानक, अस्, m., N. of one of the attendants of Śiva.
कलापूर: कलापूर कलापूर, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), and आ, f. a kind of musical instrument.
कलामक: कलामक कलामक, अस्, m. a kind of rice ripening in the cold season; [cf. कलम।]
कलाम्बि: कलाम्बि कलाम्बि, इस्, f. or कलाम्बिका, f. lending, a loan; usury.
कलाय: कलाय कलाय, अस्, m., N. of various legu-minous seeds, chiefly of the order Phaseolus, particular kinds of pulse or vetches; (आ), f. a kind of Panicum, = गण्डदूर्वा. —कलाय-खञ्ज, अस्, m. one who trembles and totters as he walks.
कलाविक: कलाविक कलाविक, अस्, m. a cock; [cf. कलाधिक।]
कलाविकल: कलाविकल कलाविकल, अस्, m. a sparrow; [cf. कलविङ्क।]
कलाहक: कलाहक कलाहक, अस्, m. a kind of musical instrument; [cf. काहल।]
कलि: कलि कलि, इस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 3. कल्), N. of the die or side of a die, which is marked with one point (personified as a deity or evil genius in the poem of Nala); the plant Terminalia Bellerica, the nuts of which in olden times were used as dice; N. of the last and worst of the four Yugas, the present or iron age, the age of vice; (the four Yugas or ages have received their names from the marks on dice, the best mark being four points and the worst one; the Kali or fourth age contains, inclusive of the two dawns, 1200 years of the gods or 432,000 years of men, and begins the eighteenth of February 3102 B. C.; at the end of this Yuga the world is to be destroyed); strife (considered as the son of क्रोध ‘Anger’ and हिंसा ‘Injury,’ and as generating with his sister दुरुक्ति ‘Calumny,’ two children, viz. भय ‘Fear’ and मृत्यु ‘Death’); dissension, war, battle; the worst in any class; a hero; an arrow; Ved., N. of a class of mythic beings related to the Gandharvas, and sup-posed by some to be fond of gambling; in epic poetry कलि is held to be the fifteenth of the Deva-gandharvas or children of the Munis; N. of a man; (इस् or ई), f. an unblown flower, a bud. —कलि-कार, अस्, m., N. of several birds, the fork-tailed shrike; Loxia Philippensis, a small bird with a yellow head; a kind of chicken; a plant bearing a nut which is used as a febrifuge, Grey Bonduc, = करञ्ज and पूतिकरञ्ज; an epithet of Nārada; (ई), f. the poisonous plant Methonica Superba. —कलि-कारक, अस्, m. the plant Cæsalpinia Bonducella; (a various reading has कलि-मारक); an epithet of Nārada (‘the quarrelsome’). —कलि-द्रुम, अस्, m. the plant Terminalia Bellerica or the tree of strife, being sup-posed to be the favourite haunt of imps or goblins. —कलि-धर्म-निर्णय, अस्, m., N. of a work. —कलि-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of a writer on music. —कलि-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, quarrelsome, mischievous, mischief-making; (अस्), m. a monkey, an ape; an epithet of Nārada. —कलि-मारक, अस्, m. the plant Cæsalpinia Bonducella; (a various reading for कलि-कारक, q. v.) —कलि-मालक, अस्, m. and कलि-माल्य, अस्, m. the plant Cæsalpinia Bonducella. —कलि-युग, अम्, n., N. of the fourth age, the present or iron age. —कलि-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the tree Terminalia Bellerica. —कलि-संश्रय, अस्, m. the act of betaking one's self to Kali.
कलिक: कलिक कलिक, अस्, m. a curlew.
कलिकाता: कलिकाता कलिकाता, f. the modern name Calcutta.
कलिकापूर्व: कलिकापूर्व कलिकापूर्व, अम्, n. (fr. कलिका and अपूर्व?), acts leading to future consequences not connected with those of a previous birth.
कलिङ्ग: कलिङ्ग कलिङ्ग, अस्, m., N. of a country; the name is applied in the Purāṇas to several places, but especially signifies a district on the Coromandel coast, extending from below Cuttack (Kaṭaka) to the vicinity of Madras; in this sense, like some other names of countries, it is usually confined to the plural number, confounding the place with the people in-habiting it, (these people are said to owe their origin to Kaliṅga, the son of Dīrgha-tamas and Sudeṣṇā; Kaliṅga being sometimes identified with the epic Bali); N. of a scholiast on the Amara-koṣa; N. of a poet; the fork-tailed shrike, Lanius Forficatus, (in this sense derived from कलिम् and ग?; cf. कलि-कार); the plants Cæsalpinia Bonducella, Wrightia Antidysenterica, Acacia Sirisa, Ficus Infectoria; (आ), f. a beautiful woman; the plant Ipomœa Turpethum; (अम्), n. Indra-grain [cf. इन्द्र-यव]; (अस्, आ, अम्), clever; cunning.
कलिङ्गक: कलिङ्गक, अस्, m. the seed of the Coraiya, Indra-grain.
कलिङ्गडी: कलिङ्गडी, f. (?) an epithet of Durgā.
कलिञ्ज: कलिञ्ज कलिञ्ज, अस्, m. a mat, a screen; (a various reading for किलिञ्ज।)
कलिन्द: कलिन्द कलिन्द, अस्, m. the tree Terminalia Bellerica; the sun; (in these meanings perhaps a compound of कलिम् and द); N. of a mountain on which the river Yamunā rises; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (ई), f. a N. of the river Yamunā or Jumnā. —कलिन्द-कन्या or कलिन्द-नन्दिनी or क-लिन्द-शैल-जाता, f. epithets of the river Yamunā or Jumnā.
कलिन्दिका: कलिन्दिका कलिन्दिका, f. science; (a various reading has कलन्दिका।)
कलिल: कलिल कलिल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. कॄ?), covered with, full of; mixed, blended; impenetrable, impervious; (अम्), n. a large heap, thicket, confusion; [cf. कलुष।]
कलुक्क: कलुक्क कलुक्क, अस्, m. a musical instru-ment, a cymbal; (आ), f. a tavern; a meteor.
कलुष: कलुष कलुष, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. कॄ?, said to be fr. rt. 3. कल्), turbid, foul, muddy, unclean; dark, opaque, without brilliancy; hoarse (as the voice); wicked, bad; lazy, idle; (अस्), m. a buffalo; (अम्), n. dirt, uncleanness; sin, wrath. —कलुष-ता, f. or कलुष-त्व, अम्, n. foulness, turbidness; darkness, opacity; agitation, trouble, anger. —कलु-ष-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, of impure origin.
कलुषाय: कलुषाय, nom. A. कलुषायते, -यितुम्, to become turbid.
कलुषित: कलुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, foul, impure; defiled, con-taminated; wicked.
कलुषिन्: कलुषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, foul, impure; defiled, depraved; wicked.
कलुषीकृ: कलुषी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to make turbid or unclean.
कलूतर: कलूतर कलूतर, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), N. of a place.
कलेवर: कलेवर कलेवर, अस्, अम्, m. n. the body; [cf. Lat. cadâver.]
कल्क: कल्क कल्क, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. 3. कल्), a viscous sediment deposited by oily sub-stances when ground; a kind of tenacious paste; dirt, filth; the wax of the ear; ordure, fæces; mean-ness, falsehood, deceit, sin, hypocrisy, pride; the tree Terminalia Bellerica; incense; levigated powder; (अस्, आ, अम्), sinful, wicked; [cf. कलुष, कल्म-ष, किल्विष।] —कल्क-फल, अस्, m. the pome-granate plant (दाडिम). —कल्कालय (°क-आल्°), अस्, m., N. of a man.
कल्कन: कल्कन, अम्, n. falsehood, deceit, cheating, quarrelling.
कल्कि: कल्कि, इस्, m. a N. of Viṣṇu in his future capacity of destroyer of the wicked and liberator of the world from its enemies. This will constitute the tenth and last Avatāra or descent of the deity, and is to take place at the end of the four Yugas or ages. —कल्कि-प्रादुर्भाव, अस्, m. the apparition of Kalki.
कल्किन्: कल्किन्, ई, इनी, इ, foul, turbid, having sediment, dirty, wicked; (ई), m. = कल्कि above.
कल्कल: कल्कल कल्कल, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
कल्प: कल्प कल्प, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. कॢप्), prac-ticable, feasible, possible; proper, fit, able, competent (with gen., loc., inf., and at the end of a compound, e. g. धर्मस्य कल्पः, competent for duty; स्व-कर्मणि न कल्पः, not competent for his own work; यदा न शासितुं कल्पः, if he is not able to rule); strong, vigorous; कल्पे वयसि, in the vigorous period of life; (अस्), m. a sacred precept, law, ordi-nance [cf. विधि, न्याय]; manner of acting, pro-ceeding, practice prescribed by the Vedas (e. g. प्र-थमः कल्पः, a rule to be observed before any other rule, first duty; एतेन कल्पेन, in this way; पशु-कल्प, the rites at the animal sacrifice; न कल्प-मात्रे, not according to the mere letter of the rule without regard to its spirit); the most complete of the six Vedāṅgas, that which prescribes the ritual and gives rules for ceremonial or sacrificial acts; (in medic.) treatment of the sick, manner of curing (e. g. कल्पेतर, one cured or treated differ-ently); the doctrine of poisons and antidotes; (at the end of an adjective compound) having the manner or form of anything, similar to, resembling, like but with a degree of inferiority (e. g. प्रभात-कल्पा शर्वरी, the night which is something similar to dawn, i. e. the night at the approach of dawn; मृ-त-कल्प, similar to a dead person, almost dead; अभेद्य-कल्प, almost impenetrable; according to native grammarians कल्प so used is an accentless affix, before which a final स् is left unchanged, and final ई and ऊ shortened; native authorities also con-nect कल्प with a simple verb, thus पचति-कल्पम्, he cooks pretty well); a resolve, a determination; pro-priety, fitness (?); optionality, alternative [cf. वि-कल्प], doubt; a fabulous period of time, a day of Brahmā or 1000 Yugas, a period of four hundred and thirty-two million years of mortals, measuring the duration of the world; (a month of Brahmā is supposed to contain thirty such Kalpas; according to the Mahā-bhārata twelve months of Brahmā constitute his year, and one hundred such years his lifetime; fifty years of Brahmā are supposed to have elapsed, and we are now in the श्वेतवाराह-कल्प of the fifty-first. The Kalpa, in the same way as the Saṃvatsara or year, is personified as son of Dhruva and Bhrami; at the end of a Kalpa the world is annihilated; hence कल्प is sometimes used for कल्पान्त or the de-struction of the world); N. of certain sentences or verses containing the verb कॢप्; one of the trees of paradise, see कल्प-तरु below; (with Jainas) a term for a particular abode of the deities [cf. कल्प-भव and कल्पातीत]; (अम् or आ), m. f. a kind of intoxicating liquor; [cf. अ-कल्प, अनु-कल्प, उप-कल्प, &c.] —कल्प-कार, अस्, m. an author of ritual or ceremonial rules. —कल्प-केदार, a medical work by Kālīśiva. —कल्प-क्षय, अस्, m. the end of a Kalpa, end of the world, destruction of all things. —कल्प-गा, f., N. of a river. —कल्प-तरु, उस्, m. one of the trees of Svarga or Indra's paradise, a fabulous tree, granting all desires, hence figuratively a generous person; title of a work on jurisprudence; also a work of Lakṣmīdhara; also one of Vācaspati. —कल्प-द्रु, उस्, m. = कल्प-तरु, also N. of a lexicon by Keśava. —कल्प-द्रुम, अस्, m. = कल्प-तरु; a work on jurisprudence; also a Tantra work; the collection of roots by Vopadeva is called कवि-कल्पद्रुम, the tree from which poets obtain all desired roots; and the modern encyclopedia of Rā-dhākānta is entitled शब्द-कल्पद्रुम, the tree which satisfies every desire for words. —कल्प-पा-दप, अस्, m. = कल्प-तरु above. —कल्प-पाल, अस्, m. a protector of order, a legitimate prince; a person who distils or sells spirituous liquors. —कल्प-भव, आस्, m. pl., N. of a certain class of deities. —कल्प-महीरुह्, ट्, m. = कल्प-वृक्ष. —कल्-प-युक्ति, title of a work by Budha. —कल्प-लता, f. a creeper yielding everything desired; कल्पलता-वतार, title of a commentary of Kṛṣṇa on the Vīja-gaṇita; कल्पलता-प्रकाश, title of a com-mentary on the Viṣṇu-bhaktilatā. —कल्प-लतिका, f. = कल्प-लता above; (शब्द-क्°, title of a dic-tionary.) —कल्प-वर्ष, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vasu-deva and Upa-devā. —कल्प-वल्ली, f. = कल्प-लता above. —कल्प-वायु, उस्, m. the wind that is to blow at the end of the world. —कल्प-विटपिन्, ई, m. or कल्प-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the fabulous tree of Indra's heaven; see above. —कल्प-विधि, इस्, m. a rule resembling a ceremonial injunction. —कल्प-वृक्ष-लता, f. a work by Lollaṭa. —कल्प-सूत्र, अम्, n. a Sūtra manual of ritual; also a medicinal work and a work of the Jaina sect so called. —कल्प-सूत्र-व्याख्या, f. a Jaina work on the Kalpasūtras. —कल्पातीत (°प-अत्°), आस्, m. pl., N. of a certain class of deities. —कल्पादि (°प-आदि), इस्, m. the beginning of a Kalpa, the renovation of all things. —कल्पानुपद (°प-अन्°), अम्, n. title of a work belonging to the Sāma-veda. —कल्पान्त (°प-अन्°), अस्, m. the end of a Kalpa, the destruction of the world. —कल्पान्तर (°प-अन्°), अम्, n. another Kalpa. —कल्पान्त-स्थायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, lasting to the end of a Kalpa.
कल्पक: कल्पक, अस्, m. a rite, a ceremony; a barber [cf. कल्पनी]; a kind of Curcuma, commonly कर्चूर। —कल्पक-तरु, उस्, m., N. of a tree of Indra's paradise; [cf. कल्प-तरु।]
कल्पन: कल्पन, अम्, n. forming, fashioning; doing, performing; fixing, constituting; anything fixed or placed upon another thing for ornament; act of clipping, cutting; (आ), f. fixing, constituting, settling; making, performing; fabrication; composing, com-position (of a poem &c.); inventing, invention; for-gery; a fancy, an idea or image formed in the mind; an imagination, intention; contrivance, plan, infer-ence; caparisoning or decorating an elephant; (ई), f. a scissors or shears. —कल्पना-शक्ति, इस्, f. the power of forming ideas.
कल्पनीय: कल्पनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made, fashioned or contrived, to be accomplished, possible, to be substi-tuted or supplied.
कल्पिक: कल्पिक, अस्, आ, अम्, fit, proper.
कल्पित: कल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, made, fabricated, artificial; composed, invented; arranged, put in order; pre-pared; brought; inferred; (अस्), m. an elephant armed or caparisoned for war. —कल्पितार्घ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one for whom a respectful offering is prepared.
कल्पिन्: कल्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. a term used in gambling with dice.
कल्प्य: कल्प्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made or contrived or performed, to be prescribed; relating to ritual; to be substituted.
कल्मन्: कल्मन् कल्मन्, अ, n. according to native grammarians = कर्मन्।
कल्मलि: कल्मलि कल्मलि, Ved. splendor (of the stars?).
कल्मलीकिन्: कल्मलीकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. burning, shining.
कल्मष: कल्मष कल्मष, अस्, अम्, m. n. stain, dirt, sin, dregs; जल-कल्मष, the dirt or sediment of water; (अम्), n. darkness, a division of the infernal regions; the hand below the wrist; (अस्, आ, अम्), dirty, foul. —कल्मष-ध्वंस-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, destroy-ing darkness or sin; preventing the commission of crime.
कल्माष: कल्माष कल्माष, अस्, ई, अम्, variegated, spotted; black, black and white; (अस्), m. a variegated colour; a mixture of black and white, the black colour; a Rakṣas, demon or goblin; a species of fragrant rice; N. of a Nāga; a form of fire; N. of a servant of the sun, identified with Yama; Śākya-muni in a former birth; (ई), f. the spotted cow of Jamadagni, the giver of all desires; N. of a river; (अम्), n. a stain. —कल्माष-कण्ठ, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva. —कल्माष-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a variegated neck. —कल्माष-तन्तुर, अस्, m., N. of a man. —कल्माष-ता, f. spottedness, the state of being variegated. —कल्माष-पाद, अस्, m., N. of a king; also Saudāsa, a descendant of Ikṣvāku, transformed to a Rākṣasa by Vasiṣṭha. —कल्मा-षाङ्घ्रि (°ष-अङ्°), इस्, m. another N. of the same king.
कल्य: कल्य कल्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 3. कल्?), well, sound, healthy, free from sickness; ready, prepared, armed; clever, dexterous; agreeable, auspicious (as a speech or discourse); instructive, admonitory; deaf and dumb [cf. कल and कल्ल]; (अम्), n. dawn, day-break; to-morrow; yesterday (?); कल्यम् or कल्ये, ind. at day-break; (अम् or आ), n. f. spirituous liquor; congratulation; good wishes; good tidings; (आ), f. Emblic Myrobalan, see हरीतकी; [cf. Gr. καλός καλλίων, κάλλιστος &c., for καλyος &c.] —कल्य-जग्धि, इस्, f. the morning-meal, breakfast. —कल्य-त्व, अम्, n. or कल्य-ता, f. health; recovery, con-valescence. —कल्य-पाल or कल्या-पाल or कल्य-पालक or कल्या-पालक, अस्, m. a distiller. —कल्-य-वर्त, अस्, m. the morning-meal, breakfast; a light meal; (अम्), n. anything light, a trifle, a trivial or unimportant matter; [cf. प्रातराश।]
कल्याण: कल्याण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, beautiful, agreeable, friendly, illustrious, noble, excellent, happy, beneficial, salutary, prosperous, propitious, lucky, well, right, good; (अस्), m., N. of a prince, also called Bhaṭṭaśrīkalyāṇa; N. of the author of the poem Gītāgaṅgādhara; (ई), f. a cow; a leguminous shrub, Glycine Debilis; N. of two cities; N. of a river in Ceylon; N. of a deity; (अम्), n. good fortune, happiness, prosperity; virtue; a festival; gold; heaven; N. of the eleventh of the fourteen Pūrvas or most ancient writings of the Jainas. —कल्-याण-कटक, अस्, m., N. of a place. —कल्याण-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, propitious, auspicious, conferring good fortune &c. —कल्याण-कार, अस्, ई, अम्, or कल्याण-कारक, अस्, आ, अम्, creating prosperity or profit. —कल्याण-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, virtuous, good; pro-pitious, lucky. —कल्याण-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of an astronomer in the twelfth century A. D. —कल्याण-चार, अस्, ई, अम्, following virtuous courses; lucky, fortunate. —कल्याण-देवी, f., N. of the wife of Ja-yāpīḍa. —कल्याण-धर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, virtuous, good. —कल्याण-पञ्चमीक, अस्, m. a fortnight, the fifth lunar day of which is lucky. —कल्याण-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —कल्याण-मल्ल, अस्, m., N. of a prince; N. of the author of a work called Anaṅgaraṅga; N. of a son of Gajamalla, author of the commentary called Mālatī. —कल्याण-मित्र, अम्, n. a friend of virtue, a religious counsellor. —कल्याण-राज-चरित्र, अम्, n. ‘the life of king Kalyāṇa’ by Madana. —कल्याण-वचन, अम्, n. friendly speech, good wishes. —कल्याण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, happy. —कल्याण-वर्त्मन्, आ, f., N. of a princess, who erected a statue of Viṣṇu, called Kalyāṇa-svāmi-keśava. —कल्याण-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of an astronomer. —कल्याण-वीज, अस्, m. a sort of pulse, Ervum Hirsutum. —कल्याण-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a scholiast on Varāha-mihira. —कल्याण-सूत्र, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman. —कल्याणाचार (°ण-आच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, following good practices, virtuous. —कल्याणाभिजन (°ण-अभ्°), अस्, ई, अम्, of illustrious birth. —कल्याणी-पञ्चमा, आस्, f. pl. (scil. रात्रयस्) nights of which the fifth is lucky.
कल्याणक: कल्याणक, अस्, इका, अम्, auspicious, efficacious (as a drug), prosperous, happy; (इका), f. red arsenic.
कल्याणिन्: कल्याणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, happy, lucky, prosperous; illustrious; virtuous, good; (इनी), f. the water-plant Sida Cordifolia.
कल्युष: कल्युष कल्युष, अम्, n. the wrist (?).

काकुभ: काकुभ काकुभ, अस्, आ, अम्, consisting of Kakubh verses; a patronymic from Kakubh. —का-कुभ-बार्हत, अस्, m. (scil. प्रगाथ) a Pragātha beginning with a Kakubh and ending with a Bṛhatī.
काकोचिक: काकोचिक काकोचिक, अस्, m. or काकोची, f. or काकोचिन्, ई, m. the fish Cyprinus Cachius.
काकोल: काकोल काकोल, अस्, m. a raven [cf. काक and काकाल]; a boar; a snake; a potter; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a poisonous substance of a black colour or the colour of a raven, whence its name; possibly the berry of the Cocculus Indicus; (अम्), n. a division of the infernal regions or hell; (अस्, ई), m. f. a vegetable substance used in medicine, described as sweet and cooling, allaying fever, removing phlegm, &c.; it is said to be a root brought from Nepal or Morung.
काक्ष: काक्ष काक्ष (का-अक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, frowning, looking scornfully or in displeasure; (अस्), m. a glance, a wink or leer; (अम्), n. a frown, a look of dis-pleasure; [cf. कटाक्ष।]
काक्षतव: काक्षतव काक्षतव, अम्, n. the fruit of Kakṣatu.
काक्षसेनि: काक्षसेनि काक्षसेनि, इस्, m. (a patronymic fr. कक्ष-सेन), an epithet of Abhipratārin.
काक्षि: काक्षि काक्षि, इस्, m., N. of a man.
काक्षी: काक्षी काक्षी, f. a perfume, a fragrant kind of earth; the plant Cytisus Cajan.
काक्षीव: काक्षीव काक्षीव, अस्, m. the plant Hyper-anthera Moringa; N. of a son of Gautama and of Auśīnarī, (irregular patronymic fr. कक्षीवत् or काक्षीवत्।)
काक्षीवक: काक्षीवक, अस्, m. the plant Hyperanthera Mo-ringa.
काक्षीवत: काक्षीवत, अस्, ई, अम्, composed by or relating to Kakṣīvat; (a patronymic fr. कक्षीवत्), epi-thet of Śambara.
काग: काग काग, अस्, m. a crow; (in the Prākṛt dialects, a raven; cf. काक।)
काग्नि: काग्नि काग्नि (का-अग्°), इस्, m. a little fire.
काङ्कायन: काङ्कायन काङ्कायन, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. कङ्क), N. of a Muni.
काङ्क्ष्: काङ्क्ष् काङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. काङ्क्षति, च-काङ्क्ष, ep. also A. काङ्क्षते, &c., काङ्क्षितुम्, to wish, desire; to strive to obtain; to long for, hope for (with acc.), expect; to wait; to look for anything (with dat.): Caus. काङ्क्षयति, अचकाङ्क्षत्: Desid. चिकाङ्क्षिषति: Intens. चा-काङ्क्ष्यते and चाकांष्टि; [cf.
