कार्षापण: कार्षापण कार्षापण, अस्, अम्, m. n. (= कर्-षापण), a coin or weight of different values, as synonymous with Karṣa; if of gold, weighing 16 Māṣas, which are variously calculated, see कर्ष; if of silver, it is in value = 16 Paṇas of Kowries, i. e. 1280 Kowries, commonly termed a Kāhan; if of copper, it weighs 80 Raktikās, or the same as of gold, about 176 grains; according to some it is the same as a Paṇa of Kowries, i. e. 80 Kowries; at the end of a compound it means ‘worth so many Kārṣāpaṇas;’ (अम्), n. money, gold and silver; (अस्), m. a husband-man (?); N. of a warrior-tribe; the chief of this tribe. —कार्षापणावर (°ण-अव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the value of at least one Kārṣāpaṇa (as a fine).
कार्षापणक: कार्षापणक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a weight or measure of different values, as synonymous with Karṣa.
कार्षापणिक: कार्षापणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, worth one Kārṣā-paṇa, bought &c. with one Kārṣāpaṇa.
कार्ष्ण: कार्ष्ण कार्ष्ण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कृष्ण), coming from or belonging to the black antelope; made of the skin of the black antelope; belonging to the god Kṛṣṇa or Kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyana, composed by him &c. (e. g. कार्ष्णं वेदम्, the Mahā-bhā-rata); belonging to a descendant of Kṛṣṇa; black; (ई), f. the plant Asparagus Racemosus; (अम्), n., Ved. the skin of the black antelope; (अस्), m. the black antelope (?).
कार्ष्णाजिनि: कार्ष्णाजिनि, इस्, m. (fr. कृष्णाजिन), a patro-nymic from Kṛṣṇājina; N. of a teacher; N. of a philosopher; N. of the author of a law-book.
कार्ष्णायस: कार्ष्णायस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कृष्णायस), of iron, made of black iron; (अम्), n. iron.
कार्ष्णि: कार्ष्णि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Kṛṣṇa; an epithet of Viśvaka; N. of a Devagandharva; an epithet of the god of love.
कार्ष्ण्य: कार्ष्ण्य, अम्, n. blackness, black colour, darkness.
कार्ष्मर्य: कार्ष्मर्य कार्ष्मर्य, अस्, m., Ved. the tree Gmelina Arborea. —कार्ष्मर्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of this tree.
कार्ष्य: कार्ष्य कार्ष्य, अस्, m. the tree Shorea Robusta. —कार्ष्य-वण, अम्, n. a forest of these trees.
काल: काल 1. काल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. 3. कल्?; for 2. काल, ‘time,’ see next page), black, of a dark colour, especially dark-blue which is often confounded with black; (अस्), m. a black or dark-blue colour; the black part of the eye; the Indian cuckoo; the poi-sonous serpent, Coluber Naga (= काल-सर्प); the plant Cassia Sophora; a plant, a red kind of plum-bago; the resin of the plant Shorea Robusta; the planet Saturn; an epithet of Śiva; also of Rudra; N. of a son of Hrada; also of a prince; also of a brother of king Prasena-jit; also of a future Buddha; also of a Nāga-rāja; of a Rakṣas; of an enemy of Śiva; N. of a mountain; (with the Jainas) N. of one of the nine treasures; a mystical name for the letter म्; (आ), f., N. of several plants, Indigofera Tinctoria; Piper Longum; a plant nearly related to Ipomœa Turpethum, perhaps Ipomœa Atropurpurea; Nigella Indica; Rubia Munjista; Ruellia Longifolia; Physalis Flexuosa; Bignonia Suaveolens; the fruit of the Kālā (?); N. of a daughter of Dakṣa, the mother of the Kāleyas or Kālakeyas (a family of Asuras); an epithet of Durgā; (ई), f. black colour, ink or black-ing; abuse, censure, defamation; a row or succession of black clouds; night; a worm or animalcule gene-rated in the acetous fermentation of milk, = क्षीर-कीट and क्षार-कीट; N. of several plants, = का-लाञ्जनी; another plant, Cajanus Indicus; Ipomœa Turpethum; Bignonia Suaveolens; one of the seven tongues or flames of fire; a form of Durgā; one of the Mātṛs or divine mothers; N. of a female evil spirit, mother of the Kālakeyas; one of the sixteen Vidyādevīs; an epithet of Śatyavatī, the wife of king Śāntanu and mother of Vyāsa or Kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyana, but before her marriage. (After her marriage she had a son called Vicitra-vīrya, whose widows were married by Kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyana and bore to him Dhṛta-rāṣṭra and Pāṇḍu; according to other legends Kālī is the wife of Bhīma-sena and mother of Sarva-gata); N. of a river, otherwise काला गङ्गा; (अम्), n. a black kind of Agallochum; a kind of perfume (= कक्कोलक); iron; [cf. Gr. κηλίς, κελαινός Lat. caligo.] —काल-कचु, उस्, f. the plant Arum Colocasia. —काल-कण्टक, अस्, m. a gallinule; [cf. the next.] —काल-कण्ठ, अस्, m., N. of several birds, a peacock; a water fowl, a gallinule; a wag-tail; a sparrow; the plant Terminalia Tomentosa, = पीतशाल and पीतसार; an epithet of Śiva; [cf. नील-कण्ठ।] —काल-कण्ठक, अस्, m. a gallinule. —काल-कन्दक, अस्, m. a water-snake. —काल-कर्णिका or काल-कर्णी, f. misfortune (predicted as the consequence of having black ears). —काल-कलाय, अस्, m. dark pulse, Phaseolus Max. —काल-कस्तूरी, f. the plant Hibiscus Abelmoschus, the seeds smelling of musk when rubbed. —काल-कीर्ति, इस्, m., N. of a king identified with the Asura Suparṇa. —काल-कुष्ठ, अस्, m. a kind of earth brought from mountains; [cf. कङ्कुष्ठ।] —काल-कोटि, इस्, f., N. of a region. —काल-क्लीतक, अम्, n. the indigo plant. —काल-खञ्ज, आस्, m. pl. = कालकञ्ज, perhaps only a wrong reading; (अम्), n. the liver. —काल-खञ्जन, अम्, n. the liver. —काल-खण्ड, अम्, n. the liver. —काल-गङ्गा, f., N. of a river in Ceylon. —काल-गण्डिका, f., N. of a river. —काल-गन्ध, अस्, m. a kind of Cobra de Capella, = काल-कन्दक. —का-ल-घट, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman. —काल-जोषक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (a various reading has कालजोषिक।) —काल-ताल, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = तमाल. —काल-तिन्दुक, अस्, m. a kind of ebony. —काल-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —काल-तोयक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —काल-दन्तक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga, a son of Vāsuki. —१। काल-नर, अस्, m., N. of a son of Sabhānara, a son of Anu; (for 2. काल-नर see under 2. काल।) —काल-नाभ, अस्, m. (नाभ = नाभि), N. of an Asura, a son of Hiraṇyākṣa; also of a son of Hiraṇya-kaśipu; also of a son of Vipra-citti and Siṃhikā. —काल-निर्यास, अस्, m. a fragrant and resinous exudation from the plant Amyris Agallocha. —काल-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, black-eyed. —काल-पर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a tree bearing dark-coloured leaves, Tabernæmontana Coro-naria, commonly called Tagara. —काल-पर्वत, अस्, m., N. of a mountain. —कालपात्रिक, अस्, m. (fr. काल-पात्र), a kind of mendicant whose alms-dish is painted black. —काल-पालक, अम्, n. a kind of earth; [cf. कङ्कुष्ठ, काल-कुष्ठ।] —काल-पीलुक, अस्, m., N. of a tree; see कुपीलु. —काल-पुच्छ or काल-पुच्छक, अस्, m. a species of animal living in marshes. —काल-पुष्प, अम्, n., N. of a plant; see कलाय. —काल-पूग, अस्, m. the black multitude, i. e. the common people (?). —काल-पृष्ठ, अस्, m. a species of antelope (with a black back); a heron; (अम्), n., N. of the bow of Karṇa; a bow in general. —काल-पेशी, f., N. of a plant; see श्यामा. —काल-भाण्डिका, f. the plant Rubia Munjista. —काल-मसी, f., N. of a river; also called कालमही. —कालमान and काल-माल, अस्, m. the plant Ocimum Sanctum, a fragrant pot-herb. —काल-मुख, अस्, m. a kind of monkey; N. of a fabulous people; (आ), f., N. of a female. —काल-मुष्कक, अस्, m. the plant Bignonia Indica; see मुष्कक। —काल-मूल, अस्, m., N. of a plant, commonly Rakta-citraka. —काल-मेशिका or काल-मेषिका, f. the plant Rubia Munjista; also the plant Ipomœa Atropurpurea (?). —काल-मेषी, f., N. of several plants, Vernonia Anthelminthica; Rubia Munjista; and perhaps Ipomœa Atropurpurea. —काल-यवन, अस्, m., N. of a prince of the Yavanas; a tyrannical Asura, the foe of Kṛṣṇa, destroyed by him by a stratagem. —१। काल-रात्रि, इस् or ई, f. a dark night; (for 2. see under 2. काल।) —काल-लवण, अम्, n. a kind of black factitious and purgative salt, commonly called विड्-लवण. —काल-लोचन, अस्, m., N. of a Daitya. —काल-लौह, अम्, n. iron. —काल-वदन, अस्, m., N. of a Daitya; also called शाल-वदन. —का-ल-वृक्ष and काल-वृन्त, अस्, m. a kind of vetch, Dolichos Biflorus [cf. कुलत्थ]; (ई), f. the trumpet flower, Bignonia Suaveolens. —काल-वेला, f. the time of Saturn, a particular time of the day at which any religious act is improper, half a watch in every day. —काल-शम्बर, अस्, m., N. of a Dānava. —काल-शाक, अम्, n. the pot-herb Ocimum Sanctum. —का-ल-शालि, इस्, m. a black sort of rice. —काल-शिवि, इस्, m., N. of a man. —काल-शैल, अस्, m., N. of a mountain. —काल-सङ्कर्षा, f. a girl nine years old, who personates Durgā at a festival in honour of this goddess. —काल-सर्प, अस्, m. the black and most poisonous variety of the Cobra, Coluber Naga. —काल-सार, अस्, m. the black antelope; (अम्), n. a yellow sort of sandal-wood. —काल-स्कन्ध, अस्, m., N. of several plants; a kind of ebony with a dark trunk, Diospyros Embryopteris; the Tamāla, a tree bearing dark blossoms, Xanthochymus Pictorius; another plant, = जीवक; another, = दुष्खदिर; the glomerous fig tree, Ficus Glomerata. —कालागुरु (°ल-अग्°), उ, n. a black kind of aloe wood or Agallo-chum. —कालाङ्ग (°ल-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a dark-blue body, as a sword with a dark-blue edge. —कालाजिन (°ल-अज्°), अस्, m., N. of a people. —कालाञ्जन (°ल-अञ्°), अम्, n. a black unguent; (ई), f. a small shrub used as a purgative. —कालाण्डज (°ल-अण्°), अस्, m. the black bird, an epithet of the Indian cuckoo. —कालानुशारिवा, f., N. of two plants, = तगर; and शीतलीजटा, commonly śīulīchop. —कालानुसारक (°ल-अन्°), अम्, n., N. of a tree, = तगर; yellow sandal. —कालानुसारि, इस्, m. or कालानुसारिन् (°ल-अन्°), ई, m. or कालानुसारिवा, f. benzoin or benjamin. —कालानुसार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. gum benjamin or benzoin; (अम्), n. a yellow fragrant wood from which a perfume is pre-pared, sandal-wood (?); N. of a tree, = तगर; (अस्, अम्), m. n. the tree Dalbergia Sissoo. —काला-नुसार्यक, अम्, n. gum benzoin or benjamin. —कालाम्र (°ल-आम्°), अस्, m., N. of a Dvīpa. —कालायस (°ल-अयस्), अम्, n. iron. —कालायस-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, of iron, consisting of iron. —का-लाशोक (°ल-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist king. —कालासुहृद् (°ल-अस्°), त्, m. an enemy of Kāla, epithet of Śiva. —कालेश्वर (°ल-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of a mountain. —कालोदक (°ल-उद्°), अम्, n., N. of a dark piece of water; N. of an ocean.

काल 2. काल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 3. कल्), a fixed or right point of time, a space of time, time in general, (in the Ṛg-veda this word occurs only once, in the Brāhmaṇas oftener); the proper time or fit season for (with gen., dat., loc., pot., &c., e. g. कालः प्र-स्थानस्य or प्रस्थानाय or प्रस्थाने, time for departure; क्रिया-कालः, time for action; न अयं कालो विलम्बितुम्, this is not the time to delay; कालो यद् भुञ्जीत भवान्, it is time for you to eat); the weather; time as leading to events, the causes of which are imperceptible to the mind of man; destiny, fate; time as destroying all things; death, time of death, often personified and repre-sented with the attributes of Yama, regent of the dead, or even identified with him, (hence कालम् इ or कालं कृ, to die; काल-समायुक्त, dead; काल in this sense is frequently connected with अन्तक and मृत्यु, e. g. अभ्यधावत प्रजाः काल इवान्तकः, he attacked the people like Time the destroyer, cf. कालान्तक below; काल personified is also a Devarṣi in Indra's court, and a son of Dhruva); a period of time, time of the world; measure of time, prosody; a section, a part; देश-कालौ, the right place and the right time, place and time; कालं कृ, to appoint or fix a time; उभौ कालौ, both times, sunrise and sunset; षष्ठे काले ऽह्नः, at the sixth hour of the day, at midday; षष्ठान्न-काल, one who eats only at the sixth meal-time, i. e. who passes five meals without eating and has no meal till the evening of the third day; or without अन्न, e. g. चतुर्थ-कालम्, at the fourth meal-time, i. e. at the evening of the second day; षष्ठे काले, at the evening of the third day; ऋतु-काल, the time of a woman's courses; गच्छता कालेन, in the course of time, after some time; नित्य-कालम्, constantly, always; दीर्घ-कालम्, dur-ing a long time; दीर्घेण कालेण, after a long time; कालेन, in the course of time; दीर्घस्य कालस्य, after a long time; कस्यचित् कालस्य, after some time; कालात् or कालतस्, in the course of time &c.; [cf. Goth. hveila; Mod. Germ. weile; Gr. καιρός, ὥρα (?); Lat. hora, calen-dœ: cf. also Gr. κήρ Hib. ceal, ‘death and everything terrible.’] —काल-करण, अम्, n. appointing or fixing a time. —काल-कर्मन्, अ, n. death. —काल-कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, like death, fatal, deadly. —काल-कार, अस्, ई, अम्, making or producing time. —काल-कारित, अस्, आ, अम्, effected or brought about by or in time. —काल-कुण्ठ, अस्, m. an epithet of Yama. —काल-कूट, अस्, अम्, m. n. a deadly poison; see s. v. —काल-कृत्, त्, m. the sun (producing the times, i. e. seasons). —काल-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by time; fixed; appointed (as to time); lent or deposited by a giver for a certain time; (अस्), m. the sun; time (?). —काल-कौमुदी, f., N. of a work. —काल-क्रम, अस्, m. lapse of time; काल-क्रमेण, in process of time. —काल-क्रिया, f. fixing a time; title of the second chapter of the Sūrya-Siddhānta; death. —काल-क्षेप, अस्, m. allowing time to pass away, delay, loss of time; spending or passing the time; अकाल-क्षेपम्, ind. without delay. —काल-गति, इस्, f. the lapse of time. —काल-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. ‘a joint of time,’ a year. —काल-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, killing in the course of time, i. e. by degrees, slowly (as a poison). —काल-चक्र, अम्, n. the wheel of time, time represented as a wheel, which always turns round; a given revolution of time, a cycle; according to the Jainas, the wheel of time has twelve Aras or spokes and turns round once in 2000, 000,000,000, 000 Sāgaras of years [cf. अव-सर्पिणी and उत्-सर्पिणी]; the wheel of fortune, the vicissitudes of life, the wheel of time or fate is sometimes regarded as a weapon; with Buddhists, a Tantra; (अस्), m. an epithet of the sun. —काल-चोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, summoned by the angel of death. —कालचोदित-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, acting under the influence of fate. —काल-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, one who knows the fixed times or seasons; (अस्), m. an astrologer; a cock. —काल-ज्ञान, अम्, n., N. of a medical work; N. of a work by Malla-deva on the symptoms of diseases; a medical work by Śambhūnātha. —काल-ज्ञानिन्, ई, m. an epithet of Śiva. —काल-तत्त्वार्णव (°व-अर्°), ‘the ocean of the truth of time,’ title of a work. —काल-तरङ्ग, the first part of the Smṛty-artha-sāgara by Nṛsiṃha. —काल-ता, f. seasonableness, timeliness. —काल-तुल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, like death, deadly. —काल-त्रय, अम्, n. the three times, i. e. past, present, and future. —काल-दण्ड, अस्, m. the staff of death, death. —काल-दमनी, f. an epithet of Durgā. —काल-धर्म, अस्, m. or काल-धर्मन्, आ, m. the line of conduct suitable to any time or season; the law, rule or operation of time, death, dying; influence of time, seasonableness; effects proper to the time or season. —काल-धारणा, f. prolongation of time.  — 2. काल-नर, अस्, m. ‘a time-man,’ i. e. in astro-logy the figure of a man's body on the various limbs of which the twelve signs of the zodiac are distributed for the purpose of foretelling future destinies; [cf. काल-पुरुष।] —काल-नाथ, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva. —काल-निधि, इस्, m. an epithet of Śiva. —काल-नियोग, अस्, m. the command of time, fate, destiny. —काल-निरूपण, अम्, n. chronology. —काल-निर्णय, अस्, m. ‘determination or fixing of times,’ title of a work, also called काल-माधवीय, by Mādhavācārya. —काल-निर्णय-दीपिका, f. title of a metrical recension of the same work. —काल-निर्णय-प्रकाश, अस्, m. title of a work on juris-prudence (?). —काल-निर्वाह, अस्, m. providing for daily wants. —काल-नेमि, इस्, f. the felly or rim of the wheel of time, regarded as a terrible weapon; (अस्), m., N. of an Asura slain by Kṛṣṇa, iden-tified with Kaṃsa; N. of a Rakṣas; N. of a son of the Brāhman Yajña-soma. —काल-नेमिन्, ई, m., N. of an Asura; [cf. the preceding.] —कालनेमि-रिपु, उस्, m. or कालनेमि-हन्, आ, m. or कालनेमि-हर, अस्, m. or कालनेम्य्-अरि, इस्, m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu, the destroyer of the Asura Kāla-nemi. —काल-पक्व, अस्, आ, अम्, ripened by time, i. e. spontaneously (opposed to अग्नि-पक्व). —काल-पथ, अस्, m., N. of a son of Viśvā-mitra. —काल-परिवास, अस्, m. standing for a time (so as to be-come stale or fermented). —काल-पाश, अस्, m. the noose of Yama or death. —काल-पाशिक, अस्, m. a hangman, an executioner, (one who has the noose of Yama.) —काल-पुरुष, अस्, m., cf. 2. काल-नर। —काल-प्रभात, अम्, n. the dawning of the best season, the two months following the rainy season, autumn; the sultry season. —काल-प्ररूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, over-blown, over-ripe. —काल-भक्ष, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva. —काल-भृत्, त्, m. the sun; [cf. काल-कृत्।] —काल-मयूख, अस्, m. title of a part of Bhāskara. —काल-महिमन्, आ, m. or काल-माहात्म्य, अम्, n. the power or sway of time. —काल-माधव-कारिका, f. title of a work. —काल-मूर्ति, इस्, f. time personified. —काल-याप, अस्, m. allowing time to pass away, putting off, delaying, procrastination. —काल-यापन, अम्, n. passing away time, putting off, delaying. —काल-योग, अस्, m. connection with time, with fate or destiny; fate, destiny. —काल-योगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, reigning over des-tiny, an epithet of Śiva. —काल-योधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fighting, or one who fights in season or at the proper time. —२। काल-रात्रि, इस् or ई, f. the night of all-destroy-ing time, the night of destruction at the end of the world, often personified or identified with Durgā or with one of the Śaktis of Durgā; a particular night in the life of man, on the seventh day of the seventh month of the seventy-seventh year, after which period a man is exempt from attention to the usual ordi-nances; N. of a Brāhman woman, familiar with magic. —काल-रूप-धृष्, क्, क्, क् (the last member of the compound being by some referred to rt. धृ or दृह्), wearing the form of Yama or death. —काल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, connected with time. —काल-विक्र-म, अस्, m. power of time, death. —काल-विधान, अम्, n. title of a work. —काल-विधवंसन, अस्, m. (scil. रस) a term for a particular drug or medicine. —काल-विप्रकर्ष, अस्, m. prolongation of time. —काल-विवेक, अस्, m., N. of a work by Jīmūta-vahana. —काल-वृद्धि, इस्, f. periodical interest, payable monthly, &c. —काल-वेग, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga, a son of Vāsuki. —काल-व्यापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, filling all time, everlasting. —काल-संरोध, अस्, m. keeping back or retaining for a long time; lapse of a long period of time. —काल-संहिता, f., N. of an astrological work. —काल-सदृश, अस्, ई, अम्, opportune, seasonable; deathlike. —काल-सम्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, effected by time, dated, bearing a date. —काल-साह्वय, अस्, आ, अम्, named after Kāla. —काल-सूत्र or काल-सूत्रक, अम्, n. the thread of time or death; N. of one of the twenty-one hells. —काल-स्वरूप, अस्, आ, अम्, having the very form of death (applied to any terrific object). —काला-कृष्ट (°ल-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, led to death or de-struction, drawn to or by one's fate; produced or brought about by time. —कालाक्षरिक, अस्, m. (fr. काल+अक्षर), a scholar, a pupil who has begun to read. —कालाग्नि (°ल-अग्°), इस्, m. the fire that is to destroy the world; the conflagration at the end of time. —कालाग्नि-रुद्र, अस्, m. Rudra regarded as the fire that is to destroy the world; (scil. रस) N. of a particular drug or medicine. —कालाग्निरुद्रो-पनिषद् (°र-उप्°), त्, f., N. of several Upaniṣads. —कालातीत (°ल-अत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, elapsed, passed by. —कालात्मक (°ल-आत्°), अस्, इका, अम्, depending on time or destiny. —कालात्यय (°ल-अत्°), अस्, m. lapse of time, loss or destruction by lapse of time. —का-लात्ययोपदिष्ट (°य-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, taught or rectified by the lapse of time; term for a vain argu-ment (हेत्व्-आभास), also called अतीत-काल and बा-धित. —कालादर्श (°ल-आद्°), अस्, m. ‘the mirror of time,’ title of a work. —कालाध्यक्ष (°ल-अध्°), अस्, m. the overseer or leader of time, an epithet of the sun. —कालानल (°ल-अन्°), अस्, m. the fire of all-destroying time, the universal conflagration at the end of all things; N. of a son of Sabhā-nara. —कालान्तक (°ल-अन्°), अस्, m. time regarded as the god of death. —कालान्तक-यम, अस्, m. all-destroying time in the form of Yama. —कालान्तर (°ल-अन्°), अम्, n. interval, intermediate time; period, process of time; a former or another time. —कालान्-तर-क्षम, अस्, आ, अम्, able to bear an interval of delay. —कालान्तर-विष, अस्, आ, अम्, poison-ous at certain times; (अस्), m. a poisonous animal, venomous only when enraged or alarmed, as a rat &c. —कालान्तरावृत्त (°र-आव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, hidden or concealed by time. —कालान्तरावृत्ति-शुभा-शुभ (°भ-अश्°), आनि, n. pl. good and evil things occurring within the revolutions of time. —काला-वधि (°ल-अव्°), इस्, m. a fixed or appointed time. —कालाव्यवाय (°ल-अव्°), अस्, m. no interval of time. —कालाशुद्धि, इस्, m. or कालाशौच (°ल-अश्°), अम्, n. season of mourning or ceremonial impurity, as at the birth of a child, the death of a relation &c., when it is considered unlawful to perform any religious rites. —काले-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born or produced at a fixed time or at due time. —कालोत्तर (°ल-उत्°), N. of a work. —कालोत्पादित (°ल-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, pro-duced in due season. —कालोप्त (°ल-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, sown in due season.
कालक: कालक, अस्, आ, अम्, dark-blue, coloured dark-blue; dark-coloured, black; (अस्), m. a mole, a freckle, a mark; the black part of the eye; a water-snake (अलगर्द); a kind of grain; N. of a Rakṣas; also of an Asura; N. of a mountain; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a Dānava family; (आ), f., Ved. a kind of bird; N. of a female evil spirit, mother of the Kālakeyas; a daughter of Dakṣa; also of Vaiśvānara; (अम्), n. the liver; N. of a plant. —कालक-वृक्षीय, अस्, m., N. of a sage. —कालकाक्ष (°क-अक्°), अस्, m., N. of an Asura. —कालकाञ्ज (°क-अञ्ज?), अस्, m. (?), Ved., N. of an animal (‘black-spotted?’); N. of a constellation (?); N. of an Asura.
कालकेय: कालकेय, अस्, m. (a metronymic fr. कालका), N. of an Asura; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a Dānava family; [cf. कालकञ्ज, कालकाञ्ज, 1. कालेय।]
कालिक: 1. कालिक, अस्, m. a species of heron, Ardea Jacu-lator (also written कालीक); N. of a king of the Nāgas; (इका), f. blackness or black colour; ink or blacking; cloudiness, a multitude or succession of clouds, a dark cloud threatening rain; a fault or flaw in gold; the liver; a particular blood-vessel in the ear; a line of hair extending from the pudenda to the navel; a kind of spirituous liquor; a female crow; a small singing bird with black wings (Turdus Macrourus, commonly Śyāmā); a scorpion; a small worm or animalcule formed by the fermentation of milk; N. of several plants, a medicinal plant, commonly Vṛścikapattra; another plant, Valeriana Jaṭāmāṃsi; a kind of Ter-minalia; a branch of the plant Trichosanthes Diœca; a kind of fragrant earth; a N. or form of Durgā; a girl of four years old, who personates the goddess Durgā at a festival held in honour of that deity; a kind of Yoginī; a species of Kinnarī; an epithet of Durgā; N. of a female evil spirit, daughter of Vai-śvānara; (with Jainas) N. of a kind of genius who executes the commands of the fourth Arhat; N. of a river; (अम्), n. black sandal-wood. —कालिका-क्रम, अस्, m. title of a work. —कालिका-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. a medical work. —कालिका-पुराण, अम्, n. the Purāṇa of Kālikā, i. e. of Durgā, title of an Upa-purāṇa. —कालिका-मुख, अस्, m., N. of a Rakṣas. —कालिकाश्रम (°का-आश्°), अस्, m., N. of a hermit-age. —कालिकोपपुराण (°का-उप्°), अम्, n., N. of an Upa-purāṇa.

2. कालिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to time, connected with time, depending on time; fit for any particular season, seasonable; lasting a long time, of long standing (often at the end of a compound, e. g. आसन्न-कालिक, relating to a time near at hand, impending; मास-कालिक, monthly); अ-कालिकम्, without delay; (आ), f. price of a commodity on credit, or a price to be paid at a fixed period or by instal-ments; periodical interest paid by the month &c.; change of complexion. —कालिक-ता, f. or कालिक-त्व, अम्, n. time, date, season.
कालिक कालिक। See under 1. काल and 2. काल at page 224 and last col.
कालिय: 1. कालिय, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga or serpent inhabit-ing the Yamunā, slain by Kṛṣṇa (also written कालीय, see below). —कालिय-दमन, अस्, or कालिय-जित्, m., N. of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu as destroyer of the serpent.
2. कालिय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to time. See col. 3.
कालिय 3. कालिय, अस्, m. (fr. कलि; for 1. and 2. see under 1. and 2. काल), the present age, commonly called the Kali-yuga.
काली: काली, f., N. of Durgā, the wife of the god Śiva. —काली-कुल-सर्वस्व, N. of a work. —काली-त-नय, अस्, m. a buffalo (‘son or favourite of Durgā,’ more correctly हंसकाली-तनय). —काली-पु-राण, अम्, n. the Purāṇa of Kālī, title of an Upa-purāṇa. —काली-माहात्म्य, अम्, n. = चण्डिका-मा-हात्म्य. —काली-रहस्य, title of a work. —काली-शिव, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Kalpa-kedāra. —काली-हृदय, title of a work.
कालीय: कालीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to blackness; (अम्), n. a dark kind of sandal or perhaps of Agallochum; N. of a Nāga, see 1. कालिय above.
2. कालीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to time, timely.
कालीय 1. कालीय। See p. 225 and col. 1.
कालीयक: कालीयक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a species of aloe wood; a kind of turmeric (Curcuma Xanthorrhiza?), a kind of fragrant wood of a yellow colour; yellow sandal; a dark kind of sandal-wood; (अस्), m., N. of a Nāga, see 1. कालिय above.
कालेय: 1. कालेय, अम्, n. (for 2. see s.v.), the liver; saffron; a yellow fragrant wood; the black sandal-wood; (अस्, आ, अम्), dark-coloured; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a family of Daityas (metronymic fr. काला).
कालेय 2. कालेय, अम्, n. (fr. कलि; for 1. see under 1. काल), the Sāman of Kali; (अस्, आ, अम्), belonging to Kali, the Kali age &c.
कालेयक: कालेयक, अस्, m. the plant Curcuma Xanthorrhiza, see कालीयक above; (अम्), n. a fragrant wood, see above; a particular part of the intestines; a disease like jaundice; (अस्), m. a dog (for कौलेयक).
काल्यक: काल्यक, अस्, m. zedoary (Curcuma Zerumbet). See काल्पक।
कालय: कालय, nom. P. कालयति, -यितुम्, to show or announce the time.
कालिनी: कालिनी, f. ‘bringing death,’ N. of the sixth lunar mansion.
कालीन: कालीन, अस्, आ, अम् (at the end of comp.), belonging or relating to any particular time, timely, seasonable.
कालीन कालीन। See under 2. काल, col. 1.
काल्य: काल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, timely, seasonable, fit for any particular season; being in a particular period; plea-sant, agreeable, auspicious (as discourse; cf. कल्य); (अस्), m., N. of a man; (आ), f. a cow fit for the bull; (अम्), n. day-break.
कालकञ्ज: कालकञ्ज कालकञ्ज or कालकञ्ज्य, आस्, m. pl., N. of a Dānava family, the children of Kālakā.
कालकटङ्कट: कालकटङ्कट कालकटङ्कट, अस्, m. an epi-thet of Śiva; (a various reading has शालकटङ्कट); [cf. कटङ्कट।]
कालकील: कालकील कालकील or कालकीलक, अस्, m. a confused or mingled sound, a tumult; [cf. कलकल।]
कालकुञ्च: कालकुञ्च कालकुञ्च, अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
कालकूट: कालकूट कालकूट, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. कल-कूट), a kind of poison contained in a bulbous root or tuber; a mortal or deadly poison; a poison pro-duced at the churning of the ocean, swallowed by Śiva and causing the blueness of his neck; a poison in general; (अस्), m. myrrh; N. of a country near the Himālaya and the people inhabiting it; an epithet of Yama; [cf. काल-कुण्ठ।]
कालकूटक: कालकूटक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a kind of poison contained in a bulbous root; a deadly poison produced at the churning of the ocean; a poison in general.
कालकूटि: कालकूटि, इस्, m. a prince of the Kalakūṭas.
कालङ्कत: कालङ्कत कालङ्कत, अस्, m. the plant Cassia Sophora.
कालञ्जर: कालञ्जर कालञ्जर, अस्, m., N. of a mountain in Bundalkhand considered as sacred, the modern Kallinjer; N. of the adjacent country; an assembly or meeting-place of religious mendicants; Kallinjer is one of the places at which such assemblies meet, being enumerated amongst the Tapasyasthānas or spots adapted to practices of austere devotion; an epithet of Śiva; (आ or ई), f. an epithet of Durgā.
कालबलन: कालबलन कालबलन, अम्, n. armour, mail; (a wrong reading for काय-बलन or काय-वलन।)
कालबव: कालबव कालबव or कालवव, अस्, m., N. of a man.
कालबविन्: कालबविन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a school.
कालम्बी: कालम्बी कालम्बी, f. or कालम्ब्य, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), N. of a caravansery.
कालव: कालव कालव, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
कालवेय: कालवेय कालवेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a school.
कालशेय: कालशेय कालशेय, अम्, n. (fr. कलशि = क-लश), buttermilk, produced in a jar or pitcher by churning; also कालसेय।
कालानर: कालानर कालानर, अस्, m., N. of a son of Sabhā-nara; [cf. काल-नर and कालानल।]
कालानुनादिन्: कालानुनादिन् कालानुनादिन्, ई, m. = कला-नुनादिन्, a large black bee; a sparrow, the francoline partridge.
कालाप: कालाप कालाप, अस्, m. (fr. कलाप), the hair of the head; a serpent's hood; a demon, an imp or goblin; a student of the Kalāpa grammar; one who knows or follows this grammar; (fr. कला-पिन्), a pupil of Kalāpin; epithet of Ārāḍa, a teacher of Śākya-muni.
कालापक: कालापक, अस्, इका, अम्, belonging to the pupils of Kalāpin; (अम्), n. an assemblage of pupils of Kalāpin; N. of a grammar.
कालाम: कालाम कालाम, अस्, m. an epithet of Ārāḍa, the teacher of Śākya-muni; [cf. कालाप।]
कालामुख: कालामुख कालामुख, अस्, m. (fr. काल-मुख?), N. of a Śaiva sect.
कालायनि: कालायनि कालायनि, इस्, m., N. of a pupil of Bāṣkali.
कालायनी: कालायनी कालायनी, f. (fr. कला), an epithet of Durgā.
कालिङ्ग: कालिङ्ग कालिङ्ग, अस्, m. (fr. कलिङ्ग), a prince of the Kaliṅgas; (pl.) the Kaliṅgas; an ele-phant; a snake; a species of cucumber, Cucumis Usitatissimus; a poisonous plant; a sort of iron; (ई), f. a princess of the Kaliṅgas; a kind of gourd or cucumber; N. of a river; (अम्), n. the water-melon; (अस्, ई, अम्), produced in or belonging to the Ka-liṅga country.
कालिङ्गक: कालिङ्गक, अस्, m. a prince of the Kaliṅgas.
कालिङ्गिका: कालिङ्गिका, f. the plant Ipomœa Turpethum.
कालिञ्जर: कालिञ्जर कालिञ्जर, अस्, m., N. of a moun-tain; [cf. कालञ्जर।]
कालिदास: कालिदास कालिदास, अस्, m. (fr. काली, the goddess Durgā, and दास, a slave, the final of काली being shortened), N. of a celebrated poet, supposed to be the author of the Śakuntalā, Vikramorvaśī, Mālavikāgnimitra, the Megha-dūta, Raghu-vaṃśa, Nalodaya, and other poems; also of the Śruta-bodha; he was one of the nine poets or gems of Vikra-māditya's court, and is supposed to have flourished in the century preceding the Christian era; the name is however applied to more persons than one, and seems, in some measure, to have been used as an honorary title; the works attributed to this author are amongst the most elegant compositions in the Sanskrit language.
कालिन्द: कालिन्द कालिन्द, अम्, n. the water-melon; (ई), f. a sort of vessel; N. of a plant [cf. कालिङ्गिका]; N. of a wife of Kṛṣṇa; N. of the wife of Asita and mother of Sagara; an epithet of the river Ya-munā; (अस्, ई, अम्), connected with the river Yamunā, coming from this river; [cf. कलिन्द।] —कालिन्दी-कर्षण, अस्, m. an epithet of Bala-rāma, this hero having diverted the stream Yamunā into a new and devious channel, marked out by his ploughshare. —कालिन्दी-भेदन, अस्, m. an epithet of Bala-rāma; [cf. the preceding.] —कालिन्दी-सू, ऊस्, m. the father of the Yamunā, an epithet of Sūrya; (ऊस्), f. the mother of Yamunā, an epithet of one of the wives of Sūrya. —कालिन्दी-सोदर, अस्, m. the brother of the Yamunā, an epithet of Yama.
कालिम्मन्या: कालिम्मन्या कालिम्-मन्या, f. (कालिम् instead of कालीम्), thinking one's self to be Kālī, regarding one's self as Kālī.
कालीक: कालीक कालीक, अस्, m. a heron; [cf. 1. कालिक।]
कालीची: कालीची कालीची, f. (fr. 2. काल and अञ्च्?), the judgment-hall of Yama, regent or judge of the dead.
कालुष्य: कालुष्य कालुष्य, अम्, n. (fr. कलुष), foul-ness, dirtiness, filth, turbidness, opacity; disturbance or interruption of harmony, disagreement.
कालेश्वर: कालेश्वर कालेश्वर, कालोत्पादित, &c. See under 1. and 2. काल।
कालोदायिन्: कालोदायिन् कालोदायिन् ई, m., N. of a pupil of Śākya-muni; (the right reading is perhaps कालो-दयिन्।)
काल्प: काल्प काल्प, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कल्प), preceptive, ritual; relating to a Kalpa or period so called; (अस्), m. the plant Curcuma Zerumbet.
काल्पक: काल्पक, अस्, m. the same plant; [cf. also काल्-यक।]
काल्पनिक: काल्पनिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कल्पना), existing only in fancy; fictitious, invented; counterfeit, hypo-critical, artificial, fabricated. —काल्पनिक-ता, f. con-trivance, hypocrisy, forgery.
काल्पसूत्र: काल्पसूत्र, अस्, m. (fr. कल्प-सूत्र), one who is familiar with the Kalpasūtras.
काल्याणिनेय: काल्याणिनेय काल्याणिनेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कल्-याणी), sprung from a virtuous or fortunate woman; (अस्), m. the son of such a woman.
काल्वालीकृत: काल्वालीकृत काल्वाली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. made bald (?); [cf. Lat. calvus.]
काव: काव काव, अम्, n. (fr. कवि), N. of a Sāman.
कावचिक: कावचिक कावचिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कवच), relating to armour, armorial; (अम्), n. a multitude of men in armour.
कावट: कावट कावट, अम्, n., N. of a district con-taining 100 Grāmas; [cf. कर्वट।]
कावटिका: कावटिका, f. a district of 200 Grāmas.
कावरुक: कावरुक कावरुक, अस्, ई, अम्, fearful; hen-pecked; (अस्), m. an owl; (a wrong form for काक-रुक or काकरूक ?).
कावष: कावष कावष, अम्, n. (fr. कवष), N. of a Sāman.
कावषेय: कावषेय, अस्, m. a patronymic of Tura in the Brāhmaṇas.
कावार: कावार कावार (का-आव्°), अम्, n. the aquatic plant Vallisneria; (ई), f. an umbrella or chhattar, especially one without a stick and worn like a broad-brimmed hat.
काविराज्: काविराज् का-विराज्, ट्, f. a metre consisting of 9 + 12 + 9 syllables.
कावृक: कावृक का-वृक, अस्, m., N. of several birds; a gallinaceous fowl (= कुक्कुट, कृकवाकु); the ruddy goose, Anas Casaca (= कोक); a small singing bird, Loxia Philippensis.
कावेर: कावेर कावेर, अम्, n. saffron, Crocus Sa-tivus; (ई), f. turmeric; a courtezan, a harlot; N. of a river in the Dekhan (according to a legend in the Hari-vaṃśa, a daughter of Yuvanāśva and wife of Jahnu, who by her father's curse was changed from one half of the Gaṅgā into the river Kāverī, therefore also called Ardha-gaṅgā or Ardha-jāhnavī).
कावेरक: कावेरक, अस्, m. a patronymic of Rajata-nābhi.
कावेरिका: कावेरिका, f., N. of a river, = कावेरी।
काव्य: काव्य काव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. कवि), endowed with the qualities of a sage or poet, descended or coming from a sage; prophetic, inspired, poetical; a particular order of manes; a patronymic of Uśanas; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of Kavi; (आ), f. understanding, intelligence; a female fiend [cf. पूतना]; (अम्), n. wisdom, intelligence; prophetic inspiration; high power and art; intellect, knowledge (often used in pl.); a poem, poetical composition, a work of poetic art; term for the first tetrastich in the metre Ṣaṭ-pada; happiness, welfare. —काव्य-कल्प-लता, f. title of a work on artificial poems. —काव्यकल्प-लता-वृत्ति, इस्, f. a commentary by Amara-candra on the last work. —काव्यकल्पलतावृत्ति-परिमल, a commentary on the preceding work. —काव्य-काम-धेनु, उस्, f. title of a commentary by Vopa-deva on his work called Kavi-kalpadruma. —काव्य-चन्द्रिका, f. title of a work on artificial poems by Kavi-candra; another work on the same subject by Nyāyavāgīśa. —काव्य-चौर, अस्, m. a robber of other poems, a plagiarist. —काव्य-ता, f. or काव्य-त्व, अम्, n. the condition of a poetical composition. —काव्य-देवी, f., N. of a princess, who erected a statue of Śiva, called Kāvyadevīśvara. —काव्य-प्र-काश or काव्य-प्रदीप, अस्, m. title of a work on artificial poems by Mammaṭa. —काव्य-मीमांसक, अस्, m. a poetaster, a rhetorician. —काव्य-रसिक, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has a taste for poetical composi-tions. —काव्य-राक्षस, अम्, n. title of an artificial poem. —काव्य-शास्त्र, अम्, n. title of a small work on poetics. —काव्य-सुधा, f. title of a commentary on a work on artificial poems. —काव्य-हास्य, अम्, n. a farce. —काव्यादर्श (°य-आद्°), अस्, m. a work on poetics by Daṇḍin. —काव्यालङ्कार-वृत्ति, इस्, f. a work on poetics by Vāmana. —काव्याष्टक (°य-अष्°), अम्, n. title of a work of Sūrya.
काश्: काश् काश्, cl. 1. and 4. A. काशते and काश्यते, चकाशे or काशामास, काशिष्-यते, अकाशिष्ट, काशितुम्, to be visible, appear; to shine, be brilliant, have an agreeable appearance: Caus. काशयति, -यितुम्: Desid. चिकाशिषते: Intens. चाकशीति and चाकाश्यते, to shine brightly; to see clearly, survey; [cf. कास्।]
काश: 1. काश, अस्, m. the becoming visible, appearance; splendor; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a species of grass, Saccha-rum Spontaneum, used for mats, roofs, &c.; also personified, together with the Kuśa grass, as one of Yama's attendants; (अस्), m., N. of a man; a son of Sunahotra; also of another Sunahotra, the father of Kāśi-rāja. —काश-कृत्स्न, अस्, m., N. of a gram-marian; also of a philosopher. —काशकृत्स्नि, इस्, m. (a patronymic from the preceding), N. of a teacher. —काश-पौण्ड्र, आस्, m. pl., N. of a peo-ple. —काश-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of the grass Saccharum Spontaneum.
काश 2. काश, अस्, m. (wrongly spelt for कास), cough, catarrh, irritation of the throat, sneez-ing. —काश-मर्द, अस्, m. wrongly spelt for कास-मर्द, q. v.
काशक: काशक, अस्, m. a species of grass, Saccharum Spontaneum; N. of a man, = काश।
काशिन्: 1. काशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of compounds) shining, appearing, having the semblance of any-thing, e. g. जित-काशिन्, one who appears as a con-queror or behaves like one; (ई), m., N. of a man, a son of Brahman Kavi (Mahā-bh. XIII. 4150).
2. काशिन्, ई, इनी, इ (wrongly spelt for कासिन्), having a cold or cough.
काशिल: काशिल, अस्, आ, अम्, made of Kāśa grass, abounding in it.
काशिष्णु: काशिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, shining, brilliant.
काशपरी: काशपरी काशपरी, f., N. of a region (?).
काशफरी: काशफरी, f., N. of a region (?); (a various reading has काशफारी।)
काशब्द: काशब्द का-शब्द, अस्, m. the noise का।
काशाल्मलि: काशाल्मलि का-शाल्मलि, इस्, f. a kind of silk-cotton tree, Bombax Heptaphyllum.
काशि: काशि काशि, इस्, m. the clenched hand, the fist; a handful; the sun (in this sense fr. rt. काश्); (अयस्), m. pl., N. of the people of Kāśi; N. of the an-cestors of the kings of Kāśi, of the family of Bharata; (इस्), m., N. of a son of Suhotra and grandfather of Dhanvantari; also N. of a son of Kāśya and grandson of Suhotra; (अयस्), m. pl. the descendants of this man; (इस् or ई), f. a celebrated city and place of pilgrimage, the modern Benares; (ई), f., N. of the wife of Sudeva and mother of Supārśva. —काशि-कन्या, f. the virgin of Kāśi, daughter of the king of Kāśi. —काशि-खण्ड, a section of the Skanda-purāṇa. —काशि-नगर, अम्, n. the city of the Kāśis, i. e. Benares. —काशि-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of several men. —काशि-प, अस्, m. a sovereign of the Kāśis. —काशि-पति, इस्, m. the ruler of the Kāśis, epithet of Divodāsa Dhanvantari, a king of Benares, author of certain medical works and teacher of the Āyur-veda; he is often confounded with his celestial namesake, the physician of the gods. —काशि-पुरी, f. the city of the Kāśis, i. e. Benares. —काशि-राज, अस्, m. a king of the Kāśis, identified with the Dānava Dīrghajihva; epithet of Divodāsa Dhanvantari; also of a grand-father of Dhanvantari. —काशि-राजन्, आ, m. = the preceding. —काशि-राम, अस्, m., N. of the author of a commentary on the Tithi-tattva and several other works. —काशि-विलास or काशी-विलास, अस्, m. title of a work written in Sanskrit and in one of the modern dialects. —काशी-खण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. title of a section of the Skanda-purāṇa, treating of Benares. —काशी-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘a lord or master of Benares;’ an epithet of Śiva; N. of several men. —काशी-माहात्म्य, अम्, n. a section of the Brahma-vaivarta-purāṇa. —काशी-राज, अस्, m. = काशि-राज, an epithet of Divodāsa. —काशी-विलास, अस्, m. = काशि-विलास. —काशीश (°शी-ईश), अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva; an epithet of Divodāsa or any king of Benares; (अम्), n. sulphate of iron. —काशीश्वर (°शि-ईश्°), अस्, m. a prince of the Kāśis or a sovereign of Benares; N. of a grammarian; काशीश्वरी, f. title of a grammar com-posed by Kaśīśvara (?); काशीश्वरी-गण, title of a trea-tise on grammar. —काशी-सेतु, उस्, m. title of a work.
काशिक: काशिक, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आ), f., scil. पुरी, the city of the Kāśis, i. e. Benares; काशिका वृत्तिः or only काशिका, f. ‘the commentary composed or used in Kāśi or Benares,’ title of a commentary on Pāṇini's grammar by Vāmana Jayāditya. —काशिक-सूक्ष्म, अम्, n. fine cotton from Kāśi. —काशिका-तिलक, N. of a poem by Nīla-kaṇṭha. —काशिका-प्रिय, अस्, m. an epithet of king Divodāsa, who was king of Benares.
काशेय: काशेय, a patronymic from Kāśi; (ई), f. a daughter of the king of the Kāśis.
काश्य: 1. काश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the race or tribe of the Kāśis, a prince of Kāśi; (अस्), m., N. of the father of Kāśyapa and ancestor of Kāśirāja Dhan-vantari; also of a son of Suhotra, and of Senā-jit; (आ), f. the daughter of a king of Kāśi.
काश्य 2. काश्य, अम्, n. = कश्य, a spirituous liquor.
काश्यक: काश्यक, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the race or tribe of the Kāśis.
काशीत: काशीत काशीत, अम्, n., N. of a verse of the Sāma-veda.
काशूकार: काशूकार काशूकार, अस्, m. the Areca or betel-nut tree; (perhaps a wrong reading for कासू-कार।)
काश्मरी: काश्मरी काश्मरी, f. or काश्मर्य, अस्, m. the plant Gmelina Arborea, commonly called Gam-bhārī; [cf. also कार्श्मरी and कार्ष्मर्य।]
काश्मीर: काश्मीर काश्मीर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कश्मीर), born in or coming from Kaśmīra; (अस्), m. a king of Kaśmīra; (आस्), m. pl. the inhabitants of Kaśmīra; the country Kaśmīra, also in sing.; (आ), f. a sort of grape; (ई), f. the tree Ficus Elastica; (अम्), n. the tuberous root of the plant Costus Speciosus; saffron; (= टङ्क।) — काश्मीर-ज, अम्, n. saffron; a sort of drug; the tuberous root of the plant Costus Speciosus; (आ), f., N. of a plant, Atis or Betula, = अति-विषा. —काश्मीर-जन्मन्, अ, n. saffron.
काश्मीरक: काश्मीरक, अस्, ई, अम्, born or produced in Kaśmīra, relating to Kaśmīra; (आस्), m. pl. the inhabitants of Kaśmīra.
काश्मीरिक: काश्मीरिक, अस्, ई, अम्, born or produced in Kāśmīra; काश्मीरिक-निवास, अस्, m. the residence of the Kaśmīras.
काश्यप: काश्यप काश्यप, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कश्यप), belonging to Kaśyapa, relating to or connected with him (e. g. काश्यपी देवी or only काश्यपी, the earth); (अस्), m. a patronymic from Kaśyapa; N. of an old grammarian; an epithet of Aruṇa; a sort of deer; a fish; (अम्), n. flesh; (ई), f. the earth; (according to a legend of the Purāṇas, Paraśu-rāma, after the destruction of the Kṣatriya race and the performance of an Aśva-medha sacrifice, presented the sovereignty of the world to Kāśyapa.) —काश्यप-नन्दन, आस्, m. pl. the children of Kāśyapa, epithet of the gods. —काश्यपी-बालाक्या-माठरी-पुत्र, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.
काश्यपि: काश्यपि, इस्, m. (a patronymic fr. काश्यप), an epithet of Aruṇa, the charioteer of the sun; also of Garuḍa, the bird of Viṣṇu.
काश्यपिन्: काश्यपिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a school called after Kāśyapa.
काश्यपीय: काश्यपीय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a Buddhist school called after Kāśyapa.
काश्यपेय: काश्यपेय, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. कश्यप), an epithet of the twelve Ādityas; also of the sun; and of Garuḍa, the bird of Viṣṇu.
काश्वरी: काश्वरी काश्वरी, f. the plant Gmelina Ar-borea, = काश्मरी।
काष: काष काष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कष्), rubbing; that against which anything is rubbed.
काषाय: काषाय काषाय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कषाय), red, dyed of a reddish colour; a red cloth or garment; (ई), f. (with मक्षिका) a sort of fly or wasp. —काषाय-ग्रहण, अस्, m., N. of a Caitya, q. v. —काषाय-वसन, अस्, आ, अम्, having a dark or brown garment. —काषाय-वासिक, अस्, m. a kind of poisonous insect.
काषायण: काषायण, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. कषाय or काषाय), N. of a teacher.
काषायिन्: काषायिन्, इणस्, m. pl., N. of a school called from Kaṣāya.
काष्ठ: काष्ठ काष्ठ, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. काश्; cf. काष्ठा next col.), N. of one of Kuvera's attendants; (अम्), n. a piece of wood or timber, a stick; wood or timber in general; an instrument for measuring lengths; a kind of measure; (metaphorically) a mere stick, a lanky thin man. At the beginning of a compound and before a simple verb काष्ठ may express excellence or superiority; [cf. Cambro-Brit. coed; Brit. coat; Gr. ξύ-λον.] —काष्ठ-कदली, f. the wild plantain, Musa Sapientum, (the fruit of this plant being hard and woody.) —काष्ठ-कीट, अस्, m. a small insect or worm found in decayed wood. —काष्ठ-कुट्ट or काष्ठ-कूट, अस्, m. a bird, a sort of woodpecker, Picus Bengalensis. —काष्ठ-कुद्दाल, अस्, m. a kind of wooden shovel or scraper used for baling water out of a boat, or for scraping and cleaning its bottom; also written °कुदाल or °कूद्दाल. —काष्ठ-खण्ड, अम्, n. a stick, a spar, a piece of wood. —काष्ठ-घटित, अस्, आ, अम्, formed of wood, wooden. —काष्ठ-जम्बू, ऊस्, f., N. of a tree, = भूमि-जम्बू. —काष्ठ-तक्ष्, ट्, m. or काष्ठ-तक्षक, अस्, m. a carpen-ter. —काष्ठ-तन्तु, उस्, m. a caterpillar which secretes itself in wood and there passes into a chrysalis; a small worm found in timber. —काष्ठ-दारु, उस्, m. the tree Pinus Deodora. —काष्ठ-द्रु, उस्, m. the tree Butea Frondosa. —काष्ठ-धात्री-फल, अम्, n. the fruit of the plant Emblica Officinalis. —काष्ठ-पाटला, f., N. of a plant (सित-पाटलिका). —काष्ठ-पाषाण-वासस्, आंसि, n. pl. wood, stone, and clothes. —काष्ठ-पुत्त-लिका, f. a wooden image. —काष्ठ-प्रदान, अम्, n. piling up wood, forming a funeral pile. —का-ष्ठ-भार, अस्, m. a particular weight of wood. —काष्ठभारिक, अस्, m. a wood-carrier; a bearer of wood. —काष्ठ-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has become wood, or who is like a piece of wood; epithet of an ascetic, who stands without stirring; (अस्), m., N. of a divine being. —काष्ठ-भृत्, see under काष्ठा. —काष्ठ-मठी, f. a funeral pile. —का-ष्ठ-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of wood, wooden, consisting of pieces of wood. —काष्ठ-मल्ल, अस्, m. a bier, a plank &c. on which dead bodies are carried. —काष्ठ-रज्जु, उस्, m. or f. (?), a rope for binding together pieces of wood. —काष्ठ-लेखक, अस्, m. a small worm found in wood. —काष्ठ-लोहिन्, ई, m. a club, a short cudgel, especially if armed with iron. —काष्ठ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having wood for fuel &c.; (वत्), ind. like a piece of wood, like a stick or stock, standing petrified with fear &c. —काष्ठ-वल्लिका, f., N. of a plant, = कटुका. —काष्ठ-वाट, अस् or अम्, m. or n. किम्: किम् किम्, ind. (originally nom. and acc. sing. n. of 2. क, q. v.), how? whence? wherefore? why?

किम् is much used as a particle of interrogation like the Lat. num, an, sometimes translateable by ‘whe-ther?’ but oftener serving only like a note of interro-gation to mark a question (e. g. किं व्याधा वने ऽस्मिन् सञ्चरन्ति, do hunters roam about in this wood ? In an interrogation the verb if uncom-pounded with a preposition generally retains its accent after किम्). To this sense may be referred the किम् expressing blame, deficiency, &c., at the beginning of compounds (e. g. किं-राजन्, what sort of a king? i. e. a bad king); also the किम् prefixed to verbs with a similar meaning (e. g. किम्-अधीते, he reads badly). किम् — उत or किम् — उतवा or किम् — उत — उत or किम् — अथवा — उत, whether — or — or; [cf. उत।]

किम् is very frequently connected with other parti-cles, as follows: किम् अङ्ग, wherefore then? अथ किम्, how else? surely; किम् अपि, somewhat, to a considerable extent, rather, much more, still further; किम् इति, why ? (see इति); किमु or किमुत, how much more ? how much less? किं किल, what a pity! (expressing dissatisfaction); किञ्च, moreover, further; किञ्-चन (originally negative = ‘in no way’), to a certain degree, a little; किञ्चित्, somewhat, a little; किं तर्हि, how then ? but, however; किन्तु, but, however, nevertheless (bearing the same relation to तु that किञ्च bears to च); किन्-नु, whether indeed? (a stronger interrogative than किम् alone); how much more? how much less? किन् नु खलु, how possibly? (a still stronger interrogative); किम् पुनर्, how much more ? how much less? किं वा, whether? or whether ? or, (often a mere particle of interroga-tion); किं स्वित्, whether ? how? (a mere particle of interrogation like the last).

कीकि: कीकि कीकि, इस्, m. a blue jay; [cf. किकि।]
कीचक: कीचक कीचक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. चीक्), a hollow bamboo; a bamboo whistling or rattling in the wind, Arundo Karka, a reed; a kind of tree; N. of a people, a tribe of the Kekayas, (a Kīcaka is chief of the army of king Virāṭa, and is conquered by Bhīma-sena); N. of a Daitya or demon; a certain Rākṣasa or goblin. —कीचक-जित्, त्, or कीचक-निसूदन, अस्, or कीचक-भिद्, त्, m. an epithet of Bhīma-sena, conqueror of Kīcaka. —कीचक-बध, अस्, m. ‘the killing of Kīcaka,’ title of a poem.
कीज: कीज कीज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. wonderful.
कीट्: कीट् कीट्, cl. 10. P. कीटयति, -यितुम्, to tinge or colour; to bind.
कीट: कीट कीट, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. a worm, an insect; an expression of contempt, e. g. पक्षि-कीट, a miserable bird; [cf. Gr. κίς.] —कीट-घ्न, अस्, m. sulphur (‘destroying insects’). —कीट-ज, अम्, n. silk; (आ), f. lac, an animal dye of a red colour. —कीट-पक्षोद्भव (°ष-उद्°), अस्, m. the change from the chrysalis or larva to the butterfly. —कीट-पादिका, f. the plant Cissus Pedata. —कीट-मणि, इस्, m. a butterfly. —कीट-माता, f. the plant Cissus Pedata. —कीट-शत्रु, उस्, m. (?) and कीटारि (°ट-अरि), इस्, m. (?) a species of plant.
कीटक: कीटक, अस्, m. a worm, an insect; a kind of bard (मागध-जाति), a panegyrist, descended from a Kṣatriya father and Vaiśya mother; N. of a prince; (अस्, आ, अम्), hard, harsh, unfeeling.
कीडेर: कीडेर कीडेर, अस्, m. the plant Amaranthus Polygamus.
कीदृक्ष: कीदृक्ष कीदृक्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. कि or किद् and दृक्ष, rt. दृश्, see ईदृक्ष), of what kind? of what sort? of what description? of what qualities? who or what like?
कीदृश्: कीदृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. ङ्, of what kind? of what sort? &c., who or what like? यादृक्-कीदृक्-च, of what-soever kind or sort. —कीदृग्-व्यापारवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, of what profession or vocation?
कीदृश: कीदृश, अस्, ई, अम्, of what kind? what like? [cf. Slav. ko-lik, Them. ko-liko; Gr. πη-λίκος; Goth. hvê-leiks, Them. hvê-leika; Mod. Germ. we-lcher; Lat. quâ-lis.]
कीन: कीन कीन, अम्, n. flesh; [cf. कीर।]
कीनार: कीनार कीनार, अस्, m., Ved. = कीनाश (?), a cultivator of the soil; (Sāy.) a vile man.
कीनाश: कीनाश कीनाश, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. क्लिश्; according to others fr. किम् and नाश), a labourer or cultivator of the soil; the poverty of this class of men in India was proverbial, so that कीनाश meant sometimes ‘a very poor man;’ according to native lexicographers कीनाश may be an adj. and has the following meanings, cultivating the soil; poor; covetous, niggardly; small, little, killing animals or killing secretly; (अस्), m. a kind of monkey [cf. कीश]; an epithet of Yama; a kind of Rākṣasa.
कीम्: कीम् कीम्, ind. a particle in आकीम् and मा-कीम्, q. v.
कीर: कीर कीर, अस्, m. a parrot; the country and (pl.) the people of Kāśmīra; (अम्), n. flesh; [cf. कीन।] —कीर-वर्णक, अम्, n. a kind of perfume (स्थौणेयक). —कीरेष्ट (°र-इष्°), अस्, m., N. of several plants; the tree Mangifera Indica; a species of mountain Pīlū Ākhoṭa; another plant, = जल-मधूक।
कीरक: कीरक कीरक, अस्, m. gaining, obtaining; a Buddha; a kind of tree.
कीरि: कीरि कीरि, इस्, m. (fr. 2. कृ), Ved. grateful or laudatory mention or remembrance; a poem, hymn, praise; one who praises, a poet. —कीरि-चोदन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. exciting praise, exciting the praiser.
कीर्ण: कीर्ण कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. कॄ), scattered, thrown, cast; covered, secret, hidden; injured, hurt; full.
कीर्ण, कीर्णि, &c. See s. v. at p. 231.
कीर्णि: कीर्णि, इस्, f. scattering, throwing; covering, con-cealing.
कीर्य: कीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, what is scattered.
कीर्यमाण: कीर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being covered, bestrewed; being scattered; being thrown at.
कीर्तन: कीर्तन, कीर्ति, &c. See under rt. कॄत्।
कीर्तन, अम्, n. mentioning, repeating, saying, telling, celebrating, praising; (आ), f. fame, glory.
कीर्मी: कीर्मी कीर्मी, f. a house for straw (?).
कीर्शा: कीर्शा कीर्शा, f., Ved. a species of bird.
कील्: कील् कील्, cl. 1. or 10. P. कीलति, कीलयति, -यितुम्, to bind; to fasten; to stake; to pin.
कील: कील, अस्, आ, m. f. a sharp piece of wood, a stake, a pin, a peg, a bolt, a wedge, &c.; a lance, a pike; a post, a post in a cow-house to which cows are fas-tened, a pillar; a weapon; the elbow; a blow or punch with the elbow; a blow, a thump; a blow in copulation; flame, lambent flame; a small or minute particle; a gnomon; a position of the fœtus impeding delivery; an epithet of Śiva. —कील-संस्पर्श, अस्, m., N. of a plant, commonly Gāva, = Diospyros Glu-tinosa, a plant, the fruit of which yields a substance like turpentine used to cover the bottom of boats.
कीलक: कीलक, अस्, m. a pin, a bolt, a wedge; a splint for confining a broken bone; a fence; also = शिवक, a pillar for cows &c. to rub themselves against, or one to which they are tied.
कीलिका: कीलिका, f. the pin of an axle.
कीलित: कीलित, अस्, आ, अम्, staked, impaled; set up as a stake or pole; pierced, transfixed; pinned, fastened by a stake &c.; bound, tied, confined.
कीलाल: कीलाल कीलाल, अस्, m. a sweet beverage; also a heavenly drink similar to Amṛta, the food of the gods; honey; (अम्), n. blood; water. —कीलाल-ज, अम्, n. flesh. —कीलाल-धि, इस्, m. the ocean. —कीलाल-प, अस्, आ, अम्, drinking blood; (अस्), m. a Rākṣasa, a sort of goblin or imp. —कीलाल-पा, आस्, m., Ved. an epithet of Agni, ‘drinking the beve-rage Kīlāla;’ (आस्), m. an attendant of Yama, or N. of one of the attendants of Yama. —कीलालोधन् (°ल-ऊधन्), आ, ध्नी, अ, Ved. carrying the beverage Kīlāla in one's udder.
कीवत्: कीवत् कीवत्, आन्, अती, अत् (fr. 1. कि; cf. कियत्), Ved. how much? how long?
कीश: कीश कीश, अस्, आ, अम्, naked; (अस्, ई), m. f. an ape, a monkey; a bird; the sun. —कीश-पर्ण, अस्, m. the tree Achyranthes Aspera (अपामार्ग); [cf. केश-पर्णी।]
कीस्त: कीस्त कीस्त, अस्, m., Ved. one who praises, a singer, a poet; (related to कीर्ति?).
कु: कु 1. कु, a pronominal base appearing in कुतस्, कुत्र, कुविद्, कुह, क्व, and as a prefix im-plying deterioration, depreciation, deficiency, want, diminution, littleness, prevention, hindrance, reproach, contempt, sin, guilt; originally perhaps कु signified how (strange!); (as a separate word कु occurs in the Vedas in the sense of ‘where?’ कु चिद्, wherever, anywhere); [cf. कु-कथा, कु-कर, &c.]
कु 2. कु, उस्, f. the earth; the ground or base of a triangle or other plane figure. —कु-कील, अस्, m. a mountain (‘a pin or bolt of the earth’).

कु 3. कु, cl. 2. P. or cl. 1. A., Ved. कौति or कवीति, कवते, चुकाव, चुकुवे, कोतुम् or कवीतुम् (?), to sound; to sound indistinctly; to cry, moan, groan; to cry as a bird, to coo, hum as a bee &c.: Caus. कावयति: Desid. चुकूषति, -ते: Intens. चोकूयते and कोकूयते, to cry aloud.

कु 4. कु or कू, cl. 6. A. कुवते, चुकुवे, कुतुम् or कुवितुम्: Intens. चोकूयते, to cry, make a noise; to moan or groan; [cf. Hib. caoi, caoidh, ‘lamentation, mourning;’ caoidhim, ‘I la-ment, mourn, grieve.’]
कुंश्: कुंश् कुंश् or कुंस्, cl. 1. or 10. P. कुंशति, कुंशयति, or कुंसति, कुंसयति, -यितुम्, to speak; to shine.
कुक्: कुक् कुक्, cl. 1. A. कोकते, चुकुके, कोकितुम्, to take, accept, seize: Desid. चुकोकिषते or चुकुकिषते।
कुक: कुक, अस्, आ, अम्, taking, accepting.
कुकथा: कुकथा कु-कथा, f. a bad, miserable tale.
कुकभ: कुकभ कुकभ, अम्, n. a kind of spirituous liquor.
कुकर: कुकर कु-कर, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कु) , having a crooked or withered arm; acting wickedly, wicked.
कुकर्मन्: कुकर्मन् कु-कर्मन्, अ, n. (see 1. कु), a wicked deed; wickedness, depravity, villainy; (आ, आ, अ), performing evil actions, wicked, depraved. —कु-कर्म-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wicked, depraved.
कुकार्य: कु-कार्य, अम्, n. a bad action, sin, wickedness.
कुकीर्ति: कुकीर्त्ति कु-कीर्त्ति, इस्, f. (see 1. कु), ill-re-pute, notoriety.
कुकीर्त्ति: कुकीर्त्ति कु-कीर्त्ति, इस्, f. (see 1. कु), ill-re-pute, notoriety.
कुकुट: कुकुट कुकुट, अस्, m., N. of a pot-herb, = सितावर, commonly सुषणिशाक, Marsilea Quadri-folia.
कुकुटुम्बिनी: कुकुटुम्बिनी कु-कुटुम्बिनी, f. a bad house-wife.
कुकुद: कुकुद कुकुद, अस्, m. one who gives away a girl in marriage after decoration with fit ornaments and the prescribed ceremonies; also कूकुद, q. v.
कुकुन्दर: कुकुन्दर कुकुन्दर or कुकुन्दुर, अम्, n., or ए, du. n. the cavities of the loins just above the hips [cf. ककुन्दर]; (अस्), m., N. of a plant, = कुक्कुर-द्रु, q. v.
कुकुन्ध: कुकुन्ध कुकुन्ध, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a kind of evil spirit.
कुकुभा: कुकुभा कुकुभा, f. one of the female per-sonifications of music or Rāgiṇīs.
कुकुर: कुकुर कुकुर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कुक्), a dog; N. of a plant and perfume, = ग्रन्थि-पर्णी; N. of a prince, a son of Andhaka; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of this prince; N. of a people, a branch of the Yadu race or Yādavas; the country of this people; [cf. कुक्कुर and कौकुर।] —कुकुर-जिह्वा, f. a species of fish, Acheiris Kookor Zibha; the plant Leea Staphylea; another plant, Ixora Undulata. —कुकुराधिनाथ (°र-अध्°), अस्, m. lord of the Yādavas, an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
कुकूटी: कुकूटी कुकूटी, f. the plant Salmalia Mala-barica; [cf. शाल्मलि।]
कुकूणक: कुकूणक कुकूणक, अस्, m. a kind of disease of the eyes in infants.
कुकूनन: कुकूनन कुकूनन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (an onomatopoetic word), gargling.
कुकूरभ: कुकूरभ कुकूरभ, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of evil spirit.
कुकूल: कुकूल कुकूल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. chaff, conflagration of chaff, a fire made of chaff; (अम्), n. a hole filled with stakes; armour, mail.
कुकृत्य: कुकृत्य कु-कृत्य, अम्, n. (see 1. कु), an evil deed, evil, wickedness.
कुकोल: कुकोल कुकोल, अम्, n. the jujube, Zizyphus Jujuba; [cf. कोलि।]
कुक्कुट: कुक्कुट कुक्कुट, अस्, m. a cock, a wild cock; a whisp of lighted straw or grass, a firebrand, a spark of fire; the offspring of a Niṣāda by a Śūdra woman or woman of the fourth caste; (इस् or ई), f. hypocrisy, interested observance of religious duties; (ई), f. a hen; a small house-lizard; the silk-cotton tree, Bombax Heptaphyllum, or the red cotton tree, Sal-malia Malabarica. —कुक्कुट-कन्थ, अम्, n., N. of a town. —कुक्कुट-ध्वनि, इस्, m. the crowing of a cock, the cackling of fowls. —कुक्कुट-पक्षक, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), a knife shaped like the wing of a cock. —कुक्कुट-पाद, अस्, m., N. of a mountain (cock-foot). —कुक्कुट-मण्डप, अस्, m., N. of a sanctuary in Benares standing on the right side of a statue of Śiva, a place where final emancipation may be attained; [cf. मुक्ति-मण्ड-प।] —कुक्कुट-मस्तक, अस्, m. a sort of pepper, Piper Chaba. —कुक्कुट-व्रत, अम्, n. a religious observance (worship of Śiva) on the seventh of the light fortnight of the month Bhādra, by women, especially for the sake of obtaining offspring. —कुक्-कुट-शिख, अस्, m. safflower, Carthamus Tinctorius (cockscomb). —कुक्कुटा-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a moun-tain. —कुक्कुटाण्ड (°ट-अण्°), अम्, n. a fowl's egg. —कुक्कुटाण्डक, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), a species of rice. —कुक्कुटाभ (°ट-आभा), अस्, m. a kind of snake compared to a fowl (perhaps from having a crest or comb). —कुक्कुटाराम (°ट-आर्°), अस्, m., N. of a grove; N. of a celebrated hermitage near Gayā. —कुक्कुटार्म (°ट-अर्°), अम्, n., N. of a place. —कुक्कुटासन (°ट-आस्°), अम्, n. a particular posture of an ascetic in religious medita-tion. —कुक्कुटाहि (°ट-अहि), इस्, m. = कुक्कुटाभ above. —कुक्कुटी-व्रत, अम्, n. a ceremony in honour of Śiva and Durgā; see कुक्कुट-व्रत।
कुक्कुटक: कुक्कुटक, अस्, m. a cock, a wild cock; a man of a mixed caste, one sprung from a Śūdra and a Niṣāda woman.
कुक्कुभ: कुक्कुभ कुक्कुभ, अस्, m. a wild cock, Pha-sianus Gallus; varnish, oily gloss.
कुक्कुर: कुक्कुर कुक्कुर, अस्, m. (a more modern form for कुकुर), a dog; N. of a Muni; also of a prince, a son of Andhaka; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (ई), f. a bitch; (अम्), n. a vegetable perfume; [cf. ग्रन्थि-पर्ण।] —कुक्कुर-द्रु, उस्, m., N. of a plant, = ताम्र-चूड।
कुक्कुवाच्: कुक्कुवाच् कुक्कु-वाच्, क्, m. (fr. कुक्कु, an onomatopoetic word, and वाच्), a kind of deer, = सारङ्ग-मृग।
कुक्रिया: कुक्रिया कु-क्रिया, f. (see 1. कु), a bad action; (अस्, आ, अम्), wicked, sinful.
कुक्ष: कुक्ष कुक्ष, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कुष्), the belly.
कुक्षि: कुक्षि, इस्, m. the belly, the cavity of the abdomen (in the earlier language generally used in dual); the interior of anything; the womb, the part of the belly containing the fœtus; a cavity in general (e. g. अद्रि-कुक्षि, cavity of a mountain); the cavity of the ocean, i. e. a bay, a gulf; a cavern; N. of a son (f. also of a daughter?) of Priya-vrata and Kāmyā; N. of Bali; of a king; of a son of Ikṣvāku and father of Vikukṣi; N. of a region; according to a native lexicographer कुक्षि means also the sheath of a sword, and steel; [cf. Lat. coxa, coxendix; Gr. κοχώνη? Old Germ. bûh; Mod. Germ. Bauch.] —कुक्षिम्-भरि, इस्, इस्, इ, one who nourishes only his belly, filling or pampering the belly, voracious, gluttonous. —कुक्षि-रन्ध्र, अस्, m. a kind of reed. —कुक्षि-शूल, अस्, m. pain in the belly, belly-ache, colic.
कुक्षिल: कुक्षिल, अस्, m., Ved. a species of evil spirit.
कुक्षितकि: कुक्षितकि कुक्षितकि, इस्, m., N. of a man.
कुक्षेयु: कुक्षेयु कुक्षेयु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Raudrāśva; (according to others कक्षेयु।)
कुखाटि: कुखाटि कुखाटि, इस्, f. (said to be fr. rt. खट्), wantonness, dalliance, frolic.
कुख्याति: कुख्याति कु-ख्याति, इस्, f. (see 1. कु), evil report, infamy; a bad reputation, disrepute, disgrace.
कुगणिन्: कुगणिन् कुगणिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. 1. कु + गण), belonging to an evil set of people.
कुगो: कुगो कु-गो, औस्, m. (see 1. कु), a miserable or weak bull.
कुग्रह: कुग्रह कु-ग्रह, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), an un-propitious planet; (five are reckoned by some, viz. Maṅgala, Ravi, Śani, Rāhu, and Ketu.)
कुग्राम: कुग्राम कु-ग्राम, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a petty village without a Rājā, an Agnihotrin, a physician, a rich man, or a river.
कुङ्कुण: कुङ्कुण कुङ्कुण, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a region.
कुङ्कुम: कुङ्कुम कुङ्कुम, अम्, n. saffron, Crocus Sativus, the plant and the pollen of the flowers; [cf. Gr. κρόκος; Lat. crocus?]. —कुङ्कुम-ताम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, red, coppery red. —कुङ्कुम-रेणु, उस्, f. the dust or pollen of saffron. —कुङ्कुमाक्त (°म-अक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, dyed or stained with saffron, orange, yellow. —कुङ्कुमाङ्क (°म-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, marked with saffron, dyed or stained of an orange colour. —कुङ्कुमारुण (°म-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, red, ruddy.
कुङ्गनी: कुङ्गनी कुङ्गनी, f., N. of a plant, = महा-ज्योतिष्मती।
कुच्: कुच् कुच्, cl. 6. 1. P. कुचति, कोचति, चुकोच, कुचितुम् or कोचितुम्, to sound high, to utter a shrill cry (as a bird); to polish; to go; to connect, mix; to bend, make curved or crooked, to be crooked; to oppose, impede; to mark with lines, to delineate, write; to contract or be contracted; to contend (?); [cf. कुञ्च्।]
कुच: कुच, अस्, m. (generally du. कुचौ), the female breast, a teat, a nipple, a pap. —कुच-कुम्भ, अस्, m. the female breast. —कुच-तट, अम्, n. the female breast. —कुचतटाग्र (°ट-अग्°), अम्, n. a nipple. —कुच-फल, अस्, m. the pomegranate (the fruit being shaped like the female breast). —कुच-मुख, अम्, n. a nipple. —कुचाग्र (°च-अग्°), अम्, n. a nipple.
कुचित: कुचित, अस्, आ, अम्, closed, contracted; small, little.
कुचण्डिका: कुचण्डिका कुचण्डिका, f. a plant, Aletris Hyacinthoides, = मूर्वा।
कुचन्दन: कुचन्दन कु-चन्दन, अम्, n. (see 1. कु), red sanders, Pterocarpus Santalinus; sappan or log-wood, Cæsalpina Sappan [cf. पत्त्राङ्ग]; a legu-minous plant, Adenanthera Pavonina; saffron.
कुचर: कुचर कु-चर, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (see 1. कु), going slowly, creeping; following evil practices, low, vile, wicked; speaking ill of any one, detracting, censorious; (अस्), m. a fixed star.
कुचर्या: कु-चर्या, f. evil conduct, wickedness, impropriety.
कुचाङ्गेरी: कुचाङ्गेरी कु-चाङ्गेरी, f. (see 1. कु), a kind of wood sorrel, Rumex Vesicarius, = चुक्रिका।
कुचिक: कुचिक कुचिक, अस्, आ, m. f. a kind of fish, in shape like an eel, commonly Kuñciya, Unibran-chapertura Cuchiya, or Muræna Apterygia Synbrache; the Hindūs affirm that its bite is mortal to cows, though perfectly harmless to men; (also a various reading for कुशिक, q. v.)
कुचीरा: कुचीरा कुचीरा, f., N. of a river.
कुचुमार: कुचुमार कुचुमार, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Aupaniṣadādhikaraṇa.
कुचेल: कुचेल कु-चेल, अम्, n. (see 1. कु), a bad garment; (अस्, आ, अम्), badly clothed, dressed in dirty or tattered garments; (आ), f., N. of a plant, = अविकर्णी or विद्धपर्णी; (ई), f., N. of a plant, = अम्बष्ठा, commonly Ākanādi, Cissampelos Hexandra.
कुचेष्टा: कुचेष्टा कु-चेष्टा, f. (see 1. कु), an evil de-sign, a wicked contrivance.
कुच्छ: कुच्छ कुच्छ, अम्, n. the white water-lily.
कुज्: कुज् कुज्, cl. 1. P. कोजति, कोजितुम्, to steal; cl. 6. P. कुजति, to be crooked; [cf. कुञ्ज्।]
कुज: कुज कु-ज, अस्, m. (fr. 2. कु and rt. जन्), a tree; the son of the earth, a N. of the planet Mars; N. of a Daitya, also called Naraka, conquered by Kṛṣṇa; (आ), f. the daughter of the earth, an epithet of the goddess Durgā; also of Sītā. —कुज-पञ्-चमी, f. the fifth day of the moon occurring on a Tuesday or the day of Mars, by some thought unlucky.
कुजन: कुजन कु-जन, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a bad or wicked man, a low, mean or vulgar person.
कुजननी: कुजननी कु-जननी, f. (see 1. कु), a bad mother.
कुजन्मन्: कुजन्मन् कू-जन्मन्, आ, आ, अ (see 1. कु), low-born, of inferior origin.
कुजम्भ: कुजम्भ कु-जम्भ, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), N. of a Daitya, a younger brother of Jambha and son of Prahrāda or Prahlāda, a son of Hiraṇya-kaśipu.
कुजम्भल: कुजम्भल कुजम्भल, अस्, m. a thief who breaks into a house; also कुजम्भिर and कुजम्-भिल; [cf. कुम्भिल।]
कुज्जिश: कुज्जिश कुज्जिश or कुज्झिश, अस्, m. a sort of fish; [cf. कुडिश।]
कुज्झटि: कुज्झटि कुज्झटि, इस् or ई, or कुज्झटिका, f. a fog or mist.
कुञ्च्: कुञ्च् कुञ्च्, cl. 1. P. कुञ्चति, चुकुञ्च, कुञ्चितुम्, to make crooked; to be crooked; to bend or curve, to move crookedly; to go; to go to or towards; to be or become small; to lessen, to make small; to shrink, to contract, to draw together: Caus. कुञ्चयति, -यितुम्: Desid. चुकुञ्चिषति: Intens. चोकुच्यते; [cf. Hib. cuach-aim, ‘I fold, plait;’ cuach, ‘a curl;’ cuachach, ‘curled, frizzled.’]
कुञ्चन: कुञ्चन, अम्, n. curving, bending, contracting; contraction; a certain disease of the eyes, contracting the eyelids.
कुञ्चफला: कुञ्च-फला, f. a kind of gourd, = कुष्माण्डी; (a wrong reading for कुच-फल?).
कुञ्चि: कुञ्चि, इस्, f. a measure of capacity equal to eight handfuls.
कुञ्चिका: कुञ्चिका, f. a key; a fish, commonly Kuñciya, in shape like an eel and eaten as one, Unibranchapertura Cuchiya, or the fish Muræna Apterygia, Synbrache [cf. कुचिक]; a plant bearing a red and black seed used as a weight, Abrus Precatorius; or another plant bearing a pungent seed, Nigella Indica; a sort of reed; the branch or shoot of a bamboo.
कुञ्चित: कुञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, crooked, curved, bent, con-tracted, &c.; (अम्), n., N. of a plant. —कुञ्चिताङ्-गुलि (°त-अङ्°), इस्, इस्, इ, with bent or curved fingers.
कुञ्ज्: कुञ्ज् कुञ्ज्, cl. 1. P. कुञ्जति, -जितुम्, to murmur, = कूज्।
कुञ्ज: कुञ्ज कुञ्ज, अस्, अम्, m. n. a place overrun with plants or overgrown with creepers, a bower, an arbour; a cave; the lower jaw; an elephant's tusk or jaw; a tooth; (अस्), m., N. of a man. —कुञ्ज-कुटीर, अस्, m. a bower, an arbour. —कुञ्ज-वल्लरी, f., N. of a plant, = निकुञ्जिकाम्ला।
कुञ्जिका: कुञ्जिका, f. another N. of the plant Kuñja-vallarī; fennel-flower seed, = कुञ्चिका, Nigella Indica.
कुञ्जर: कुञ्जर कुञ्जर, अस्, m. (fr. कुञ्ज ?), an ele-phant; anything pre-eminent in its kind (generally in compounds, e. g. पुरुष-कुञ्जर, an eminent man); the tree Ficus Religiosa; N. of a Nāga; N. of a prince of the Sauvīraka race; N. of a mountain; of a region; hair; (आ and ई), f. a female elephant; (आ), f. the plant Bignonia Suaveolens; another plant, Grislea Tomentosa. —कुञ्जर-कर, अस्, m. an elephant's trunk. —कुञ्जर-क्षार-मूल, अम्, n. a kind of radish (मूलक). —कुञ्जर-ग्रह, अस्, m. an elephant-catcher. —कुञ्जर-दरी, f. ‘ele-phant's cave,’ N. of a place. —कुञ्जर-पिप्पली, f., N. of a plant described as bearing a fruit resembling long pepper; [cf. गज-पिप्पली।] —कुञ्जर-रूपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, elephant-shaped. —कुञ्जरानीक (°र-अन्°), अम्, n. the division of an army consisting of ele-phants, an elephant-corps. —कुञ्जराराति (°र-अर्°), इस्, m. a lion; the Śarabha, a fabulous animal with eight legs, (‘enemy of the elephant.’) —कुञ्जरा-लुक (°र-आल्°), अम्, n. a species of esculent root, a sort of yam. —कुञ्जराशन (°र-अश्°), अस्, m. the holy fig tree, Ficus Religiosa.
कुञ्जल: कुञ्जल कुञ्जल, अम्, n. sour gruel; [cf. काञ्जिका।]
कुट्: कुट् कुट्, cl. 6. P. कुटति, चुकोट, कुटि-ष्यति, अकुटीत्, कुटितुम्, to be or become crooked or curved; to bend, curve, curl; to make crooked; to be dishonest, cheat or deceive; cl. 4. P. कुट्यति, or cl. 10. A. कोटयते, -यितुम्, to break to pieces, tear asunder, divide; to speak indistinctly; to be warm, burn: Caus. कोटयति: Desid. चुकुटि-षति: Intens. चोकुट्यते; [cf. कुट्ट् and कुण्ट्।]
कुट: कुट, अस् or अम्, m. n. a water-pot, a jar, pitcher; (अस्), m. a fort, a stronghold; a house [cf. कुटि, कुटी, and कूट]; a hammer, a mallet for breaking small stones; a tree; a mountain; N. of a man; (अम्), n., Ved. = कृत, a work. —कुट-कारिका, f. a female servant (bringing the water-jar). —कुट-ज, अस्, m. the medicinal tree Wrightia Antidysenterica, commonly called Karaya; the seeds are used as a vermifuge [cf. इन्द्र-यव]; a N. of the sage Agastya (‘born in a water-jar’); also of Droṇa, q. v. —कुटज-मल्ली, f. a kind of plant.
कुटक: कुटक, अस्, m., N. of a people; N. of a moun-tain; the post round which the string of the churning-stick winds [cf. कुटर and कुठर]; (अम्), n. a plough without a pole.
कुटि: कुटि, इस्, ई, m. f. a curvature, a curve; a hut, cottage, house, hall, shop; (ई), f. a vessel with openings used for fumigations; a bawd, a procuress or go-between; a nosegay, a bundle or tuft of flowers or vegetables; a kind of perfume, commonly Murā; spirituous liquor; (इस्), m. the body; a tree; [cf. Eng. hut; Germ. Hütte.] —कुटि-चर, अस्, m. a crocodile or porpoise. —कुटि-पार्थिव, अस्, m., N. of a man. —कुटी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, curved, curled, twisted, frizzled; (अम्), n. anything (as woollen cloth) curled or twisted. —कुटी-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, inside the house. —कुटी-गु, उस्, m., N. of a man. —कुटी-चक, अस्, m. a kind of religious mendicant, one who lives at his son's expense; (lit. ‘delighting in staying in the house.’) —कुटी-चर, अस्, m. an ascetic of a particular order, one who consigns the care of his family to his son and remains at home en-gaged solely in devotion; or one who goes begging from one house to another. —कुटी-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of a house (?). —कुटी-मुख, अस्, m., N. of one of the attendants of Kuvera.
कुटि कुटि, कुटिर। See under rt. कुट् above.
कुटिक: कुटिक, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, crooked; (आ), f., N. of a river.
कुटित: कुटित, अस्, आ, अम्, crooked, bent.
कुटितृ: कुटितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, making crooked; acting dishonestly; being bent.
कुटिर: कुटिर, अम्, n. a hut, a cottage.
कुटिल: कुटिल, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, crooked, curved, round, running in curved lines, crisped, curled; going crookedly, tortuous; insincere, dishonest, fraudu-lent; (आ), f., N. of a plant [cf. तगरपादी]; N. of a river; (according to some) N. of the Sarasvatī; N. of a metre containing four lines of fourteen sylla-bles each; (अम्), n., N. of a plant [cf. तगर, कुञ्चित, वक्र]; a kind of perfume; tin. —कुटिल-गति, इस्, f. a species of the Atijagatī metre, = चन्-द्रिका. —कुटिल-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going crookedly, tortuous. —कुटिल-ता, f. or कुटिल-त्व, अम्, n. crookedness; guile, dishonesty. —कुटिल-पक्ष्म, अस्, आ, अम्, having curved eyelashes or brows. —कुटिल-स्वभाव, अस्, आ, अम्, crooked-minded, disingenuous. —कुटिलाशय (°ल-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ill-intentioned, malevolent.
कुटिल कुटिल। See under rt. कुट्, col. 2.
कुटिलक: कुटिलक, अस्, इका, अम्, bent, curved, crooked, winding; (इका), f. crouching, coming stealthily as a hunter on his prey; a peculiar movement or gesture (in theatrical language); an instrument used by a blacksmith, a blacksmith's forge.
कुटीय: कुटीय, nom. P. कुटीयति, -यितुम्, to imagine one's self in a hut.
कुटीर: कुटीर, अस् or अम्, m. n. a small house, a hut, a hovel; a kind of plant; (अम्), n. sexual intercourse; exclusiveness.
कुटीर कुटीर। See under rt. कुट्, col. 2.
कुटङ्क: कुटङ्क कुटङ्क, अस्, m. (connected with कुट above), a roof, a thatch; [cf. कुटुङ्गक, कुडङ्ग, कुण्डङ्ग, कुटल।]
कुटङ्ग: कुटङ्ग कुटङ्ग, N. of a place.
कुटङ्गक: कुटङ्गक कुटङ्गक, अस्, m. an arbour formed by creeping plants overrunning a tree; a roof or thatch; a house, a small house, a hut or cottage; [cf. कुटुङ्गक।]
कुटच: कुटच कुटच, अस्, m. (for कुट-ज), the medicinal tree Wrightia Antidysenterica.
कुटज: कुटज कुट-ज। See under कुट above.
कुटन्नक: कुटन्नक कुटन्नक, अम्, n. the fragrant grass Cyperus Rotundus; [cf. also the following.]
कुटन्नट: कुटन्नट कुटन्नट, अस्, m. the tree Calos-anthes Indica; (अम्), n. the fragrant grass Cyperus Rotundus.
कुटप: कुटप कुटप, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कुट्), a measure of grain &c. (= कुडव); a saint, a divine sage or Muni; a garden or grove near a house (= निष्कुट); (अम्), n. a lotus.
कुटर: कुटर कुटर, अस्, m. a post round which the string passes that works the churning-stick [cf. कुटक and कुठर]; N. of a Nāga.
कुटरु: कुटरु कुटरु, उस्, m., Ved. a cock; a tent, a house of cloth or canvas.
कुटरुणा: कुटरुणा कुटरुणा, f. a plant, commonly Teöri, Ipomœa Turpethum.
कुटल: कुटल कुटल, अम्, n. a roof, a thatch; [cf. कुटङ्क।]
कुटिकोष्टिका: कुटिकोष्टिका कुटिकोष्टिका, f., N. of a river.
कुटुङ्गक: कुटुङ्गक कुटुङ्गक, अस्, m. an arbour or bower formed of creeping plants; a creeper winding round a tree; a thatch, a roof; a hut, a cottage; a granary, a store-room; [cf. कुटङ्क, कुटङ्गक, कुडङ्ग।]
कुटुनी: कुटुनी कुटुनी, f. a wrong reading for कुट्टनी, q. v.
कुटुम्ब: कुटुम्ब कुटुम्ब, अम्, n. a household, the collective members of a household, a family; the care of a family, house-keeping; the care taken by a householder for the members of his family, hence metaphorically care or anxiety about anything; (अस्, अम्), m. n. name; race; a kinsman, a relation by descent; a connection, a relation by marriage by the mother's side; offspring, progeny. —कुटुम्ब-क-लह, अस्, अम्, m. n. domestic dissension, family feud. —कुटुम्ब-व्यापृत, अस्, m. a provident and attentive father of a family. —कुटुम्बार्थम् (°ब-अर्°), ind. for the support or on account of a family. —कुटुम्बौकस् (°ब-ओक्°), अस्, n. apartments &c. appropriated to the accommodation of relations &c.
कुटुम्बक: कुटुम्बक, अस्, आ, अम्, being of one family; (अम्), n. a household; the duties and cares of a house-holder; a family, kindred.
कुटुम्बय: कुटुम्बय, nom. A. -यते, to support a family.
कुटुम्बिक: कुटुम्बिक, अस्, आ, अम्, taking care of a family or household; (अस्), m. the slave of a house.
कुटुम्बिन्: कुटुम्बिन्, ई, m. a householder, a paterfamilias; one who supports or takes care of a family; meta-phorically one who takes care of anything (especially at the end of a compound); a member of a family, any one belonging to a household; a peasant, a cultivator of the soil; (इनी), f. the wife of a house-holder and mother of a family, a matron; a large household, a large family; a small shrub used in medicine, a kind of moon-plant, = क्षीरिणी. —कु-टुम्बि-ता, f. or कुटुम्बि-त्व, अम्, n. family con-nection or union, living as one family.
कुटेर: कुटेर कुटेर, अस्, m. a hut, a cottage; [cf. कुटीर।]
कुट्ट्: कुट्ट् कुट्ट्, cl. 10. P. कुट्टयति, अचुकुट्टत्, यितुम्, to cut, divide; to grind or pound; to multiply; to censure, abuse.
कुट्ट: कुट्ट, अस्, ई, अम्, (at the end of compounds) cut-ting, dividing, making small; grinding, pounding; (अस्), m. a multiplier such that a given dividend being multiplied by it and a given quantity added to (or subtracted from) the product, the sum (or difference) may be measured by a given divisor. —कुट्टप-रान्त or कुट्टापरान्त (°ट-अप्°), आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —कुट्ट-प्रचरण and कुट्ट-प्रा-वरण, आस्, m. pl., N. of two nations.
कुट्टक: कुट्टक, अस्, आ, अम्, what cuts or divides, what pounds or grinds; (अस्), m. a grinder or pulverizer, a multiplier, &c. [cf. कुट्ट]; a kingfisher. —कुट्टक-व्यवहार, अस्, m. or कुट्टकाध्याय (°क-अध्°), अस्, m. that branch or chapter of arithmetic which treats of the कुट्ट or कुट्टक।
कुट्टन: कुट्टन, अम्, n. cutting, dividing; pounding, grinding, beating, threshing; abusing; (ई), f. a bawd, a procuress, a go-between.
कुट्टन्ती: कुट्टन्ती, f. a kind of dagger.
कुट्टाक: कुट्टाक, अस्, ई, अम्, what cuts or divides.
कुट्टित: कुट्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, divided; pounded, flat-tened; (आ), f., scil. सिरा, unskilful opening of a vein, the latter being cut to pieces by repeated application of the knife.
कुट्टिन्: कुट्टिन्, ई, इनी, इ, what cuts or pounds; (नी), f. a bawd, a procuress.
कुट्टिम: कुट्टिम, अस्, आ, अम्, plastered with small stones, decorated with mosaic; (अस्, अम्), m. n. an inlaid or paved floor, pavement, ground paved with mosaic or small stones, ground smoothed and plastered; ground prepared for the site of a mansion; a jewel mine; a hut, a cottage; the pomegranate.
कुट्टमित: कुट्टमित कुट्टमित, अम्, n. one of the ten blandishments of women, affected repulse of a lover's caresses; [cf. कुट्टुमित।]
कुट्टार: कुट्टार कुट्टार, अस्, m. a mountain; (अम्), n. sexual intercourse; pleasure; a woollen cloth or blanket; exclusion; oneness; [cf. कुटीर and कुट्-टीर।]
कुट्टिहारिका: कुट्टिहारिका कुट्टिहारिका, f. a female servant, a slave; [cf. कुट-हारिका।]
कुट्टीर: कुट्टीर कुट्टीर, अस्, m. a mountain; [cf. कुटीर and कुट्टार।]
कुट्टीरक: कुट्टीरक कुट्टीरक, अम्, n. (?) a small house, a hut; (a wrong reading for कुटीरक?).
कुट्टुमित: कुट्टुमित कुट्टुमित, अम्, n. = कुट्टमित above.
कुट्मल: कुट्मल कुट्मल, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. कुट्), opening or expanding as the blossom of a flower, blossoming; (अस्, अम्), m. n. an opening bud; (अम्), n. one of the twenty-one hells in which sinners are punished (where they are bound with ropes).
कुठ: कुठ कुठ, अस्, m. a tree; (generally written कुट।)
कुठर: कुठर कुठर, अस्, m. the post round which the string of the churning-stick winds; [cf. कुटर।]
कुठाकु: कुठाकु कुठाकु, उस्, m. a bird, the wood-pecker, Picus Bengalensis, commonly Kāṭhṭhākro.
कुठाटङ्क: कुठाटङ्क कुठाटङ्क, अस्, आ, m. f. an axe.

कुण्: कुण् कुण्, cl. 6. P. कुणति, -णितुम्, to sound; to cherish, to support or aid with gifts &c.; to be in pain (?); cl. 10. P. कुणयति, -यितुम्, to counsel or advise; to converse with, to speak to, address; to salute; to invite; [cf. Lat. cano, sono; Lith. zwanu.]
कुण: कुण कुण, अस्, m. in composition with अश्वत्थ and other trees or flowers; the time when a plant bears fruit, e. g. पीलु-कुण, q. v.
कुणक: कुणक कुणक, अस्, m. a young animal just born.

कुणाल: कुणाल कुणाल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. क्वण्), a kind of bird; N. of a son of Aśoka; N. of a country.
कुणि: कुणि कुणि, इस्, इस्, इ, a cripple with a crooked or withered arm, or without a hand or finger; (इस्), m. a whitlow; the tree Cedrela Toona (तुन्न); N. of a prince, a son of Jaya and father of Yugan-dhara; N. of a Muni; N. of the author of a Dharma-śāstra. —कुणि-बाहु, उस्, m., N. of a Muni.
कुणिताहि: कुणिताहि कुणिताहि, इस्, m., N. of the author of a Dharma-śāstra.
कुणिन्: कुणिन् कुणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, only in कुणी कण-भः, a kind of bug; [cf. उत्कुण, मत्कुण।]
कुणिन्द: कुणिन्द कुणिन्द, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कुण्), sound, sounding.
कुण्टक: कुण्टक कुण्टक, अस्, ई, अम्, fat, corpulent.
कुण्ठ्: कुण्ठ् कुण्ठ्, cl. 1. P. कुण्ठति, -ठितुम्, to be lame or mutilated, to be blunted or dulled; to be lazy or stupid; cl. 10. P. कुण्ठयति, यितुम्, to cover, conceal.
कुण्ठ: कुण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, blunt, dull; stupid; weak; indolent, lazy, slow; foolish; [cf. अ-कुण्ठ।] —कुण्-ठ-ता, f. bluntness, dulness, indolence.
कुण्ठक: कुण्ठक, अस्, आ, अम्, stupid, ignorant, a fool; (अस्), m., N. of a pupil of Luṇṭaka; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.

कुण्ड्: कुण्ड् कुण्ड्, cl. 1. P. कुण्डति, to mutilate; cl. 1. A. कुण्डते, -डितुम्, to burn; cl. 10. P. कुण्डयति, -यितुम्, to protect.
कुण्ड: कुण्ड कुण्ड, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. कुण्डिक: कुण्डिक, अस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; (आ), f. a pitcher; a student's water-pot, the Kamandalu.
कुण्डिन्: कुण्डिन्, ई, इनी, इ, furnished with a pitcher or water-jar; (ई), m. a horse [cf. किन्धिन् &c.]; a bastard.
कुण्डिन: कुण्डिन, अस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; N. of an author; (अम्), n. a city, the capital of the district Vidarbha, ruled over by Bhīma, the father-in-law of Nala, apparently the modern Kondavir in Berar; (according to some the city is also called Vidarbha, or m. pl. Vidarbhās, but this is rather the name of the territory.)
कुण्डङ्ग: कुण्डङ्ग कुण्डङ्ग, अस्, m. a bower, an ar-bour; (a wrong reading for कुडङ्ग।)

कुण्डलना: कुण्डलना, f. (fr. कुण्डलय, nom. fr. कुण्डल), encircling a word or the circle round any word which is to be left out in a MS.
कुण्डलिका: कुण्डलिका, f., N. of a metre in Prākṛt poetry; [cf. वात-कुण्डलिका।]

कुण्डीर: कुण्डीर कुण्डीर, अस्, आ, अम्, strong, power-ful, able; (अस्), m., N. of a man.
कुण्डृणाची: कुण्डृणाची कुण्डृणाची, f., Ved. a species of animal; (Sāy.) tortuous progress.
कुत्: कुत् कुत् (a Sautra root, or one found in grammatical Sūtras only), to spread.
कुत: कुत कुत, अस्, m., N. of one of the eighteen attendants of the sun, identified with the god of the ocean.
कुतनय: कुतनय कु-तनय, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a de-generate son.

कुतपस्विन्: कुतपस्विन् कु-तपस्विन्, ई, m. (see 1. कु), a wicked or bad ascetic.
