केत: केत केत, अस्, m. (connected with 2. का or कित् = चित् ?), desire, wish, will, intention; summons, invitation; a house, an abode; apparition, form, shape; (Sāy.) wealth; atmosphere, sky. —केत-पू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved. purifying the desire or will. —केत-वेदस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. desirous, wishful; (Sāy.) knowing the wealth of another. —केत-साप्, प्, प्, प्, Ved. obeying the will (of another), obedient; (Sāy.) touching the sky.
केतन: केतन, अम्, n. a summons, an invitation; a house, an abode; place, site, situation; the symbol of a goddess; the ensign of a warrior, a flag or banner (e. g. वानर-केतन, one who has a monkey as his ensign or arms; see also मकर-केतन, &c.); a sign, a spot or mark; business, indispensable act.
केतय: केतय, nom. P. केतयति, -यितुम्, to summon, to call or invite; to counsel or advise; to fix or appoint a time; to hear.
केतित: केतित, अस्, आ, अम्, called, summoned; dwelt, inhabited.
केतक: केतक केतक, अस्, ई, m. f. the tree Pandanus Odoratissimus.
केतलिकीर्ति: केतलिकीर्ति केतलि-कीर्ति, इस्, m., N. of the author of the work Megha-mālā.
केतु: केतु केतु, उस्, m. (fr. कि for rt. 2. चि), bright appearance, clearness, brightness; a ray of light; day-time; apparition, form, shape; sign, mark, ensign, flag, banner; a chief, a leader, any eminent person; intellect, judgment, discernment; any unusual or striking phenomena, a comet, meteor, falling star; the dragon's tail or descending node considered in astronomy as the ninth of the planets, and in mythology as the body of the demon Saiṃhikeya, son of Siṃhikā, which was severed from the head or Rāhu by Viṣṇu at the churning of the ocean, but was rendered immortal by having tasted the Amṛta; a pigmy race (see केतु-गण below); disease; an enemy; N. of a son of Agni, supposed to be the author of a Ṛg-veda hymn; N. of a Dānava; N. of a son of Ṛṣabha; also of a son of the fourth Manu; अरुणाः केतवः, red apparitions, a class of superhuman spirits or demons, (a kind of sacrificial fire is called after them अग्निर् आरुणकेतुकः।) —केतु-गण, आस्, m. pl. the dwarfish inhabitants of Kuśa-dvīpa, children of Jaimini. —केतु-ग्रह, अस्, m. the descending node. —केतु-तारा, f. a comet. —केतु-धर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a man. —केतु-भ, अस्, m. a cloud. —केतु-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, being or become a banner. —केतु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, endowed with brightness, clear; clear (as a sound), penetrating; (आन्), m., N. of a Dānava; of a regent of the western part of the world, a son of Rajas; of a son of Kṣema and father of Suketu; of a son of Kṣema and father of Varṣa-ketu; of a warrior; of a son of Dhanvantari; of Ambarīṣa; N. of a mountain; N. of a palace of Sunandā, the wife of Vāsu-deva; (ती), f., N. of a metre consisting of two lines of twenty-one syllables each. —केतु-माला, f., N. of a Tīrtha; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (अम्), n. one of the nine great divisions of the known world, the western portion or Varṣa of Jambu-dvīpa, called after a son of Agnīdhra; (अस्), m., N. of a boar. —केतुमालिन्, ई, or केतुमालि, इस्, m., N. of a Dānava. —केतु-यष्टि, इस्, f. a flag-staff. —केतु-रत्न, अम्, n. lapis lazuli. —केतु-वसन, अस्, m. a flag. —केतु-वीर्य, अस्, m., N. of a Dānava. —केतु-शृङ्ग, अस्, m., N. of a king.
केदर: केदर केदर, अस्, आ, अम्, squint-eyed; (अस्), m., N. of a plant; [cf. केकर and टेरक।]
केदार: केदार केदार, अस्, m. a field, especially one under water, a meadow, a plain; a basin for water round the root of a tree, a bed in a garden or field; a mountain; a particular mountain; a parti-cular place, the modern Kedār, part of the Himālaya mountains; an epithet of Śiva as worshipped in the Himālayas; N. of the author of a work entitled Abdhi. —केदार-कटुका, f., N. of a plant, = कटुका। —केदार-कल्प, अस्, m. a part of the Skanda-purāṇa. —केदार-खण्ड, अम्, n. a small dyke or mound, earth raised to keep out water; a part of the Skanda-purāṇa. —केदार-ज, अम्, n., N. of a plant. —के-दार-नाथ, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva as worshipped in the Himālayas. —केदार-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of an author. —केदार-मल्ल, अस्, m. an epithet of Madanapāla.
केदारक: केदारक, अस्, m. a particular kind of rice, = षष्टिक।
केन: केन केन, ind. (inst. fr. 2. क), by what? wherefore? whence?
केनती: केनती केनती, f. an epithet of the wife of Kāma, the god of love; (a wrong form?).
केनव: केनव केनव, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of Śākapūrṇī.
केनार: केनार केनार, अस्, m. the head; a skull; the temples, the upper part of the cheek; a joint; a division of hell, a hell compared to a potter's kiln.
केनिप: केनिप केनिप, अस्, m., Ved. a sage, a wise man; [cf. आकेनिप।]
केनिपात: केनिपात केनिपात or केनिपातक, अस्, m. the helm, a rudder, a large oar used as a rudder.
केनेषितोपनिषद्: केनेषितोपनिषद् केनेषितोपनिषद् or केनो-पनिषद्, त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad beginning with the word केनेषितम्।
केन्दु: केन्दु केन्दु, उस्, m. a kind of ebony.
केन्दुक: केन्दुक, अस्, m. another variety of ebony yielding a species of tar, Diospyros Glutinosa.
केन्द्र: केन्द्र केन्द्र, अम्, n. (a word borrowed from the Gr. κέντρον), the centre of a circle; the equation of the centre; the argument of a circle; the argu-ment of an equation; the distance of a planet from the first point of its orbit in the fourth, seventh, or tenth degree; it is variously applied in composition, as पतन-केन्द्रम्, argument of the latitude; द्वितीय-केन्द्रम्, the distance of the higher apsis of a planet in any point of its orbit; शीघ्र-केन्द्रम्, commutation, the distance of the sun from a superior planet or of an inferior planet from the sun; मन्द-केन्द्रम्, argument of anomaly.
केप्: केप् केप्, cl. 1. A. केपते, to shake or tremble [cf. कम्प् and वेप्]; to go, move, approach [cf. गेप्].
केपि: केपि केपि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. unclean; (or fr. rt. कम्प्), trembling, shaking (?).
केमद्रुम: केमद्रुम केमद्रुम in astronomy = the Gr. χρηματισμός
केमुक: केमुक केमुक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = केचुक।
केयूर: केयूर केयूर, अस्, अम्, m. n. a bracelet worn on the upper arm; (अस्), m. a kind of coitus. —केयूर-बल, अस्, m., N. of a deity.
केयूरक: केयूरक, अस्, m., N. of a Gandharva.
केयूरिन्: केयूरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, decorated with a bracelet on the upper arm.
केरक: केरक केरक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
केरल: केरल केरल, आस्, m. pl., N. of the inha-bitants of Malabar; (अस्), m. sing. a king of the Keralas; N. of a son of Ākrīḍa, from whom the people of Kerala are derived; (ई), f. a kind of science; astronomical science; an astronomical Śāstra or treatise; a Hora or period of time equal to about one hour; (अम्), n., N. of the country inhabited by the Keralas. —केरलोत्पत्ति (°ल-उत्°), इस्, f., N. of a work.
केरलक: केरलक, आस्, m. pl., N. of the inhabitants of Malabar.
केल्: केल् केल् [cf. Prākṛt कील् = क्रीड्], cl. 1. P. केलति, to shake; to go or move, move about, be frolicsome, sport.
केलक: केलक, अस्, m. a dancer, a tumbler, one who walks or dances on the edge of a sword.
केलाय: केलाय, nom. P. केलायति, -यितुम्, to sport, play.
केलि: केलि, इस् or ई, m. f. play, sport, amorous sport, pastime, amusement; (इस्), f. the earth. —केलि-कला, f. amorous or sportive accents or address; sportive skill, wantonness; the Vīṇā or lute of Sarasvatī. —केलि-किल, अस्, m. the confidential companion of the hero of a drama, in general a sort of buffoon; one of Śiva's attendant demi-gods; (आ), f. an epithet of Rati the wife of Kāma-deva, the god of love. —केलि-कीर्ण, अस्, m. a camel. —केलि-कुञ्चिका, f. a wife's younger sister. —केलि-कोष, अस्, m. an actor, a dancer or tumbler. —केलि-गृह or केलि-निकेतन, अम्, n. a pleasure-house, a private apartment. —केलि-नागर, अस्, m. a sensualist, an enjoyer of worldly pleasures. —केलि-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, wanton, sportive. —केलि-मण्डप, अस्, अम्, m. n. or केलि-मन्दिर, अम्, n. a pleasure-house, a play-room. —केलि-मुख, अस्, m. pastime, sport. —केलि-रङ्ग, अस्, m. a pleasure-ground. —केलि-रैवतक, अम्, n. title of a treatise. —केलि-वृक्ष, अस्, m. a species of the Kadamba, commonly called Kelikadamba (Nauclea Cordifolia), being abundant in the scene of Kṛṣṇa's sports with the Gopīs. —केलि-शयन, अम्, n. a pleasure-couch, a sofa. —केलि-शुषि, इस्, f. the earth. —केलि-सचिव, अस्, m. minister of the sports, master of the revels. —केलि-सदन, अम्, n. a pleasure-house, a play-room. —केलि-स्थली, f. a place of pleasure. —केली-पिक, अस्, m. a cuckoo kept for pleasure. —केली-वनी, f. a pleasure-park, a pleasure-grove.
केलिक: केलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, sporting, sportive; (अस्), m. the tree Jonesia Aśoka.
केल: केल केल or केलु, a particular number.
केव्: केव् केव्, cl. 1. A. केवते, -वितुम्, to serve, attend to.
केवट: केवट केवट, अस्, m., Ved. a cave, a hollow.
केवर्त: केवर्त केवर्त, अस्, m., Ved. a fisherman, = कैवर्त, q. v.
केवल: केवल केवल, अस्, आ (or Ved. ई), अम्, ex-clusively one's own (not common to others); peculiar; alone, only, mere, sole, one, excluding others; not connected with anything else, isolated, abstract, abso-lute; simple, pure, uncompounded, unmingled, perfect in one's self, entire, whole, all; selfish, envious; (अम्), ind. only, merely, solely, entirely, wholly, absolutely, certainly; न केवलम् — अपि, not only — but also; केवलम् — न तु, only — but not; (अस्), m., N. of a prince, a son of Nara; (ई), f. the doctrine of the absolute unity of spirit; N. of a place; (अम्), n. the doctrine of the absolute unity of spirit; N. of a country. —केवल-ज्ञानिन्, ई, m., N. of the first Arhat of the last Utsarpiṇī. —केवल-तस्, ind. only. —केवल-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being alone. —केवल-द्रव्य, अम्, n. black pepper. —केवल-नैयायिक, अस्, m. a mere logician, not versed in any other science. —केवल-वैयाकरण, अस्, m. a mere grammarian, one not versed in any other science. —केवलाघ (°ल-अघ), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. alone guilty. —केवलात्मन् (°ल-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, one whose nature or essence is absolute unity. —केवला-दिन् (°ल-आद्°), ई, इनी, इ, eating by one's self alone or apart from others.
केवलिन्: केवलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, alone, one, only; devoted to the doctrine of the absolute unity of spirit; (ई), m. with Jainas, an Arhat.
केविका: केविका केविका or केवी, f., N. of a flower, = कविका, commonly केवेर।

(said to be fr. rt. क्लिश्), the hair of the head; the mane (of a horse or lion); a kind of perfume [cf. ह्रीवेर]; an epithet of Varuṇa; of Viṣṇu; N. of a Daitya; (ई), f. a lock of hair on the crown of the head; N. of several plants, the Indigo plant; another plant, Carpopogon Pruriens; an epithet of the goddess Durgā. —केश-कर्मन्, अ, n. dressing or arranging the air of the head. —केश-कलाप, अस्, m. a mass or quantity of hair, a head of hair. —केश-कार, अस्, m. a sort of sugar-cane. —केश-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, dressing or ar-ranging the hair of the head. —केश-कीट, अस्, m. a louse or other insect in the hair. —केश-गर्भ, अस्, m. a braid or tress of hair; an epithet of Varuṇa. —केश-गर्भक, अस्, m. a braid or tress of hair. —केश-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, pulled or seized by the hair. —केश-ग्रह, अस्, m. or केश-ग्रहण, अम्, n. pulling the hair. —केश-घ्न, अम्, n. morbid baldness, falling of the hair. —केश-चूड, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has dressed his hair in a tuft or top-knot. —केश-च्छिद्, त्, m. a hair-dresser, a barber. —केश-जाह, अम्, n. the root of the hair. —केश-दृंहण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. serving for fastening the hair. —केश-धर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —केश-धृत्, त्, f., N. of a plant, the root of sweet flag. —केश-पक्ष, अस्, m. much or ornamented hair, a tuft. —केश-पङ्क्ति, इस्, f. a row or line of hair; a quantity of hair. —केश-पर्णी, f. the plant Achyranthes Aspera; also अपामार्ग. —केश-पाश, अस्, m. much or ornamented hair, a tuft; (ई), f. a lock of hair hanging down from the top of the head. —केश-बन्ध, अस्, m. a hair-band. —केश-भू, ऊस्, m. the head. —केश-भूमि, इस्, f. any place on which hair grows. —केश-मार्जक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?) a comb. —केश-मार्जन, अम्, n. a comb; cleaning the hair. —केश-मुष्टि, इस्, m. a handful of hair; N. of two plants, (also विष-मुष्टि and महा-निम्ब।) —केश-रचना, f. arranging or dressing the hair. —केश-रञ्जन or केश-राज, अस्, m., N. of a vegetable, = भृङ्ग-राज. —केश-रुहा, f., N. of a plant, = भद्र-दन्तिका. —केश-रूपा, f., N. of a parasitical plant. —केश-लुञ्चक, अस्, आ, अम्, pulling the hair. —केश-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a fine head of hair; having long hair; having a mane. —केश-वपनीय, अस्, m., N. of a festival. —केश-वर्-धन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. causing the hair to grow. —केश-वर्धिनी, f., N. of a plant, a kind of Sida. —केश-वेश, अस्, m. a tress or fillet of hair. —केश-वेष्ट, अस्, m. the parting of the hair. —केश-हन्त्री, f., N. of a tree, = शमी. —केश-हस्त, अस्, m. much or ornamented hair, a tuft. —केशा-केशि, ind. hair to hair, head to head; pulling each other's hair. —केशाग्र (°श-अग्°), अम्, n. the top of a hair. —केशान्त (°श-अन्°), अस्, m. the tip or end of a hair; long hair hanging down, a lock of hair, a tuft; cutting off the hair finally, as a religious cere-mony performed upon Brāhmans at sixteen years of age, Kṣatriyas at twenty-two, and Vaiśyas at twenty-four. —केशान्तिक, अस्, आ, अम्, extending to the end of the hair as far as the forehead; relating to the ceremony of final tonsure. —केशारि (°श-अरि), इस्, m. the plant Mesua Ferrea. —केशारुहा (°श-आर्°), f., N. of a plant, = सह-देवी. —केशार्हा (°श-अर्°), f., N. of a plant, = महानीली. —केशावमर्षण (°श-अव्°), अम्, n. pulling the hair, especially amo-rously playing with it, rubbing it, &c. —केशोच्चय (°श-उच्°), अस्, m. much or handsome hair.
केशक: केशक, अस्, आ, अम्, skilful in dressing hair, be-stowing care upon the hair.

केशिक: केशिक, अस्, ई, अम्, having fine or luxuriant hair, relating to the hair; (आ), f. the plant Asparagus Racemosus.

केश्य: केश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in or on the hair; suit-able to the hair; (अस्), m., N. of a plant; (अम्), n. black Aloe wood.
केशट: केशट केशट, अस्, m. a goat; a bug; a louse; N. of a tree, commonly Sonapat, = शोणक; the parching arrow of Kāma-deva, the god of love; a brother; an epithet of Viṣṇu.
केशारुका: केशारुका केशारुका, f. = कशेरुका, the back-bone.
केसर: केसर केसर or केशर, अस्, अम्, m. n. (the former form being more usual in Vedic and the latter in classical literature), the hair; the mane (of a horse or lion); the filament of a lotus or of any vegetable; a fibre (as of a Mango fruit); (अम्), n. the tail of the Bos Grunniens, used as a fan for driving away flies; (अस्), m., N. of several plants, Rottleria Tinctoria; Mimusops Elengi; Mesua Ferrea; (अम्), n. the flower of these plants; gold; sulphate of iron; N. of a metre consisting of four lines of eighteen syllables each; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. Asa Fœtida; [cf. Lat. cœsaries; Angl. Sax. haer; Eng. hair; Germ. Haar.] —केसर-ग्राम, अस्, m., N. of a Grāma. —केसर-प्राबन्धा, f., Ved., N. of a woman. —केसर-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a mane. —केसर-वर, अम्, n. saffron. —केसरा-चल (°र-अच्°), अस्, m. ‘the filament mountain,’ N. of the mountains situated round Meru, which is called ‘the seed-vessel of the earth.’ —केसराम्ल (°र-अम्°), अस्, m. the citron.
केसरि: केसरि, इस्, m., N. of the father of Hanumat.
केसरिन्: केसरिन् and केशरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having a mane; (ई), m. a lion; a horse; N. of several plants, Rottle-ria Tinctoria; Mesua Ferrea; a citron tree; a variety of Moringa with red flowers (= रक्त-शिग्रु); N. of a man; of a monkey, husband of the mother of Hanumat. —केसरि-सुत, अस्, m., N. of Hanumat.
केह्लदेव: केह्लदेव केह्ल-देव, अस्, m., N. of a man.
कै: कै कै, cl. 1. P. कायति, चकौ, कास्यति, कातुम्, to sound.
कैकय: कैकय कैकय, अस्, m. the king of the Kekayas; (आस्), m. pl. the sons of this king; (ई), f. a daughter of this king.
कैकेय: कैकेय, अस्, m. a descendant of Kekaya, who was prince of the Kekayas; a son of Śivi; Dṛṣṭaketu, king of the Kekayas and father of the five Kaikeyas; (आस्), m. pl. the Kekayas; (ई), f. a daughter of the prince of the Kekayas, one of the wives of Daśa-ratha, mother of Bharata; a shrew, a scold.
कैङ्कर्य: कैङ्कर्य कैङ्कर्य, अम्, n. (fr. किङ्-कर), the office of a servant or slave; service, servitude.
कैट: कैट कैट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कीट), coming from an insect.
कैटज: कैटज कैटज, अस्, m. = कुटज, the plant Wrightia Antidysenterica.
कैटभ: कैटभ कैटभ, अस्, m., N. of an Asura slain by Viṣṇu; title of a class of writings; (आ and ई), f. an epithet of Durgā. —कैटभ-जित्, त्, m. or कै-टभ-हन्, आ, m. or कैटभारि (°भ-अरि), इस्, m. or कैटभार्दन (°भ-अर्°), अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
कैटर्य: कैटर्य कैटर्य, अस्, m. a plant used in medicine, commonly Kayaphal; the Nimb tree; Mayana Vangueria Spinosa.
कैडर्य: कैडर्य, अस्, m., N. of two plants, = कट्फल and कटभी।
कैतक: कैतक कैतक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. केतक), coming from the plant Pandanus Odoratissimus; (अम्), n. the flower of the tree Pandanus Odoratissimus.
कैतव: कैतव कैतव, अस्, m. (fr. कितव), a patro-nymic of Ulūka; (अम्), n. the stake in a game; gambling; deceit, fraud, cheating, roguery; the lapis lazuli. —कैतव-प्रयोग, अस्, m. a trick, a device. —कैतव-वाद, अस्, m. falsehood, evasion.
कैतवेय: कैतवेय or कैतव्य, अस्, m. a patronymic of Ulūka.
कैदार: कैदार कैदार, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. केदार), being on or growing in a field or meadow, especially one under water; (अस्), m. rice, corn; (अम्), n. a multi-tude of fields.
कैदारक: कैदारक or कैदारिक or कैदार्य, अम्, n. a multitude of fields.
कैदार्य: कैदार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to a field.
कैन्नर: कैन्नर कैन्नर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. किन् नर), coming from Kinnara.
कैयट: कैयट कैयट or कैय्यट, अस्, m., N. of a son of Jaiyaṭa, author of a commentary on Patañ-jali's Mahā-bhāṣya.
कैरलेय: कैरलेय कैरलेय, अस्, m. a king of the Keralas.
कैरव: कैरव कैरव, अस्, m. a gambler, a cheat, a rogue; an enemy; (अम्), n. the white esculent water-lily or lotus blossoming at night; (ई), f. moon-shine, moonlight; N. of a plant, = मेथिका. —कै-रव-बन्धु, उस्, m. an epithet of the moon.
कैरविन्: कैरविन्, ई, m. the moon; (इणी), f. a place or pond abounding in water-lilies, an assemblage of them. —कैरविणी-खण्ड, अम्, n. a multitude of spots filled with water-lilies.
कैराटक: कैराटक कैराटक, अस्, m. a species of vegetable poison, one of the fixed kinds.
कैरात: कैरात कैरात, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. किरात), relating or belonging to the Kirātas; (अस्), m. a prince of the Kirātas; a strong man; N. of a serpent; (अम्), n. the plant Agathotes Chirayta; a kind of sandal-wood.
कैरातक: कैरातक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the Kirāta people.
कैरातिक: कैरातिक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to the Kirātas.
कैराल: कैराल कैराल, अम्, ई, n. f., N. of a plant, used as a remedy for worms; [cf. विडङ्ग।]
कैरिशि: कैरिशि कैरिशि, इस्, m. (fr. किरिशि), a patro-nymic of Sutvan.
कैर्मेदुर: कैर्मेदुर कैर्मेदुर, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), N. of a place; (अस्, ई, अम्), coming from that place.
कैल: कैल कैल, अम्, n. sport, pleasure.
कैलकिल: कैलकिल कैलकिल, an epithet of Yavana.
कैलावत: कैलावत कैलावत, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
कैलास: कैलास कैलास, अस्, m., N. of the mountain Kailāsa, the fabulous residence of Kuvera and paradise of Śiva; it is placed by the Hindūs in the Himālaya range, and is regarded as one of the loftiest peaks to the north of the Mānasa lake. —कैलास-नाथ, अस्, m. the sovereign of the Kailāsa mountain, i. e. the god Kuvera. —कैलास-निकेतन, अस्, m. an epithet of Kuvera of Śiva —कैलास-पण्डित, अस्, m., N. of a copyist. —कैलासौकस् (°स-ओक्°), आस्, m. an epi-thet of Kuvera.
कैवर्त: कैवर्त कैवर्त, अस्, m. [cf. केवर्त], a fisherman, born of a prostitute by a Kṣatriya or of an Āyogava female by a Niṣāda father; (ई), f. the wife of a fisherman; a kind of grass, Cyperus Ro-tundus; [cf. परिपेल।] —कैवर्त-मुस्त or कै-वर्त-मुस्तक, अम्, n. the grass Cyperus Rotundus.
कैवर्तिका: कैवर्तिका, f., N. of a plant, = सुरङ्गा, लता, वल्ली, दशरुहा, &c.
कैवर्तिमुस्तक: कैवर्ति-मुस्तक or कैवर्ती-मुस्तक, अम्, n. a fragrant kind of grass, Cyperus Rotundus.
कैवल: कैवल कैवल, अम्, n. a kind of plant, used as a remedy for worms, = कैराल।
कैवल्य: कैवल्य कैवल्य, अम्, n. (fr. केवल), perfect isolation, abstraction, detachment from all other con-nections, detachment of the soul from matter or fur-ther transmigrations; becoming one with the Supreme; eternal happiness, emancipation, beatitude; exclusive-ness, soleness, individuality, totality; (अस्, आ, अम्), con-nected with this state of mind. —कैवल्य-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra. —कैवल्य-दीपिका, f., N. of a commentary by Hemādri. —कैवल्याश्रम (°य-आश्°), अस्, m. a pupil of Govinda, author of a commentary on the poem Ānanda-laharī. —कैव-ल्येन्द्र (°य-इन्°), अस्, m., N. of the instructor of Rāyaṇendra. —कैवल्योपनिषद् (°य-उप्°), त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad.
कैशव: कैशव कैशव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. केशव), be-longing to Keśava, (Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu.)
कैशिक: कैशिक कैशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. केश), hair-like, fine as a hair; (अस्), m. love, passion, lust; N. of a subdivision of the Yādavas, descended from Kaiśika, who was son of Vidarbha and brother of Kratha; (ई), f., scil. वृत्ति, one of the four varieties of dramatic style, the graceful style, suited especially to the passion of love; N. of a place or river; an epithet of Durgā; (अम्), n. a quantity of hair, a head of hair.
कैशिन: कैशिन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. केशिन्), connected with Keśin Dārbhya.
कैश्य: कैश्य, अम्, n. (fr. केश), the whole mass of hair, a head of hair, much or ornamented hair.
कैशोर: कैशोर कैशोर, अम्, n. (fr. किशोर), youth, boyhood, from the age of ten to that of fifteen. —कैशोरक-वयस्, अस्, n. the age or life of a youth.
कैष्किन्ध: कैष्किन्ध कैष्किन्ध, अस्, ई, अम्, coming from Kiṣkindhā.
को: को को, a prefix in a number of words, as in को-जागर, को-मल, को-विद, &c., related to 1. कु; [cf. the prefixes क, कव, का, किम्, कु।]
कोक: कोक कोक, अस्, m. (an onomatopoetic word), a wolf; a cuckoo; the ruddy goose; a frog; a small lizard or chameleon; a kind of noxious parasitical animal; the wild date tree; an epithet of Viṣṇu; N. of a man, a son of Śoṇa; N. of a river. —कोक-देव, अस्, m. a pigeon. —कोक-नख, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —कोक-बन्धु, उस्, m. the friend of the Cakravāka or ruddy goose, an epithet of the sun. —कोक-यातु, उस्, m., Ved. a demon or ghost in the shape of a cuckoo. —कोक-वाच, अस्, m. a sort of animal living in caves, a fox (?). —कोक-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a very indecent treatise on the art of love, ascribed to a Paṇḍit named Koka. —कोकाग्र (°क-अग्°), अस्, m., N. of a plant, = समष्ठिल।
कोकड: कोकड कोकड, अस्, m. an animal of a brown colour, with a bushy tail, lurking in holes, perhaps a hare or fox.
कोकनद: कोकनद कोकनद, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (अम्), n. the red lotus; the red water-lily. —कोकनद-च्छवि, इस्, m. the colour of the red lotus; (इस्, इस्, इ), of the colour of the red lotus.
कोकरक: कोकरक कोकरक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
कोकलिक: कोकलिक कोकलिक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
कोकली: कोकली कोकली, f., N. of a woman.
कोकामुख: कोकामुख कोकामुख, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a Tīrtha.
कोकाह: कोकाह कोकाह, अस्, m. a white horse; (per-haps a foreign word.)
कोकिल: कोकिल कोकिल, अस्, m. (an onomatopoetic word; but by some said to be fr. rt. कुक्), the Kokila or Koïl, the black or Indian cuckoo, Cuculus Indicus; a kind of mouse; a kind of poisonous insect; a firebrand, a lighted coal; N. of a poet; N. of a Rājaputra; (आ), f. the female of a Kokila, (the Kokila or Koïl is frequently alluded to in Hindū poetry, and its musical cry is supposed to inspire pleasing and tender emotions.) —कोकिल-नयन, अस्, m. a plant bearing a dark black flower, Capparis Spinosa; it is also applied to Barleria Longifolia; [cf. कोकिलाक्ष।] —कोकिल-मैत्रावरुण, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the duties or office of the Maitrāvaruṇa priest at the Kaukilīṣṭi; (अम्), n. title of a treatise. —कोकिल-होत्र, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the duties or office of the Hotṛ priest at the Kaukilīṣṭi; (अम्), n. title of a treatise. —कोकिलाक्ष (°ल-अक्°), अस्, m. ‘having eyes like those of the Koïl,’ the plant Asteracantha Longifolia or Capparis Spinosa. —कोकिलाक्षक, अस्, m. the same plant. —कोकिला-माहात्म्य, अम्, n. title of a part of the Skanda-purāṇa. —कोकिलावास (°ल-आव्°), अस्, m. the Mango tree; [cf. आम्र।] —कोकि-लेक्षु (°ल-इक्°), उस्, m. the black variety of sugar-cane; [cf. कृष्णेक्षु।] —कोकिलेष्टा (°ल-इष्°), f., N. of a plant, = महा-जम्बू. —कोकिलोत्सव (°ल-उत्°), अस्, m. the Mango tree.
कोकिलक: कोकिलक, अस् or अम्, m. or n (?), N. of a metre of four lines, each containing seventeen syllables.
कोक्क्वोक: कोक्क्वोक कोक्क्वोक, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Rati-rahasya.
कोङ्क: कोङ्क कोङ्क, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
कोङ्कट: कोङ्कट कोङ्कट, अस्, m., N. of a scholiast on the Amara-koṣa; (a various reading has कोक्कट।)
कोङ्कण: कोङ्कण कोङ्कण, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people on the western shore of the Dekhan; (अम्), n. a kind of weapon; (आ), f. a female of the Koṅkaṇa people. —कोङ्कणा-वती, f., N. of a river. —कोङ्-कणा-सुत, अस्, m. an epithet of Paraśu-rāma, the son of Koṅkaṇā.
कोङ्कणक: कोङ्कणक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people on the western shore of the Dekhan.
कोङ्कार: कोङ्कार कोङ्-कार, अस्, m. the sound कोम्।
कोच: कोच कोच, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. कुच्), drying, becoming dry; (अस्), m. drying up, desiccation, aridity; a man of mixed caste, the offspring of a fisherman by a female of the butcher tribe.
कोजागर: कोजागर को-जागर, अस्, m. a kind of festi-val, the night of full moon in the month Āśvina (September — October), celebrated with various games; (according to some authorities from कः and जागर, ‘who is awake?’ the exclamation of Lakṣmī, who descending on this night, promised wealth to all that were awake; hence the night is spent in festivity and games of chance in honour of the goddess.)
कोञ्ज: कोञ्ज कोञ्ज, अस्, m. = कौञ्च, N. of a mountain.
कोट: कोट कोट, अस्, m. (rt. कुट्), a fort, a strong-hold; a shed, a hut [cf. कुट, कुटी]; crookedness, curvature; a beard. —कोट-चक्र, अम्, n. a sort of diagram.
कोटक: कोटक, अस्, ई, अम्, who or what curves or bends; (अस्), m. a builder of sheds or huts, a thatcher, a carpenter; a mixed caste, the son of a mason and of the daughter of a potter.
कोटर: कोटर, अस्, अम्, m. n. the hollow of a tree; a cave in general; (ई), f. a naked woman; an epithet of the goddess Durgā. —कोटरा-वण, अम्, n. a wood in which there are hollow trees.
कोटवी: कोटवी, f. a naked woman; a form of the goddess Durgā (represented naked).
कोटि: कोटि, इस् or ई, f. the curved end of a bow or of claws, &c.; the end or top of anything; the edge or point of a sword; the horns of the moon; the highest point, eminence, excellence; the highest number in the older system of numbers, viz. a Krore or ten millions; the complement of an arc to 90°; the side of a right-angled triangle; N. of a plant, Piring or Asparac, Medicago Esculenta, = कोटि-वर्षा. —कोटि-कर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a man. —कोटि-जित्, त्, m. a conqueror of ten millions; an epithet of the poet Kālidāsa. —कोटि-ज्या, f. the cosine of an angle in a right-angled triangle. —कोटि-तीर्थ, अस्, m., N. of a Tīrtha. —कोटि-द्वय, अम्, n. ‘the two ends,’ i. e. two alternatives. —कोटि-पात्र, अम्, n. a rudder or large oar used as one. —कोटि-पाल, अस्, m. the guard of a stronghold? (a wrong reading for कोट्ट-पाल ?). —कोटि-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —कोटि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with a point. —कोटि-वर्ष, अम्, n., N. of a city, Vāṇapura or Devikote, on the Coromandel coast; (आ), f. a plant used medicinally, either Medicago Esculenta or Trigonella Corni-culata. —कोटि-वेधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, striking an edge or point, i. e. performing the most difficult things. —कोटि-शस्, ind. by tens of millions, in innumerable multitudes. —कोटि-श्री, f. an epithet of the goddess Durgā. —कोटी-वर्ष, अम्, n., N. of the town Vāṇapura on the Coromandel coast; (आ), f. the plant Medicago Esculenta or Trigonella Corniculata; [cf. कोटि-वर्ष।] —कोटीश्वर (°टि-ईश्°), अस्, m. the lord of ten millions, a millionaire.
कोटि, इस्, f. a point or side in an argument.
कोटिक: कोटिक, अस्, आ, अम्, forming the highest point, top or summit of anything, placed in the highest position, e. g. मानुष-कोटिका, a princess; (अस्), m., scil. मण्डूक, a frog; an insect, coccinella of various kinds; N. of the son of a prince. —कोटि-कास्य (°क-आस्°), अस्, m., N. of a son of king Suratha.
कोटिर: कोटिर, अस्, m. the hair (collected on the forehead in the shape of a horn); an ichneumon, Viverra Ichneumon; an insect, coccinella of various kinds [cf. कोटिक]; an epithet of Indra.
कोटिश: कोटिश, अस्, m. a harrow; N. of a Nāga.
कोटीर: कोटीर, अस्, m. long entangled hair; a crest, a diadem.
कोटीश: कोटीश, अस्, m. a harrow; [cf. कोटिश।]
कोट्ट: कोट्ट कोट्ट, अस्, अम्, m. n. a fort, a castle, a stronghold; [cf. कोट।]
कोट्टवी: कोट्टवी कोट्टवी, f. (fr. को-आर्तव?), a naked woman; an epithet of Durgā; the mother of Vāṇa, an Asura; [cf. कोटवी, कौटवी, कोटरी।] —कोट्टवी-पुर, अम्, n., N. of the town Vāṇapura on the Coromandel coast; [cf. कोटि-वर्ष and कोटी-वर्ष।]
कोट्टार: कोट्टार कोट्टार, अस्, m. a fortified town, a stronghold; a pond; the stairs of a pond; a liber-tine; [cf. कोट्ट।]
कोठ: कोठ कोठ, अस्, m. (fr. कुष्ठ), a species of leprosy with large round spots; ringworm, im-petigo.
कोठर: कोठर कोठर, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = अङ्-कोट; [cf. कोटर।] —कोठर-पुष्पी, f. the plant Convolvulus Argenteus.
कोण: कोण कोण, अस्, m. a corner, an angle (= अश्रि); an intermediate point of the compass; the quill or bow of a lute, a fiddle-stick, &c.; a sort of musical instrument, a stringed musical instrument; a drum-stick; the sharp edge of a sword; a stick, a staff, a club; a N. of Maṅgala, the planet Mars; a N. of the planet Saturn (in this sense fr. the Gr. κρόνος). —कोण-कुण, अस्, m. a bug; [cf. कोल-कुण, उत्कुण, मत्कुण।] —कोण-वादिन्, ई, m. an epithet of Śiva. —कोण-स्पृग्-वृत्त, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a circle in contact with the angles of a figure; an exterior circle; one circumscribed. —को-णा-कोणि, ind. from angle to angle, from one corner to the other, cornerwise, diagonally; athwart.
कोणि: कोणि कोणि, इस्, इस्, इ, having a crooked arm; [cf. कुणि।]
कोणेरभट्ट: कोणेरभट्ट कोणेर-भट्ट, अस्, m. a N. of a son of Viṣṇu and father of Rudra-bhaṭṭa.
कोण्डभट्ट: कोण्डभट्ट कोण्ड-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of a grammarian.
कोथ: कोथ कोथ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. कुथ्), afflicted with pain, churned; (अस्), m. putrefaction, corrup-tion; a sore; gangrene; a disease of the eyes, inflammation and ulceration of the angles of the eyelids; churning.
कोदण्ड: कोदण्ड को-दण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. a bow; (अस्), m. an eyebrow (shaped like a bow); a creeping plant; N. of a country.
कोदण्डिन्: कोदण्डिन्, ई, इनी, इ, armed with a bow; an epithet of Śiva.
कोदार: कोदार कोदार, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), a kind of grain.
कोद्रव: कोद्रव कोद्रव, अस्, m. a species of grain eaten by the poor, Paspalum Scrobiculatum.
कोनालक: कोनालक कोनालक, अस्, आ, m. f. a kind of aquatic bird.
कोनालि: कोनालि कोनालि, इस्, m. or f. (?), a kind of plant.
कोन्तल: कोन्तल कोन्तल, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; [cf. कुन्तल।]
कोन्व: कोन्व कोन्व, अस्, m., N. of a mountain; [cf. कोल, कोल्लक, कोलगिरि, कोल्वगिरेय।]
कोन्वशिर: कोन्वशिर कोन्वशिर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a degraded warrior-tribe.
कोपन: कोपन, अस्, आ, अम्, inclined to passion, passionate, wrathful, angry; irritating, causing morbid irritation or disorder of the humours; (अस्), m., N. of an Asura; (अम्), n. irritating; becoming angry; (आ), f. a pas-sionate woman.
कोपनक: कोपनक, अम्, n. a kind of perfume; [cf. चोरक।]
कोपयिष्णु: कोपयिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, intending to exasperate, inclined to make angry.
कोपित: कोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, furious.
कोपिन्: कोपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, angry, passionate, wrathful; (at the end of a compound) irritating, stirring up; (ई), m. a bird called the water-pigeon (जल-पारावत).
कोपक्रम: कोपक्रम 2. कोपक्रम (क-उप्°), अम्, n. Brahmā's creation; see 3. क। (For 1. कोप-क्रम see under कोप above.)
कोपज्ञ: कोपज्ञ कोपज्ञ (क-उप्°), अम्, n. Brahmā's creation.
कोम: कोम कोम, अम्, n. = क्लोम, q. v.
कोमल: कोमल को-मल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. को = कु and मल fr. rt. म्लै, ‘easily fading away?’), tender, soft (opposed to कर्कश); bland, sweet, low; pleasing, agreeable, beautiful; (आ), f., N. of a plant; (अम्), n. water. —कोमल-गीत or कोमल-गीतक, अम्, n. a pleasing song. —कोमल-ता, f. or कोमल-त्व, अम्, n. softness, tenderness, agreeableness. —कोमल-स्वभाव, अस्, आ, अम्, tender-hearted.
कोमलक: कोमलक, अम्, n. the fibres of the stalk of a lotus.
कोमासिका: कोमासिका कोमासिका, f. a budding fruit; [cf. जालिका।]
कोम्य: कोम्य कोम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = काम्य, lovely (?).
कोयष्टि: कोयष्टि को-यष्टि, इस्, or कोयष्टिक, अस्, m. the lapwing; a small white crane, commonly called a paddy-bird.
कोर: कोर कोर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कुर्), a movable joint, as the fingers, the knee, &c.; amphi-arthrosis; a bud (see the next).
कोरक: कोरक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a bud, an unblown flower; the fibres of the stalk of a lotus; a species of perfume, commonly Cor (चोर); another perfume, a berry containing a resinous and fragrant substance; [cf. कक्कोलक।]
कोरकित: कोरकित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with buds.
कोरित: कोरित, अस्, आ, अम्, budded, sprouted; ground, pounded, comminuted.
कोरङ्गी: कोरङ्गी कोरङ्गी, f. small cardamoms; [cf. एला।]
कोरदूष: कोरदूष कोर-दूष or कोरदूषक, अस्, m. a kind of grain eaten especially by the poor, Paspalum Scrobiculatum. See कोद्रव।
कोरली: कोरली कोरली or कोरिला, f., N. of a town.
कोल: कोल कोल, अस्, m. a hog; a raft, a float, a boat; a kind of weapon; the breast, the haunch, the hip or flank, the lap [cf. क्रोड]; an embrace, embracing; N. of a plant (= चित्र, चित्रक); the planet Śani or Saturn; N. of a son of Ākrīḍa; N. of a degraded warrior-tribe; an outcast, one of a tribe degraded by Sagara from the military order; a man of a mixed caste; a barbarian, a Kol, a tribe inhabit-ing the hills and forests in central India; (आ or ई), f. the jujube tree, Zizyphus Jujuba; (आ), f. Piper Longum, and Piper Chaba (चव्य); (अम्), n. the fruit of the jujube; black pepper; the weight of one Tola; [cf. Lith. kuilys, kiaule; Hib. cullach; Gr. χοῖρος.] —कोल-कन्द, अस्, m. a sort of bulbous plant, used as a remedy for worms; [cf. कृमि-घ्न, पञ्जल, &c.] —कोल-कर्कटिका, f., N. of a plant, = मधु-खर्जूरिका. —कोल-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain. —कोल-दल, अम्, n. a kind of perfume, = नखी. —कोल-नासिका, f., N. of a plant, = वङ्-किणी. —कोल-पुच्छ, अस्, m. a heron. —कोल-मूल, अम्, n. the root of long pepper. —कोल-वल्ली, f. the plant Pothos Officinalis, a plant with a pungent fruit resembling pepper, = गज-पिप्पली; another plant, Piper Chaba (चव्य). —कोल-शिम्बी, f., N. of a plant, commonly called Ālakuśī, Carpopogon Pruri-ens; [cf. कृत-फला, खट्वा, &c.] —कोला-कोलि, ind. with mutual embraces. —कोलाञ्च (°ल-अञ्°), अस्, m. a N. of Kaliṅga, the Coromandel coast from Cuttack to Madras; but, according to some, this place is in Gangetic Hindūstan, with Kanouj for the capital. —कोला-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
कोलक: कोलक, अस्, m., N. of two plants, = अङ्कोठ and बहु-वार; (अम्), n. a kind of perfume, = कक्को-लक; black pepper.
कोलकिल: कोलकिल कोलकिल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a town; (also read किलकिल, किलिनकिल, कोलिकिल।)
कोलकुण: कोलकुण कोलकुण, अस्, m. a bug; [cf. कोणकुण, उत्कुण, मत्कुण।]
कोलम्बक: कोलम्बक कोलम्बक, अस्, m. (fr. को + लम्-बक ?), the body of a lute, the whole of it except the strings.
कोलाहल: कोलाहल कोलाहल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (an onomatopoetic word), a loud and confused sound, an uproar, a great and indistinct noise (of men, animals, &c.); (अस्), m., N. of a personified moun-tain.
कोलि: कोलि कोलि, इस्, इस् or ई, m. f. the jujube tree, Zizyphus Jujuba; [cf. कर्कन्धु।] —कोलि-सर्प, अस्, m., N. of a degraded warrior-tribe.
कोलिकिल: कोलिकिल कोलिकिल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a town (?); [cf. कोलकिल।]
कोलित: कोलित कोलित, अस्, m. an epithet of Maud-galyāyana.
कोलुह: कोलुह कोलुह, अस्, m., N. of a man.
कोलूक: कोलूक कोलूक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a country; also कोलूत and शैलूत; [cf. उलूक, उलूट, उतूल, कुलूट, कुलूत, कौलूत।]
कोल्या: कोल्या कोल्या, f. Piper Longum; [cf. कोला।]
कोल्लक: कोल्लक कोल्लक, अस्, m., N. of a mountain; [cf. कोन्व, कोन्वशिर, कोल, कोलगिरि, कोल्वगि-रेय।] —कोल्ल-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain.
कोल्वगिरेय: कोल्वगिरेय कोल्व-गिरेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
कोविद: कोविद को-विद, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. को and rt. विद्, to know), experienced, skilled, learned, wise (with loc., gen., and at the end of comp., e. g. अश्वेषु or अश्वानाम् or अश्व-कोविद, skilled in horses).
कोविदार: कोविदार को-विदार, अस्, m. a tree, Bauhinia Variegata; also one of the trees of paradise.
कोश: कोश कोश, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. rt. कुश् or कुष् ?, related to कुक्षि and कोष्ठ?; in the earlier literature generally spelt कोश; later books read both कोश and कोष), a cask, a vessel for holding liquids; (metaphorically) a cloud; a pail; a bucket; a drink-ing-vessel, a cup, a vessel in general; a box, a cup-board, a drawer, a trunk; the interior or inner part of a carriage; a sheath, a scabbard, &c.; a case, a covering, a cover; store-room, store, provisions; a treasury, the apartment where money or plate is kept; treasure, accumulated wealth, money; gold or silver, wrought or unwrought, as plate, jewellery, &c.; a kind of bandage (in surgery); a dictionary, lexicon, or vocabulary; a bud; the sheath or integument of a plant; a pod or any similar seed-vessel; a nutmeg, a nut-shell; the inner part of the fruit Artocarpus Integrifolia; the cocoon of a silk-worm; the vulva, the womb; the penis; a testicle or the scrotum; an egg; (in the Vedānta philosophy) a term for the three sheaths or succession of cases which make up the various frames of the body enveloping the soul, (these are, 1. the आनन्द-मयः कोशः or ‘sheath of pleasure,’ forming the कारण-शरीर or ‘causal frame;’ 2. the विज्ञान-मयः or बुद्धि-मयः or मनो-मयः or प्राण-मयः कोशः, ‘the sheath of intellect or will or life,’ forming the सूक्ष्म-शरीर or ‘subtile frame;’ 3. the अन्न-मयः कोशः, ‘the sheath of nourishment,’ forming the स्थूल-शरीर or ‘gross frame’); a ball or globe (e. g. सूत्र-कोष, a ball of thread; नेत्र-कोष, the eye-ball &c.); judicial trial, ordeal by fire, water, poison, the balance, heated balls of iron, boiling oil &c., attesting a deity with thrice-repeated drinking of the water in which some idol has been washed; the water used at an ordeal; an oath; (आ), f., N. of a river; (ई), f. a bud; a seed-vessel; the beard of corn; a shoe, a sandal; [cf. Hib. gucog, ‘a bud, a sprout;’ Gr. κόκκος] —कोश-कार, अस्, m. one who makes scabbards, cases, boxes, &c.; the compiler of a diction-ary, a lexicographer; the silk-worm or the insect while in its cocoon; a chrysalis or pupa; a variety of sugar-cane or sugar-cane in general. —कोश-कारक, अस्, m. a silk-worm. —कोश-कृत्, त्, m. a kind of sugar-cane. —कोश-गृह, अम्, n. a treasury; a room in which valuable garments, precious stones &c. are kept. —कोश-ग्रहण, अम्, n. undergoing an ordeal. —कोश-चञ्चु, उस्, m. the Indian crane. —कोश-नायक, अस्, m. a chief over treasure, a treasurer; an epithet of Kuvera. —कोश-पाल, अस्, m. the guardian of a treasure. —कोश-पेटक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a chest or strong box in which treasure is kept. —कोश-फल, अस्, m. a kind of creeping plant [cf. घोषक]; (आ), f. a Cucurbitaceous plant, = पीत-घोषा; the plant Cucumis Utilissimus, = त्रपुषी; (अम्), n. a kind of perfume, a berry containing a waxy and fragrant substance; a nutmeg. —कोश-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, treasured, stored, accumulated. —कोश-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing treasures, rich, wealthy; (ती), f., N. of a kind of plant. —कोश-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, living in a shell, wrapped up in a sheath or shell, incased; (ई), m. any animal so incased, a chrysalis or pupa. —कोश-वृद्धि, इस्, f. swelled testicle, enlargement of the scrotum from hernia or hydrocele &c. —कोश-वेश्मन्, अ, n. a treasury. —कोश-शायिका, f. a clasp-knife or one lying in a sheath. —कोश-शुद्धि, इस्, f. purification by ordeal. —कोश-स्कृत्, त्, m. a silk-worm. —कोश-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, incased, sheathed, enveloped in a sheath or shell &c.; (अस्), m. any shelled insect or animal, as a snail &c.; a pupa or chrysalis; the silk-worm in its cocoon. —कोश-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, without treasure, deprived of riches, poor. —कोशांश (°श-अं°), अस्, m. part of a trea-sure, a portion of any one's wealth. —कोशागार (°श-आग्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. a treasure-house, store-room, treasury. —कोशाङ्ग (°श-अङ्°), अस्, m. a kind of reed or grass, commonly Ikāda; [cf. उत्कट।] —कोशाधिपति (°श-अध्°), इस्, or कोशाधीश or कोशाध्यक्ष (°श-अध्°), अस्, m. a superintendent of the treasury, a treasurer, a paymaster; an epithet of Kuvera. —कोशापहरण (°श-अप्°), अम्, n. car-rying off treasure. —कोशाम्र (°श-आम्°), अस्, m., N. of a plant, = कृमि-वृक्ष, सुकेशक, commonly कोशाम; (अम्), n. the fruit of this plant, Vulg. keuḍā (= keurā? Sonneratia Apetala?).
कोशक: कोशक, अस्, m. an egg, a testicle.
कोशयी: कोशयी, f., Ved. a chest, a box; the interior of a carriage (?). According to Sāy. = कोश।
कोशिन्: कोशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, incased (आम-कोशिन्, having the cavity of the ear filled up); (ई), m. the mango tree; [cf. आम्र।]
कोशिला: कोशिला, f. a kind of bean [cf. मुद्ग-पर्णी]; N. of a river.
कोशल: कोशल कोशल and कोशला। See under कोसल।
कोशलिक: कोशलिक कोशलिक, अम्, n. a bribe; (wrong reading for कौशलिक, q. v.)
कोशातक: कोशातक कोशातक or कोषातक, अस्, m. (fr. कोश?), hair; (ई), f. several Cucurbitaceous plants, Trichosanthes Diœca, Luffa Acutangula, and Luffa Pentandra; the fruits of these plants; a moonlight night.
कोशातकिन्: कोशातकिन् कोशातकिन्, ई, m. (fr. the pre-ceding ?), trade, business; a trader, a merchant; submarine fire.
कोश्य: कोश्य कोश्य, औ or ए (?), m. or n. (?), du., Ved. two lumps of flesh near the heart of a sacrificial horse.
कोष: कोष कोष with its compounds, see under कोश, for which कोष is only a later form.
कोषला: कोषला कोषला, wrongly spelt for कोसला।
कोष्ठ: कोष्ठ कोष्ठ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कुष्; probably related to कुक्षि and कोश), any one of the viscera of the body, as the stomach, heart, lungs, &c., but particularly the stomach; the belly, bowels, abdomen; an inner apartment; a granary, a place in which grain is kept, a store-room, a treasury; (अम्), n. a sur-rounding wall; a kind of vessel; the shell of any-thing; (अस्, आ, अम्), own. —कोष्ठ-कोटि, इस्, m., N. of an attendant of Śiva. —कोष्ठ-पाल, अस्, m. a municipal officer, a constable; a watch, a guard, the watch of a city; a storekeeper, a treasurer. —कोष्ठ-वत्, आन्, m., N. of a mountain. —कोष्-ठ-शुद्धि, इस्, f. dejection by stool, evacuation of the bowels. —कोष्ठागार (°ठ-अग्° or आग्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. a store-room, a store; a treasury. —कोष्ठागारिक, अस् or आ (?), m. or f. (?), a kind of animal, any animal living in a shell. —कोष्ठा-गारिन्, ई, m. a kind of poisonous insect. —कोष्-ठाग्नि (°ठ-अग्°), इस्, m. the digestive faculty, the gastric juice. —कोष्ठी-प्रदीप, अस्, m., N. of a work on astronomy.
कोष्ठक: कोष्ठक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a granary, a treasury [cf. अन्न-कोष्ठक]; a surrounding wall; (अम्), n. a brick trough for watering cattle; N. of a town.
कोष्ठकीकृ: कोष्ठकी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to surround, enclose.
कोष्ठिल: कोष्ठिल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
कोष्ठ्य: कोष्ठ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, proceeding from the chest or interior of the body, emitted (as a sound) from the centre of the lungs.
कोष्ण: कोष्ण कोष्ण (का-उष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, mode-rately warm, tepid, warm; (अम्), n. warmth; [cf. कवोष्ण, कदुष्ण।]
कोसल: कोसल कोसल, अस्, m. (in later books gene-rally spelt कोशल), N. of a country and the warrior-tribe inhabiting it, descendants of Māthava Videgha; (आ), f., N. of the capital of this country or Ayodhyā, the modern Oude. —कोसलात्मजा (°ल-आत्°), f. the daughter of the king of the Kosalas, an epithet of a wife of Daśa-ratha, the mother of Rāma.
कोहड: कोहड कोहड, अस्, m., N. of a man; [cf. कौहड and कोहल।]
कोहल: कोहल कोहल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. को + हल? cf. कुतूहल), speaking indistinctly; (अस्), m. a kind of musical instrument; a sort of spirituous liquor; N. of a saint or Muni, the inventor or first teacher of the drama, also a writer on music.
कोहलीय: कोहलीय, अम्, n. title of Kohala's work on music.
कोहित: कोहित कोहित, अस्, m., N. of a man.
कौकुट्टक: कौकुट्टक कौकुट्टक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (variously written कौकुन्तक and कौ-कुन्दक।)
कौकुर: कौकुर कौकुर, आस्, m. pl. (fr. कुकुर), N. of a people.
कौकुवादि: कौकुवादि कौकुवादि, इस्, m., N. of a man.
कौकूस्त: कौकूस्त कौकूस्त, अस्, m., N. of a man.
कौकृत्य: कौकृत्य कौकृत्य, अम्, n. (fr. कु-कृत or कु-कृत्य), evil doing, wickedness; repentance.
कौक्कुट: कौक्कुट कौक्कुट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुक्कुट), relating to a cock or domestic fowl, gallinaceous.
कौक्कुटिक: कौक्कुटिक, अस्, m. a poulterer, one who sells fowls; a kind of mendicant, one who walks with his eyes fixed on the ground for fear of treading upon insects &c.; a hypocrite.

कौक्ष: कौक्ष कौक्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुक्षि), abdo-minal, ventral.
कौक्षेय: कौक्षेय, अस्, ई, अम्, being in the belly; being in a sheath.
कौक्षेयक: कौक्षेयक, अस्, m. a sword; a scymitar.
कौङ्क: कौङ्क कौङ्क, अस्, m. the country Koṅka, = कोङ्क, कोङ्कण।
कौङ्कण: कौङ्कण, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; the dis-trict of Koṅkan in the peninsula.
कौङ्किण: कौङ्किण, आस्, m. pl. = कौङ्कण above.
कौङ्कुम: कौङ्कुम कौङ्कुम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुङ्कुम), relating to the saffron flower.
कौचवार्य: कौचवार्य कौचवार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, coming from Kūcavāra.
कौञ्च: कौञ्च कौञ्च, अस्, m., N. of a mountain, part of the Himālaya range; [cf. क्रौञ्च।]
कौञ्जर: कौञ्जर कौञ्जर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुञ्जर), belonging to an elephant; (अस्), m., N. of a race.
कौञ्जायन: कौञ्जायन कौञ्जायन, आस्, m. pl. (fr. कुञ्ज), N. of a mountain-tribe, descended from Kuñja; (ई), f. a princess of this tribe; a female descendant of Kuñja; the wife of a Brāhman or any venerable personage.
कौञ्जायन्य: कौञ्जायन्य, अस्, m. a prince of the mountain-tribe called Kauñjāyana.
कौट: कौट 1. कौट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुटि), living in one's own house, independant, free; domestic, homely, home-born, home-bred; (अस्), m. = कुटज, the plant Wrightia Antidysenterica. —कौट-तक्ष, अस्, m. an independant carpenter, one who works at home on his own account and not for the village or cor-poration.
कौट 2. कौट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कूट), snared, wired; fraudulent, dishonest; (अम्), n. fraud, false-hood. —कौट-साक्षिन्, ई, m. a false witness, = कूट-साक्षिन्. —कौटसाक्ष्य, अम्, n. false evidence.
कौटकिक: कौटकिक, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose occupation is to catch animals in traps, caves, &c.; (अस्), m. a vender of the flesh of birds or beasts, a poacher, a butcher, &c.; [cf. कौटिक।]
कौटिक: कौटिक, अस्, ई, अम्, one whose business is to catch animals in traps &c.; one who kills animals and sells their flesh for his own subsistence, a hunter, a poacher, a mountaineer, &c.; relating to a snare or trap; fraudulent, dishonest.
कौटज: कौटज कौटज, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुटज), coming from the plant Wrightia Antidysenterica; (अस्), m. the plant Wrightia Antidysenterica. —कौटज-भा-रिक, अस्, आ, अम्, carrying or bearing a load of Wrightia Antidysenterica.
कौटजिक: कौटजिक, अस्, ई, अम्, carrying a load of Wrightia Antidysenterica.
कौटभी: कौटभी कौटभी, f. an epithet of the god-dess Durgā; [cf. कैटभी।]
कौटल्य: कौटल्य कौटल्य, अस्, m. an epithet of Cāṇakya; also called Vātsyāyana; [cf. कौटिल्य।]
कौटवी: कौटवी कौटवी, f. a naked woman; [cf. कोट्टवी।]
कौटिलिक: कौटिलिक कौटिलिक, अस्, m. (fr. कुटिलिका), a hunter; a blacksmith.
कौटिल्य: कौटिल्य कौटिल्य, अस्, m. (fr. कुटिल), an epithet of Cāṇakya [cf. कौटल्य]; N. of a gram-marian; (अम्), n. crookedness, curvature, curliness of the hair; falsehood, fraudulent behaviour, dis-honesty, deceit, insincerity; a kind of horse-radish.
कौटीर: कौटीर कौटीर, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the plant Kuṭīra, made of it.
कौटीर्या: कौटीर्या, f. an epithet of Durgā, ‘living in a hut (?).’
कौटुम्ब: कौटुम्ब कौटुम्ब, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुटुम्ब), necessary for the household; (अम्), n. family relation-ship.
कौटुम्बिक: कौटुम्बिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to a family, constituting a family; having relations; (अस्), m. the father or master of a family.
कौडविक: कौडविक कौडविक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुडव), sown with a particular measure (a Kuḍava) of grain (as a field &c.), containing a Kuḍava.
कौडोदरि: कौडोदरि कौडोदरि, इस्, m. (or कौण्डोदरि fr. कुण्डोदर ?), N. of a man.
कौड्य: कौड्य कौड्य, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
कौणकुत्स्य: कौणकुत्स्य कौणकुत्स्य, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman; [cf. कूण-कुच्छ।]
कौणप: कौणप कौणप, अस्, m. (fr. कुणप), ‘feed-ing upon corpses,’ a Rākṣasa or goblin; N. of a Nāga (these beings are supposed to eat human flesh). —कौणप-दन्त, अस्, m. an epithet of Bhīṣma, uncle of the Pāṇḍus. —कौणपाशन (°प-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a Nāga.
कौणिन्द: कौणिन्द कौणिन्द, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (अस्), m. sing. a prince of this people.
कौणेय: कौणेय कौणेय, अस्, m. (fr. कुणि?), Ved. a patronymic of Rajana.
कौण्डल: कौण्डल कौण्डल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुण्डल), furnished with rings.
कौण्डिन्य: कौण्डिन्य कौण्डिन्य, अस्, m., N. of a Muni or divine sage; N. of a grammarian; a patronymic of the poet Jaya-deva.
कौण्डिल्यक: कौण्डिल्यक कौण्डिल्यक, अस्, m. (or कौण्-डिन्यक ?), a kind of poisonous insect.
कौण्डोपरथ: कौण्डोपरथ कौण्डोपरथ, आस्, m. pl. (fr. कुण्डोपरथ), N. of a warrior-tribe.
कौण्डोपरथीय: कौण्डोपरथीय, अस्, m. a prince of this tribe.
कौण्य: कौण्य कौण्य, अम्, n. (fr. कुणि), distortion or paralysis of the hands; the being maimed or handless.
कौतुक: कौतुक कौतुक, अम्, n. (fr. कुतुक), curi-osity, interest in anything, vehement desire for, wish, inclination; eagerness, vehemence, impatience; any-thing causing curiosity, admiration or interest, any singular or surprising object, a wonder; festivity, gaiety, a festival, a show, a solemn ceremony, espe-cially the ceremony with the marriage-thread or ring preceding a marriage; the marriage-thread or ring; joy, pleasure, happiness, enjoyment; sport, pastime; public diversion; song, dance, show or spectacle; season of enjoyment; kind or friendly greeting, civility, salutation. —कौतुक-क्रिया, f. a solemn ceremony, a marriage ceremony. —कौतुक-गृह, अम्, n. the house in which a marriage takes place. —कौतुक-तोरण, अस्, अम्, m. n. a triumphal arch erected at certain festivals. —कौतुक-मङ्-गल, अम्, n. a solemn ceremony. —कौतुकागार (°क-अग्°, or आग्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. a room for festivity, a room in which a marriage ceremony takes place.
कौतुकित: कौतुकित, अस्, आ, अम्, eagerly interested, eager.
कौतुकिन्: कौतुकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, festive, gay, jocose, a jester.
कौतूहल: कौतूहल कौतूहल, अम्, n. (fr. कुतूहल), curiosity, interest in anything, vehement desire for anything, eagerness, vehemence; anything causing curiosity, any unusual phenomenon; a solemn cere-mony. —कौतूहल-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, curious, in-quisitive. —कौतूहलान्वित (°ल-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, eager, vehement, curious.
कौतोमत: कौतोमत कौतोमत, अम्, n. (fr. कुतस् + मत), N. of a Sūkta (?).
कौत्स: कौत्स कौत्स, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुत्स), composed by Kutsa; (अम्), n. a Sūkta or Sāman composed by Kutsa; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Kutsa; N. of a teacher; N. of a pupil of Vara-tantu; the son-in-law of Bhagīratha; a patronymic of Jaimini; N. of a degraded family. —कौत्सी-पुत्र, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.
कौथुम: कौथुम कौथुम, आस्, m. pl. the pupils of Kuthumin.
कौदालिक: कौदालिक कौदालिक or कौदालीक, अस्, m. (fr. कुदाल), a man of a mixed caste, the son of a fisherman by a woman of the washerman caste.
कौद्रविक: कौद्रविक कौद्रविक, अम्, n. (fr. कोद्रव), sochal salt.
कौद्रवीण: कौद्रवीण, अस्, आ, अम्, sown with Kodrava (as a field &c.).
कौनख्य: कौनख्य कौनख्य, अम्, n. (fr. कु-नखिन्), the condition of one who has a disease of the nails; ugliness of the nails. —कौनख्यादिक (°य-आद्°), अम्, n. neglect of personal decoration.
कौन्तिक: कौन्तिक कौन्तिक, अस्, m. (fr. कुन्त), a spearman, a soldier armed with a spear.
कौन्ती: कौन्ती कौन्ती, f. (fr. कुन्त or कुन्ति), a sort of perfume, commonly रेणुक।
कौन्तेय: कौन्तेय कौन्तेय, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. कुन्ती), a N. of Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhīma-sena, and Arjuna; N. of a tree = अर्जुन।
कौन्त्य: कौन्त्य कौन्त्य, अस्, m. a king of the Kuntis.
कौन्द: कौन्द कौन्द, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुन्द), relating to or coming from jasmine.
कौप: कौप कौप, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कूप), coming from a well or cistern; (अम्), n. well-water.
कौपीन: कौपीन, अम्, n. the pudenda; a privity, a privy part; a small piece of cloth worn over the privities by poor persons; a wrong or improper act, sin. —कौपीन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has only a piece of cloth over the privities.
कौप्य: कौप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, coming from a well or cistern.
कौपोदकी: कौपोदकी कौपोदकी, f. the mace of Kṛṣṇa, = कौमोदकी; [also कौपादकी ?].
कौब्ज्य: कौब्ज्य कौब्ज्य, अम्, n. (fr. कुब्ज), crooked-ness, hump-backedness.
कौम: कौम कौम, अम्, n., N. of a Vedic treatise, so named from its author.
कौमार: कौमार कौमार, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुमार or कुमारी), juvenile, youthful, girlish, belonging to a youth or young girl, maiden, maidenly, virgin, (कौ-मारी भार्या, a virgin wife, one who has not had a husband previously; कौमारः पतिः, a man who marries a virgin; कौमारं व्रतम्, a vow of abstinence); soft, tender; relating to the god of war or Sanat-kumāra, belonging or peculiar to them; (ई), f. one of the seven divine Mātṛs, the divine mothers or personified energies of the gods, the energy or शक्ति of Kumāra or Kārttikeya the god of war; a kind of bulbous plant, = वाराही-कन्द; (अम्), n. childhood, youth from birth to the age of five; maidenhood to the age of sixteen. —कौमार-पर्वत, अस्, m., N. of a mountain. —कौमार-भृत्य, अम्, n. the rearing and education of chil-dren, a department of medical science; [cf. कुमार-भृत्या।] —कौमारराज्य, अम्, n. (fr. कुमार-राज = राज-कुमार, युव-राज), the position of an heir-apparent; [cf. यौवराज्य।]
कौमारक: कौमारक, अम्, n. childhood, the juvenile age.
कौमारिक: कौमारिक, अस्, ई, अम्, endowed with girls; (अस्), m. a father of girls. —कौमारिक-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra.
कौमुद: कौमुद कौमुद, अस्, m. (fr. कुमुद), the month Kārttika, October-November; (ई), f. moon-light, moonshine (from its causing the Kumudas to blossom); elucidation, (the word Kaumudī being metaphorically used like other words of similar im-port (चन्द्रिका) at the end of the title of grammatical commentaries and other explanatory works to imply that the book so designated throws much light on the subject of which it treats, e. g. पदार्थ-कौ-मुदी, प्रक्रिया-क्°, लघु-क्°, वैषम्य-क्°, सिद्-धान्त-क्°); the day of full moon in the month Kārttika, sacred to the god Kārttikeya; the day of full moon in the month Āśvina; a festival in honour of Kārttikeya held on the full moon of the month Kārttika; a festival in general; N. of a metre con-sisting of two lines of twenty-four syllables each; N. of a river. —कौमुदी-चार, अस्, अम्, m. n. the day of full moon in the month Āśvina. —कौमुदी-पति, इस्, m. the moon. —कौमुदी-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the stick or stand of a lamp.
कौमुदिक: कौमुदिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to a water-lily, abounding with them; (इका), f., N. of a female friend of Umā.
कौमोदकी: कौमोदकी कौमोदकी, f. (fr. कुमोदक), N. of the club or mace of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa, given to him by Varuṇa.
कौमोदी: कौमोदी, f. the club or mace of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.
कौम्भ: कौम्भ कौम्भ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुम्भ), put into a pot.
कौम्भकारि: कौम्भकारि, इस्, m. or कौम्भकार्य, अस्, m. the son of a potter.
कौरम: कौरम कौरम, अस्, m., N. of a man; (a various reading has कौरुम।)
कौरयाण: कौरयाण कौरयाण, अस्, m. (fr. कुरयाण), a patronymic of Pāka-sthāman.
कौरव: कौरव कौरव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुरु), belong-ing to the Kurus &c.; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Kuru; a descendant of Kuru; also कौरवक।
कौरवायणि: कौरवायणि, इस्, or कौरवेय, अस्, m. a patro-nymic from Kuru.
कौरव्य: कौरव्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from Kuru; a descendant of Kuru; N. of a Nāga, father of Ulūpī.
कौरव्यायणी: कौरव्यायणी, f. a female descendant of Kuru. —कौरव्यायणी-पुत्र, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.
कौरुकत्य: कौरुकत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the family of the Kurus and Katas.
कौरुकुल्लक: कौरुकुल्लक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a Buddhist sect.
कौरुपञ्चाल: कौरुपञ्चाल, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the race of the Kurus and Pañcālas.
कौरुपथि: कौरुपथि, इस्, m. (fr. कुरु-पथ), N. of a teacher.
कौर्पर: कौर्पर कौर्पर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कूर्पर), being at the elbow.
कौर्प्य: कौर्प्य कौर्प्य, अस्, m. (a word borrowed from the Gr. σκοπρίος), the sign of the zodiac Scorpio.
कौर्म: कौर्म कौर्म, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कूर्म), belong-ing or relating to a tortoise, connected with a tortoise, acting as one; belonging or relating to the Avatāra of Viṣṇu as a tortoise; (अस्), m., N. of a Kalpa, the day of full moon of Brahmā; (अम्), n., scil. पुराणम्, title of a Purāṇa on the subject of Viṣṇu's descent as a tortoise. —कौर्मोपपुराण (°म-उप्°), अम्, n., N. of an Upa-purāṇa.
कौल: कौल कौल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुल), belonging or relating to a family, ancestral, extending over a whole family or race, sprung from a noble family, of a good family, well-born; (अस्), m. a worshipper of Śakti according to the left-hand ritual; (अम्), n. the doctrine and practices of the left-hand Śāktas. —कौ-लोपनिषद् (°ल-उप्°), त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad.
कौलकेय: कौलकेय, अस्, ई, अम्, sprung from a noble family, of a good family, well-born; (अस्), m. a bastard; (wrong form for कौलटेय।)
कौलत्थ: कौलत्थ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुलत्थ), made or prepared with or consisting of Dolichos Uniflorus; (अम्), n. a drink prepared with Kulattha.
कौलत्थीन: कौलत्थीन, अस्, आ, अम्, sown with Dolichos Uniflorus (as a field).
कौलिक: कौलिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to a family or race, customary in a family, ancestral, heritable in the family; (अस्), m. a weaver; a heretic, an im-postor; a follower of the left-hand Śākta ritual.
कौलीन: कौलीन, अस्, आ, अम्, peculiar or belonging to a noble family; (अस्), m. the son of a female beggar; a follower of the left-hand Śākta ritual; (अम्), n. rumour, report; evil report, detraction; family scan-dal; combat of animals, of birds, snakes, &c.; cock-fighting, &c.; contention of animals as a species of gambling; a privity, a privy part, the pudenda; high birth, family descent; an improper act, a bad deed.
कौलीन्य: कौलीन्य, अम्, n. high birth, nobility; family honour; family trouble, family scandal.
कौलेय: कौलेय, अस्, ई, अम्, sprung from a noble family; of the left-hand Śākta sect; [cf. कौल, कौलिक, कौलीन।]
कौलेयक: कौलेयक, अस्, ई, अम्, sprung from a noble family, of good parentage; pertaining to a family; (अस्), m. a dog (a domestic animal).
कौल्य: कौल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from a noble family, of good family or parentage; of the left-hand Śākta sect.
कौल्य; add — (अम्), n. noble origin, good family.
कौलटिनेय: कौलटिनेय कौलटिनेय, अस्, ई, m. f. (fr. कुलटा), the son or daughter of a female beggar; a bastard.
कौलटेय: कौलटेय, अस्, ई, m. f. the child of a female beggar; a bastard, the child of a disloyal wife.
