(e. g. क्व नु ते क्षत्रियाः शूराः, where now are those Kṣatriya heroes ?); क्व appears to be used as a loc. of 2. क in Manu X. 66. (e. g. क्व श्रेयस्-त्वम्, in whom is the preference?); क्व with भू, अस्, or गत, may denote, how is it with? what has become of? (e. g. क्व अहम् भवानि, what will become of me? क्व गतस् तव मय्य् अनुरागः, what has become of your affection for me?), or क्व alone may have the same meaning (e. g. क्व सुखम्, where is happiness? i. e. there is no such thing as happiness); क्व — क्व or कुत्र — क्व implies ex-cessive incongruity, where is this? where is that? how distant is this from that, how little does this agree with that (e. g. क्व शूर्य-प्रभवो वंशः क्व च अल्प-विषया मतिः, how can my limited intellect describe the solar race?); क्वापि (क्व अपि), anywhere, somewhere, to some place, to any place, in a certain place; sometimes; क्व च, anywhere, somewhere, at any time; क्व च न, anywhere (originally negative); न क्वचन, nowhere; क्व-चिद्, anywhere, somewhere, to any place, in a certain place; in a certain case, sometimes; at some time, once upon a time; क्वचिद् — क्वचिद्, here — there, here and there, in various places; now — then, now and then; न क्वचिद्, nowhere, never, by no means; यत्र क्वापि or यत्र क्वच, wherever, whereso-ever, to whatsoever place, anywhere; यत्र क्व-चन, to whatsoever place, hither and thither, any-where; whenever, at any time, when, in any case or matter whatever; यत्र क्व वाथ — तत्र तत्रापि, wherever — there. —क्व-जन्मन्, आ, आ, अ, where born? —क्व-निवास, अस्, आ, अम्, where dwelling?
क्वत्य: क्वत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, or क्वत्यक, अस्, इका, अम्, of or belonging to where or what place? being where?
क्वङ्गु: क्वङ्गु क्वङ्गु, उस्, m. = कङ्गु, a sort of Panic, Panicum Italicum.
क्वण्: क्वण् क्वण्, cl. 1. P. क्वणति, चक्वाण, क्वणितुम्, to sound; to hum (as a bee); to make any sound; to tinkle: Caus. क्वणयति, यितुम्, to cause to sound, to make sound, to twang, to produce a sound with anything; e. g. नूपुरैः, with anklet ornaments; [cf. Lat. cano; Goth. hana, ‘a cock.’]
क्वण: क्वण, अस्, m. the sound or tone of any musical instrument; sound in general.
क्वणन: क्वणन, अम्, n. sounding, the sound of any musical instrument; (अस्), m. a small earthen pot or boiler.
क्वणित: क्वणित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, twanged (as a stringed instrument); (अम्), n. sound, twang.
क्वाण: क्वाण, अस्, m. the sound of a musical instrument; sound in general.
क्वथ्: क्वथ् क्वथ्, cl. 1. P. क्वथति, चक्वाथ, क्वथिष्यति, अक्वथीत्, क्वथितुम्, to boil, stew, decoct, prepare by heat; to digest: Caus. क्वाथयति, -यितुम्, to cause to boil, to boil, decoct.
क्वथ: क्वथ, अस्, m. a decoction, an extract.
क्वथित: क्वथित, अस्, आ, अम्, boiled, decocted, stewed, digested.
क्वाथ: क्वाथ, अस्, m. a decoction, any solution or infusion prepared with a continued or gentle heat; the mixture of the materials for a decoction; pain, sorrow, cala-mity, distress. —क्वाथोद्भव (°थ-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, produced by boiling; (अम्), n. blue vitriol used as a collyrium.
क्वधःस्थ: क्वधःस्थ क्व्-अधः-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 2. कु-अधस्-स्थ), Ved. standing below on the earth.
क्वयि: क्वयि क्वयि, इस्, m., Ved. a kind of bird.
क्वल: क्वल क्वल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), Ved. a substance used for coagulating other substances.
क्वाचित्क: क्वाचित्क क्वाचित्क, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. क्व-चित्), met with somewhere or occasionally; rare, un-common.
क्वाथि: क्वाथि क्वाथि, इस्, m., Ved. an epithet of Agastya.
क्वापि: क्वापि क्वापि, ind. somewhere, &c. See क्व।
क्वेल्: क्वेल् क्वेल्, cl. 1. P. क्वेलति, to shake or move; (a less correct form for क्ष्वेल्।)
क्शा: क्शा क्शा, a root forming, according to native grammarians, some tenses of ख्या and चक्ष् (e. g. the Fut. क्शास्यति; Inf. क्शातुम्; Aor. अक्शासीत्, अक्शास्त; Perf. चक्शे).
क्ष: क्ष क्ष, अस्, m. (fr. 4. क्षि), destruction; loss, disappearance; destruction of the world; lightning; a field; the protector or cultivator of a field, a peasant, a husbandman; a demon or Rakṣas; the fourth in-carnation of Viṣṇu as the man-lion or नर-सिंह।
क्षज्: क्षज् क्षज् or क्षञ्ज्, cl. 1. A. क्षजते or क्षञ्जते, चक्षञ्जे, क्षञ्जितुम्, to go, approach; to give; cl. 10. P. क्षञ्जयति, -यि-तुम्, to live in distress; to live in pain or want.
क्षण: क्षण क्षण, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be a corruption of ईक्षण, a glance, and not used in the earlier literature; native lexicographers make this word m. only), any instantaneous point of time, an instant, the twinkling of an eye, a moment (e. g. क्षणम्, acc., or क्षणेन, inst. for an instant, in a moment; क्षणात्, abl. after an instant, immedi-ately, directly, at once; क्षणे क्षणे, every instant, every moment; तत्-क्षणम्, that very moment, in that same moment, immediately; तत्-क्षणात्, immediately upon that); a moment regarded as a measure of time, equal to thirty Kalas or four minutes, or according to other authorities equal to (4/5) or (2/3) (4/5) seconds; a leisure moment, a vacant instant, leisure, (क्षणं कृ, to have leisure for, wait patiently for; cf. कृत-क्षण); a fit or suitable moment, an opportunity, (क्षणं कृ or दा, to give an oppor-tunity); a festival; a certain day of the fortnight, as the full moon, change of the moon, &c.; dependance, servitude; the centre, the middle. —क्षण-क्षेप, अस्, m. a momentary delay. —क्षण-द, अस्, m. an astrologer; (आ), f. night (giving leisure); turmeric; (अम्), n. night-blindness; water. —क्षणदा-कर, अस्, m. the moon. —क्षणदा-चर, अस्, ई, m. f. a night-walker, a Rakṣas, a fiend, a goblin. —क्ष-णदान्ध्य (°द-आन्°), अम्, n. night-blindness, nycta-lopsis; [cf. क्षपान्ध्य, नक्तान्ध्य।] —क्षण-दृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, momentarily visible, seen for an instant. —क्षण-द्युति, इस्, f. momentary flash, lightning; [cf. अचिर-द्युति and क्षण-प्रभा।] —क्षण-निश्वास, अस्, m. a porpoise, the Gangetic porpoise. —क्षण-प्रकाशा, f. lightning. —क्ष-ण-प्रभ, अस्, आ, अम्, gleaming or flashing for an instant; (आ), f. lightning. —क्षण-भङ्गुर, अस्, आ, अम्, perishing in an instant, transient, frail, perish-able. —क्षण-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, momentary, short-lived. —क्षण-मात्रम्, ind. for an instant merely, only for a moment. —क्षण-मात्रानुरागिन् (°त्र-अन्°), ई, इणी, इ, one whose affection lasts only a mo-ment. —क्षण-रामिन्, ई, m. a pigeon. —क्षण-विघ्न, अम्, n. a momentary hindrance. —क्षण-विध्वंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, collapsing or perishing in a moment; (ई), m. the name of a sect of atheistic philosophers who deny the continued identity of any part of nature, and maintain that the universe perishes and undergoes a new creation every instant. —क्ष-णान्तर (°ण-अन्°), अम्, n. the interval of a moment; (ए), ind. after a little while, the next moment, there-upon. —क्षणार्ध (°ण-अर्°), अम्, n. half the measure of time called Kṣaṇa, half a moment, a small space of time.
क्षणिक: क्षणिक, अस्, आ, अम्, momentary, transient; (आ), f. lightning. —क्षणिक-त्व, अम्, n. momentary duration.
क्षणित: क्षणित, अस्, आ, अम्, having a leisure moment.
क्षणिन्: क्षणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a leisure moment; momentary, transient; (इनी), f. the night; [cf. क्षण-दा।]
क्षणतु: क्षणतु क्षणतु, &c. See under rt. क्षन्।
क्षणतु, उस्, m. a wound or sore.
क्षत्तृ: क्षत्तृ क्षत्तृ। See under rt. क्षद्।

क्षत्तृ, ता, m. one who cuts anything, one who carves or distributes; an attendant; a door-keeper, a porter; a charioteer, a coachman; [cf. अनु-क्षत्-तृ]; one who fights from a chariot; the son of a Śūdra man and a Kṣatriya woman, or the son of a Kṣatriya man and a Śūdra woman (called Ugra in Manu X. 9), or the son of a Śūdra man and Vaiśya woman (called Āyogava in Manu X. 12); the son of a female slave; (the proper employment of a Kṣattṛ is said to be catching animals that live in holes); a N. of Vidura as the son of a female slave, his father being the celebrated Vyāsa (see Mahā-bh. 1. 7381); an epithet of Brahmā; a fish.
क्षत्र: क्षत्र क्षत्र, अम्, अस्, n. m. (probably fr. rt. 1. क्षि; the m. form does not appear to occur), dominion, supremacy, power, might (whether human or supernatural, in the Veda especially applied to the power of Varuṇa-Mitra and Indra); government, governing body, the military or reigning order (the members of which in the earliest times, as represented by the Vedic hymns, were generally called Rājanya, not Kṣatriya; afterwards, when the difference be-tween Brahman and Kṣatra or the priestly and civil authorities became more distinct, the reigning or military caste accepted the title Kṣatriya); a man of the second or Kṣatriya caste, a warrior, a soldier (in this sense fancifully derived in Raghu. II. 53. fr. क्षतात् त्र fr. rt. त्रै, i. e. a preserver from injury); (ई), f. a woman of the second caste; the rank of a member of the reigning or military order, the authority of the second caste; wealth; water; the body; N. of a plant, = तगर; [cf. तुवि-क्षत्र, देव-क्षत्र, &c.] —क्षत्र-धर्म, अस्, m. the duty of a Kṣatriya, bravery, military conduct. —क्षत्र-धर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, having the duties of a soldier or of the second caste; (आ), m., N. of a prince. —क्षत्रधर्मानुग (°म-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, following or observing the duty of a soldier. —क्ष-त्र-धृति, इस्, f. the support of supreme power; N. of a particular part of the Rāja-sūya ceremony. —क्षत्र-प, अस्, m. a governor, a Satrap (a word found on coins). —क्षत्र-पति, इस्, m., Ved. the possessor of dominion. —क्षत्र-बन्धु, उस्, ऊस् or उस्, उ, one who belongs to the military order or second caste; (उस्), m. a member of the Kṣatriya caste; a mere Kṣatriya, i. e. a Kṣatriya by birth but not by his actions (a term of abuse). —क्षत्रबन्धु-वत्, ind. like a warrior. —क्षत्र-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. one who holds or confers dominion. —क्षत्र-योग, अस्, m., Ved. union of the princely order. —क्षत्र-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, endowed with princely dignity. —क्षत्र-वनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. favourable to the princely order. —क्षत्र-वर्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. promoting dominion. —क्षत्र-विद्या, f. the knowledge or science possessed by the Kṣatriya or military order. —क्षत्र-वृक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a tree, = मुचुकुन्द. —क्षत्र-वृद्ध, अस्, m., N. of a prince. —क्षत्र-वृद्धि, इस्, m., N. of one of the sons of Manu Raucya. —क्षत्र-वृध्, त्, m., N. of a prince, = क्षत्र-वृद्ध. —क्षत्र-वेद, अस्, m., the Veda of the Kṣatriya or military order. —क्षत्र-श्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. possessing sovereignty; (Sāy.) possessed of power. —क्षत्र-सव, अस्, m., N. of a sacrificial ceremony. —क्ष-त्रायतनीय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. क्षत्र + आयतन), Ved. based on the Kṣatra or kingly power. —क्ष-त्रोपक्षत्र (°र-उप्°), अस्, m., N. of a prince. —क्षत्रौजस् (°र-ओज्°), आस्, m., N. of a prince.
क्षत्रिण: क्षत्रिण, अस्, m., N. of a man.
क्षत्रिन्: क्षत्रिन्, ई, m. a man of the military order or second caste.
क्षत्रिय: क्षत्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, governing, endowed with sovereignty; (अस्), m. a member of the military or reigning order which in later time constituted the second caste; (आ), f. a woman of the military order or of the second caste; (ई), f. the wife of a man of the second caste; (अम्), n. the power or rank of this order. —क्षत्रिय-जाति, इस्, f. the mili-tary tribe or caste. —क्षत्रिय-ता, f. or क्षत्रिय-त्व, अम्, n. the order or rank of a Kṣatriya. —क्षत्रिय-धर्म, अस्, m. the duty or occupa-tion of the warrior-tribe, war, government, &c. —क्षत्रिय-धर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, having the duties of a soldier or of the second caste. —क्षत्रिय-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, mostly consisting of the military tribe. —क्षत्रिय-मर्दन, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying or destroyer of Kṣatriyas. —क्षत्रिय-राज, अस्, m. the chief of Kṣatriyas. —क्षत्रियर्षभ (°य-ऋष्°), अस्, m. best of Kṣatriyas. —क्षत्रिय-हण, अस्, m. one who destroys the military caste. —क्षत्रियान्तकर (°य-अन्°), अस्, m. one who destroys the Kṣatriyas.
क्षत्रियका: क्षत्रियका or इका, f. a woman belonging to the military or reigning order, a woman of the second caste.
क्षत्रियाणी: क्षत्रियाणी, f. a woman belonging to the mili-tary caste; the wife of a man of the second caste.
क्षद्: क्षद् क्षद्, cl. 1. A., Ved. क्षदते, चक्षदे, to cut, dissect, cut to pieces, divide; to kill; to carve (meat), to distribute (food); to take (food), to consume, eat. (As a Sautra root क्षद् means ‘to cover, protect, shelter.’)
क्षदत्: क्षदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, carving, dividing, tearing; eating.
क्षदन: क्षदन, अम्, n. the act of carving, dividing, tearing; eating.
क्षद्मन्: क्षद्मन्, अ, n., Ved. a carving knife; pieces of food cut off or carved; (according to Schol.) water.
क्षन्: क्षन् क्षन् or क्षण्, cl. 8. P. A. क्ष-णोति, -णुते, चक्षाण, चक्षणे, क्ष-णिष्यति, -ते, अक्षणीत्, क्षणितुम्, P. to hurt, injure, wound, break; A. to hurt one's self, be injured or wounded: Caus. क्षाणयति, -यितुम्: Desid. चिक्षणिषति, -ते: Intens. चङ्क्षण्यते, चङ्क्-षन्ति; [cf. Gr. καίνω, κανῶ; καίνυται = क्षणुते; ξαίνω; perhaps also σίνομαι for ξίνομαι.]
क्षणन: क्षणन, अम्, n. hurting, injuring; killing, slaughter.
क्षणनु: क्षणनु, उस्, m. a wound, a sore.
क्षत: क्षत, अस्, आ, अम्, wounded, hurt, hit, injured, broken, torn, rent, destroyed, impaired, violated; diminished, trodden or broken down; (अम्), n. a hurt, wound, sore, contusion. —क्षत-कास, अस्, m. a cough produced by an injury; [cf. क्षत-ज, &c.] —क्षत-घ्न, अस्, m., N. of a plant, commonly Kukuraśoṅkhā, Conyza Lacera; (आ or ई), f. a kind of insect; lac, the animal dye. —क्षत-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by a wound or injury of any kind (e. g. कास, a kind of cough); (अम्), n. blood; pus, matter. —क्षत-तेजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, dimmed, obscured (as light or power). —क्षत-पुण्य-लेश, अस्, आ, अम्, having the stock of merit exhausted. —क्षत-योनि, इस्, f. a woman who has been violated, one no longer a virgin. —क्षत-विक्षत, अस्, आ, अम्, mangled, covered with cuts and wounds. —क्षत-विध्वंसिन्, ई, m. a sort of pot-herb, Convolvulus Argenteus. —क्षत-वृत्ति, इस्, f. destitution, the being without the means of support, living on what one can get. —क्षत-व्रण, अस्, m. a sore produced by an injury. —क्षत-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, a violator of a vow or religious engagement. —क्षत-हर, अम्, n. Agallochum or Aloe wood. —क्षतारि (°त-अरि), इस्, इस्, इ, victorious, triumphant. —क्षतोत्थ (°त-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, produced by injury. —क्षतोदर (°त-उद्°), अम्, n. flux, dysentery. —क्षतोद्भव (°त-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, produced by injury; (अम्), n. (?) blood; [cf. क्षत-ज।] —क्षतौजस् (°त-ओज्°), आस्, आस्, अस्, weakened, reduced, impaired.
क्षति: क्षति, इस्, f. injury, hurt, a wound; destruction; damage, disadvantage.
क्षप्: क्षप् 1. क्षप्, cl. 1. P. A. क्षपति, -ते, to be abstinent, to fast, to do penance: Caus. क्षपयति, -यितुम्, to regret sorrowfully, miss.
क्षप् 2. क्षप्, cl. 10. P. क्षपयति, -यि-तुम्, to send, throw, cast, direct, &c.; [cf. Goth. skapa.]
क्षप् 3. क्षप्। See Caus. of rt. 4. क्षि, ‘to destroy.’

4. क्षप्, प्, f., Ved. night; a measure of time equivalent to a whole day of twenty-four hours; darkness; water; क्षपः or क्षपा, ind. at night; [cf. Lat. crepus-culum; Gr. κνέφος, κνέφας.] —क्षपोत्यय (°पस्-अत्°), अस्, m. the end of night.
क्षपण: 1. क्षपण, अस्, m. a Buddhist mendicant; (अस्, आ, अम्), shameless, impudent?; (अम्), n. abstinence, chastisement of the body, defilement, impurity.
2. क्षपण, अस्, आ, अम्, destructive, one who destroys; (अम्), n. destroying, diminishing, suppress-ing, expelling.
क्षपणक: क्षपणक, अस्, m. a mendicant, especially a Buddhist mendicant, who wears no garments; also a Jaina mendicant; (अस्), m., N. of an author supposed to have lived at the court of king Vikra-māditya.
क्षपयत्: क्षपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, casting, sending.
क्षपित: क्षपित, अस्, आ, अम्, sent, cast, directed.
क्षपा: क्षपा, f. night (Ved. only used in inst. pl. क्षपाभिस्); turmeric. —क्षपा-कर, अस्, m. ‘making the night,’ the moon. —क्षपा-घन, अस्, m. a dark cloud or dark nocturnal clouds. —क्ष-पा-चर, अस्, m. a night-walker; a fiend, a goblin. —क्षपाट (°पा-अट), अस्, m. a night-walker; a Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin. —क्षपा-नाथ, अस्, m. the moon. —क्षपान्त (°पा-अन्°), अस्, m. dawn, day-break. —क्षपान्ध्य (°पा-आन्°), अम्, n. night-blindness, nyctalopsis; [cf. क्षणदान्ध्य, नक्-तान्ध्य।] —क्षपा-पति, इस्, m. the moon; cam-phor. —क्षपाह (°पा-अहन्), अम्, n. a day and night.
क्षपणी: क्षपणी क्षपणी, f. = क्षेपणी, an oar, a net.
क्षपण्यु: क्षपण्यु क्षपण्यु, उस्, m. an offence, a transgression.
क्षम्: क्षम् 1. क्षम्, cl. 1. A., 4. P. क्षमते, क्षाम्यति (ep. also 1. P. and Ved. 2. P. क्षमति, क्षमिति), चक्षमे, चक्षाम, क्ष-मिष्यते, -ति, and क्षंस्यते, -ति, अक्षमिष्ट, अक्षंस्त, अक्षमत्, क्षमितुम् and क्षन्तुम्, to be patient or composed, to suppress anger, keep quiet; to submit to (with dat.); to bear patiently, endure, put up with, suffer; to pardon, forgive (with gen. or dat. of the person, e. g. क्षमस्व तद् मे, forgive me that); to allow, permit, suffer; to resist; to be com-petent or able to do anything (with inf.): Caus. क्षमयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to ask pardon for anything (with double acc., e. g. तत् क्षमये भवन्तम्, I ask you to pardon that); to suffer or bear patiently: Desid. चिक्षमिषते, -ति, and चिक्षंसते, -ति: Intens. चङ्क्षम्यते, चङ्क्षन्ति; [cf. Goth. hramja (?); Angl. Sax. hremman, ‘to hinder, disquiet.’]
2. क्षम्, f. (making क्षास् in the nom. case), Ved. the ground, the earth, χθών; [cf. χαμαί. &c.] —क्ष-पावत्, आन्, m., Ved. an earth-protector, a ruler, a governor.
क्षन्तव्य: क्षन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be borne or endured, bearable, to be suffered or submitted to patiently, to be pardoned or forgiven.
क्षन्तृ: क्षन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, pardoning, bearing patiently, submissive.
क्षम: क्षम, अस्, आ, अम्, patient; enduring, suffering, bearing, submissive, resisting; adequate, competent, able, fit for (with inf. or at the end of a compound, वयं त्यक्तुं क्षमाः, we are able to quit; गमन-क्षम, able to go); friendly; favourable; bear-able, tolerable; fit, appropriate, becoming suitable, proper for (with gen. of the person, e. g. क्ष-मं कौरवाणाम्, proper for the Kauravas; or with inf., e. g. न स क्षमः कोपयितुम्, he is not a fit object for anger); (अस्), m. a N. of Śiva, ‘the patient;’ (आ), f. patience, forbearance, indulgence; per-sonified as a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Pulaha; resistance; the earth; an epithet of Durgā; N. of a female shepherd; the tree Acacia Catechu (खदिर); N. of a species of the Atijayatī metre [cf. उत्पलिनी]; night (wrong form for क्षपा); (अम्), n. propriety, fitness; [cf. Hib. cam, ‘strong, stout, mighty; power, might;’ cama, ‘brave.’] —क्षम-ता, f. or क्ष-म-त्व, अम्, n. ability, fitness, capability. —क्षम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, knowing what is proper or right. —क्षमा-कल्याण, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of Jinalābhasūri, who composed 1794 A. D. a com-mentary on the Jīva-vicāra. —क्षमा-तल, अम्, n. the earth. —क्षमा-दंश, अस्, m., N. of a tree, = शिग्रु. —क्षमान्वित (°मा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, endowed with patience, patient, enduring, forgiving. —क्षमा-पति, इस्, m. lord of the earth, a king. —क्षमापन्न (°मा-आप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, forbearing, patient. —क्षमा-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, very patient, for-bearing. —क्षमा-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, patient; (क्), m. a king, a prince. —क्षमा-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, en-dowed with patience, patient, enduring. —क्षमा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, patient, enduring, forbearing; (अती), f., N. of the wife of Nidhi-pati.
क्षमणीय: क्षमणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be suffered, to be patiently borne; to be pardoned.
क्षमा: क्षमा (inst. case of 2. क्षम्), on the earth, on the floor (included by Pāṇini among the indeclinables with स्वर्, दिवा, &c.); [cf. Gr. χαμαί, χαμᾶ-ζε, χαμά-θεν, χθαμαλός.] —क्षमा-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in the ground or under the earth.
क्षमापय: क्षमापय, nom. P. A. -पयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to ask any one's (acc.) pardon, to beg forgiveness.
क्षमितव्य: क्षमितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be endured, to be patiently borne, to be pardoned.
क्षमितृ: क्षमितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, patient, enduring, for-bearing, indulgent.
क्षमिन्: क्षमिन्, ई, इणी, इ, patient, enduring, forbearing, indulgent; capable, able.
क्षम्य: क्षम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in the earth, terrestrial; χθόνιος.
क्षान्त: क्षान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, borne, endured; patient, enduring; (अस्), m., N. of a man; of a hunter; epi-thet of Śiva [cf. क्षम]; (आ), f. the earth, ‘the patient one.’
क्षान्ति: क्षान्ति, इस्, f. patience, forbearance, endurance, indulgence, patient waiting for anything. —क्षान्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, patient, enduring, indulgent. —क्षान्ति-वादिन्, ई, m., N. of a Ṛṣi; N. of Śākya-muni in one of his former births.
क्षान्तु: क्षान्तु, उस्, उस्, उ, patient, enduring; (उस्), m. a father.
क्षाम्य: क्षाम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be borne; to be pardoned or overlooked.
क्षमुद: क्षमुद क्षमुद, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a particular number.
क्षम्प्: क्षम्प् क्षम्प्, cl. 1. or 10. P. क्षम्पति or क्षम्पयति, -यितुम्, to suffer, bear; [cf. 1. क्षम्।]
क्षय: क्षय क्षय। See under rt. 2. क्षि and rt. 4. क्षि, p. 266.

1. क्षय, अस्, m. (for 2. see under rt. 4. क्षि below), an abode, residence, habitation, dwelling-place, seat, house [cf. उरु-क्षय]; family, race; the house of Yama, god of death; dominion (?). —क्षय-तरु, उस्, m. the plant Bignonia Suave-olens.

2. क्षय, अस्, m. (for 1. see under 2. क्षि last col.), loss, waste, wane, diminution, destruction, decay wasting or wearing away; fall (as of prices, opposed to वृद्धि, e. g. क्षयो वृद्धिश् च पण्यानाम्, the fall and rise in the price of commodities); removal; end, termination (e. g. निद्रा-क्षय, the end of sleep; दिन-क्षये, at the end of day; जीवित-क्षये, at the end of life; क्षयं या or गम्, to become less, be diminished, go to destruction, come to an end, perish); consumption, pthisis pulmonalis; sickness in general; the destruction of the universe; (in algebra) a negative quality, a minus. —क्षय-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing destruction or ruin, de-structive, ruinous, terminating; liberating from ex-istence. —क्षय-काल, अस्, m. the end of all things, the period of destruction. —क्षय-कास, अस्, m. a consumptive or phthisical cough. —क्षय-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, or क्षयङ्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing ruin or loss; destructive. —क्षय-नाशिनी, f. the plant Celtis Orientalis, = जीवन्ती (‘removing consump-tion’). —क्षय-पक्ष, अस्, m. the dark fortnight, that of the moon's wane. —क्षय-युक्ति, इस्, f. or क्षय-योग, अस्, m. necessity or opportunity of destroying. —क्षय-रोग, अस्, m. consumption. —क्षयरोगि-त्व, अम्, n. or क्षयरोगि-ता, f. consumption. —क्षय-रोगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, consumptive. —क्षय-वायु, उस्, m. the wind that is to blow at the end of the world. —क्षय-सम्पद्, त्, f. total loss, ruin, destruction.
क्षयथु: क्षयथु क्षयथु, उस्, m. cough; (a wrong form for क्षवथु।)
क्षर्: क्षर् क्षर्, cl. 1. P. क्षरति, चक्षार, क्षरिष्यति, अक्षारीत्, क्षरितुम् (ep. cl. 1. A. क्षरते, Ved. cl. 2. P. क्षरिति, Ved. inf. क्षरध्यै), to flow, stream, glide; to flow away; to stream forth; pour out (either in active or neuter sense); to drop, distil, trickle, ooze, run; to melt away, wane, perish, be destroyed; to fall or slip from, to be deprived of (with abl.): Caus. क्षारयति, -यितुम्: Desid. चिक्षरिषति: Intens. चाक्षर्यते, चाक्षर्ति; [cf. Lat. scateo ?].
क्षर: क्षर, अस्, आ, अम्, melting away, perishable; (अस्), m. a cloud; (अम्), n. water; a body. —क्षर-ज or क्षरे-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by distillation. —क्षर-पत्त्रा, f., N. of a plant, = द्रोण-पुष्पी। —क्षर-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, mutable, dissoluble.
क्षरक: क्षरक, अस्, इका, अम्, pouring forth.
क्षरण: क्षरण, अम्, n. the act of flowing, trickling, distilling, dropping (e. g. अङ्गुली-क्षरण, perspira-tion of the fingers).
क्षरत्: क्षरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flowing, running, trickling, oozing.
क्षरित: क्षरित, अस्, आ, अम्, dropped, liquefied, oozed, trickling, flowing.
क्षरिन्: क्षरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, flowing, dropping, trickling; (ई), m. the rainy season.
क्षार: क्षार, अस्, आ, अम्, caustic, biting, corrosive, acid, pungent, saline (according to some in these senses fr. rt. क्षै), anything converted to alkali or ashes by distillation; (अस्), m. juice, essence; treacle, molasses; any corrosive or acid or saline substance, especially an alkali such as soda or potash; caustic alkali, one species of cautery; glass; a rogue, a cheat; (अम्), n. a factitious or medicinal salt, commonly black salt [cf. विड्-लवण and कृष्ण-लवण]; water. —क्षार-कर्दम, अस्, m. a pool of saline or acid mud; N. of a hell. —क्षार-कर्मन्, अ, n. apply-ing caustic alkali (Lapis Infernalis) to proud flesh &c.; or applying acid remedies in general. —क्षार-कृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be treated with caustic alkali. —क्षार-तैल, अम्, n. oil cooked with alkaline ingredients. —क्षार-त्रय or क्षार-त्रितय, अम्, n. natron, saltpetre, and borax. —क्षार-दला, f. a kind of pot-herb, = चिल्ली. —क्षार-द्रु, उस्, m. the tree Bignonia Suaveolens; [cf. घण्टा-पाटलि।] —क्षार-नदी, f. a river in hell, the water of which is alkaline. —क्षार-पत्त्र, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), or क्षार-पत्त्रक, अस्, m. the pot-herb Cheno-podium Album. —क्षार-पाल, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi. —क्षार-भूमि, इस्, f. a saline soil. —क्षार-मध्य, अस्, m. the plant Achyranthes Aspera [cf. अपामार्ग]; its alkaline ashes make it useful in washing clothes. —क्षार-मृत्तिका, f. saline soil, especially an impure sulphate of soda. —क्षार-मेलक, अस्, m. an alkaline substance. —क्षार-मेह, अस्, m. a morbid state of the urine, in which its smell and taste resemble that of potash. —क्षार-रस, अस्, m. a saline or alkaline flavour. —क्षार-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the tree Bignonia Suave-olens [cf. क्षार-द्रु]; any tree yielding abundant potash. —क्षार-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, m. the tree Butea Frondosa; also = क्षार-वृक्ष; (अम्), n. alkaline earth; [cf. वज्र-क्षार।] —क्षार-षट्क, अम्, n. six kinds of trees distinguished by their juice, as the Butea Frondosa, Grislea Tomentosa, Achyranthes Aspera, Cowach, Ghaṇṭā-pāṭali, Coraya. —क्षार-समुद्र, अस्, m. or क्षार-सिन्धु, उस्, m. the salt ocean. —क्षार-सूत्र, अम्, n. acid thread, applied to fistulas &c. —क्षाराक्ष (°र-अक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having an artificial eye made of glass. —क्षारागद (°र-अग्°), अस्, m. remedy prepared by extracting the alkaline particles from the ashes of plants. —क्षा-राच्छ (°र-अच्छ), अम्, n. sea-salt. —क्षाराञ्जन (°र-अञ्°), अम्, n. an alkaline unguent. —क्षा-राम्बु (°र-अम्°), उ, n. or क्षारोद (°र-उद), अस्, m. or क्षारोदक (°र-उद्°), अम्, n. an alkaline juice or fluid. —क्षाराम्बुधि (°र-अम्°), क्षा-रोदधि (°र-उद्°), इस्, m. the salt ocean.
क्षार क्षार। See under rt. क्षर्, p. 265.
क्षारक: क्षारक, अस्, m. alkali; a juice, essence; a blossom, a new-blown flower or a young fruit; a bud or a multitude of young buds; a cage or basket or net for birds or fish; a washerman.
क्षारण: क्षारण, अम्, आ, n. f. accusing of unfaithfulness; (अम्), n. converting to alkali or ashes; distilling.
क्षारय: क्षारय, nom. P. क्षारयति, -यितुम्, to fur-nish or mix with acid substances; to torture a person with acid substances; to speak ill of a person; to abuse, accuse, calumniate.
क्षारित: क्षारित, अस्, आ, अम्, distilled from saline matter, strained through alkaline ashes &c.; calumniated, falsely accused (especially of adultery), accused of a crime, guilty.
क्षल्: क्षल् 1. क्षल्, cl. 1. P. क्षलति, -लितुम्, to flow; to collect; [cf. क्षर्।]

क्षल् 2. क्षल् (related to rt. क्षर्), cl. 10. P. क्षालयति, अचिक्षलत्, -यितुम्, to wash, wash off, purify, cleanse, clean, make clean; to wipe away; [cf. Lith. skalauju, ‘to wash off;’ skalbju, ‘to wash;’ Mod. Germ. spüle?].
क्षालन: क्षालन, अम्, n. washing, washing off, cleansing with water; sprinkling.
क्षालनीय: क्षालनीय or क्षालितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be washed, to be cleansed with water.
क्षालयत्: क्षालयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, washing, cleansing, sprinkling.
क्षालित: क्षालित, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansed, cleaned, washed.
क्षव: क्षव क्षव। See under rt. 1. क्षु।
क्षव, अस्, m. sneezing, cough, catarrh; a black species of mustard, Sinapis Dichotoma; [cf. राजिका।] —क्षव-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, anything which causes sneez-ing; making a sneeze, sneezing, coughing.
क्षाति: क्षाति क्षाति, इस्, f. (fr. क्षै), Ved. singeing, scorching, heat.
क्षात्त्र: क्षात्त्र क्षात्त्र, अम्, n. (fr. क्षत्तृ), Ved. a community or number of attendants or servants.
क्षात्र: क्षात्र क्षात्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. क्षत्र), be-longing or relating to or peculiar to the second or military tribe; (अम्), n. the second or military tribe; the dignity of a ruler or governor.
क्षात्रि: क्षात्रि, इस्, m. the son of a man of the second caste (by a woman of another caste ?).
क्षाम: क्षाम क्षाम, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. क्षै), scorched, singed; dried up, emaciated, wasted, fallen away, thin, slim, slender; weak, debilitated, infirm, slight. —क्षाम-ता, f. or क्षाम-त्व, अम्, n. emaciation, thinness, slenderness; debility. —क्षा-म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. scorching, singeing, dry-ing up; epithet of Agni; (ती), f., scil. इष्टि, N. of a particular sacrificial ceremony. —क्षामास्य (°म-आस्°), अम्, n. any diet or any state of the body (as menstruation) incompatible with a particular medical treatment.
क्षाम, अस्, आ, अम्, wasted, dried up. See s. v.
क्षामन्: क्षामन् क्षामन्, अ, n. (occurring only in nom., acc., loc. sing.), Ved. earth, soil, ground; [cf. 2. क्षम्।]
क्षामाप्रस्थ: क्षामाप्रस्थ क्षामा-प्रस्थ, अस्, m., N. of a town.
क्षास्: क्षास् क्षास्, nom. case of 2. क्षम्, q. v.
क्षि: क्षि 1. क्षि, cl. 1. P., Ved. क्षयति (only the pres. seems to occur), to possess, have power over, rule, govern, be master of (with gen.).

क्षि 2. क्षि, cl. 2. 6. P., Ved. क्षेति, क्षियति, चिक्षाय, क्षेष्यति, क्षेतुम्, to abide, stay, dwell, reside (used especially of an undisturbed or secret residence); to inhabit; to re-main; to be quiet; to go, move, approach: Caus. क्षययति or क्षेपयति, -यितुम्, to make a person live quietly; to pacify.
3. क्षि, इस्, f. abode, residence; going, moving.

क्षि 4. क्षि, cl. 1. 5. 9. P. क्षयति, क्षि-णोति, क्षिणाति, चिक्षाय, क्षेष्यति, अक्षै-षीत्, क्षेतुम्, to destroy, corrupt, ruin, to make an end of; to kill, injure: Pass. क्षीयते, to wane; to decrease; to be diminished, waste away, perish: Caus. क्षययति or क्षपयति or Ved. क्षापयति, यितुम्, to destroy, ruin, make an end of, finish; to weaken: Desid. चिक्षीषति: Intens. चेक्षीयते, चेक्षयीति, चेक्षेति; [cf. Gr. κτίννυμι?].
5. क्षि, इस्, f. destruction; waste, loss.
क्षयत्: क्षयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, possessing, ruling, govern-ing. —क्षयद्-वीर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ruling or governing men; an epithet of Indra, Rudra, and Pūṣan; (Sāy. as if fr. 2. क्षि), possessed of abiding or of going heroes such as sons &c.
क्षित्: 1. क्षित्, त्, त्, त्, ruling, a ruler, a governor, a sovereign, (used in comp., e. g. मही-क्षित्, q. v.)
2. क्षित्, त्, त्, त्, dwelling, an inhabitant, (at the end of several compounds, e. g. अन्तरिक्ष-क्षित्, an inhabitant of the air &c.)
क्षयण: 1. क्षयण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. habitable (?); (अस्), m. a place with tranquil water; a bay, harbour (?); (अम्), n. a dwelling-place.
2. क्षयण, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying, annihilating, driving away, dispersing; (often at the end of com-pounds, e. g. असुर-क्षयण, पिशाच-क्षयण, &c.)
क्षयस्: क्षयस्, अस्, n. a dwelling-place, habitation.
क्षिति: 1. क्षिति, इस्, f. (for 2. see under rt. 4. क्षि below), an abode, a dwelling, habitation, house, residence [cf. उरु-क्षिति]; the earth, the soil of the earth; (अयस्), f. pl., Ved. settlements, colonies, races of men, nations, men in general; the families of the gods. —क्षिति-कण, अस्, आ, m. f. a particle of earth, dust. —क्षिति-कम्प, अस्, m. an earthquake. —क्षिति-क्षम, अस्, m. the tree Mimosa Khayar; [cf. खदिर।] —क्षिति-क्षित्, त्, m. a ruler of the earth; a king, a prince. —क्षिति-खण्ड, अस्, m. a clod or lump of earth. —क्षिति-गर्भ, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —क्षिति-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, earth-born, produced of or in the earth; (अस्), m. a tree; a kind of snail (= भू-नाग); an earth-worm; N. of the planet Mars; an epithet of the demon Naraka; (आ), f. an epithet of Sītā, the wife of Rāma; (अम्), n., N. of a circle of the sky. —क्षिति-जन्तु, उस्, m. a kind of snail (= भू-नाग); an earth-worm. —क्षिति-तल, अम्, n. the surface of the earth, the region below the earth. —क्षिति-देव, अस्, m. the ‘earth-god,’ an epithet of a king. —क्षिति-देवता, f. the deity of the earth, epithet of a Brāhman. —क्षिति-धर, अस्, m. ‘earth-supporter,’ a mountain. —क्षिति-धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, carrying soil or earth. —क्षिति-धेनु, उस्, f. the earth considered as a milch-cow. —क्षिति-नन्द, अस्, m., N. of a king. —क्षिति-नाग, अस्, m. a kind of snail (= भू-नाग) or rather snail-shell; an earth-worm (?). —क्षिति-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of the earth,’ a king. —क्षिति-प, अस्, m. ‘earth-protector,’ a king. —क्षिति-पति, इस्, m. lord of the earth, a king, a sovereign. —क्षिति-पाल, अस्, m. ‘earth-protector,’ a king, a prince. —क्षिति-पीठ, अम्, n. the surface of the earth. —क्षिति-पुत्र, अस्, m. a son of the earth, an epithet of Naraka. —क्षिति-प्रतिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelling or abiding on the earth. —क्षिति-भुज्, क्, m. one who enjoys the earth, a king. —क्षिति-भृत्, त्, m. ‘earth-supporter,’ a mountain; a king. —क्षिति-मण्डल, अम्, n. the earth, the globe. —क्षिति-रुह्, ट्, or क्षिति-रुह, अस्, m. a plant, a tree. —क्षिति-लव-भुज्, क्, m. one who possesses a small tract of the earth, a petty prince. —क्षिति-वदरी, f., N. of a plant, = भू-वदरी। —क्षिति-वर्धन, अस्, m. a corpse. —क्षिति-वृत्ति, इस्, f. (patient) behaviour like that of the earth. —क्षितिवृत्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, patient like the earth. —क्षिति-व्युदास, अस्, m. a cave within the earth. —क्षिति-सुत, अस्, m. an epithet of the demon Naraka; also of the planet Mars; [cf. क्षिति-पुत्र।] —क्षितीश (°ति-ईश), अस्, m. a ruler of the earth, a king. —क्षितीश-वंशावली-चरित, अम्, n. ‘genealogy and history of the kings,’ title of a work composed in the last century, being a family chronicle of the viceroys of a part of Bengal. —क्षितीश्वर (°ति-ईश्°), अस्, m. a king. —क्षित्य्-अदिति, इस्, f. the Aditi of the earth, an epithet of Devakī, the mother of Kṛṣṇa.
2. क्षिति, इस्, f. (for 1. see under rt. 2. क्षि above), loss, destruction; wane; a period of the destruction of the universe, the end of the world; a kind of perfume = रोचना; (इस्), m., N. of a man.
क्षययितव्य: क्षययितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be destroyed.
क्षयिन्: क्षयिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wasting, decaying, fragile; consumptive. —क्षयि-त्व, अम्, n. fragility.
क्षयिष्णु: क्षयिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, destroying, wasting, decay-ing, perishing; perishable, fragile.
क्षय्य: क्षय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, perishable, decaying; [cf. अ-क्षय्य।]
क्षित: क्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, wasted, decayed, exhausted; weakened; poor, miserable. —क्षितायुस् (°त-आय्°), उस्, उस्, उस्, Ved. one whose life goes to an end, one whose life is forfeited.
क्षिया: क्षिया, f. loss, waste, destruction; offence against the customs.
क्षिया क्षिया। See under rt. 4. क्षि।
क्षीण: क्षीण, अस्, आ, अम्, diminished, wasted, expended, worn away; lost, destroyed; injured, broken, torn; subdued, suppressed; thin, emaciated, feeble; delicate, slender, poor, miserable. —क्षीण-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, with slackened or diminished motion or progress. —क्षीण-तमस्, आस्, m., N. of a Vihāra. —क्षीण-ता, f. or क्षीण-त्व, अम्, n. the state of wasting away, diminution, decay; the state of being worn away or injured; emaciation, thinness; slenderness. —क्षीण-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, impoverished. —क्षी-ण-पाप, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose sins are destroyed; one who is purified after having suffered the con-sequences of sin. —क्षीण-पुण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose merit is lost; one who has enjoyed the fruits of merit and is doomed to labour for more in another birth. —क्षीण-मध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, slender-waisted. —क्षीण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, wasted, decayed. —क्षी-ण-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, inhabiting a dilapidated house; (ई), m. a dove or pigeon. —क्षीण-विक्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has lost courage, destitute of prowess. —क्षीण-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, out of employ, having no means of subsistence or maintenance. —क्षीण-शक्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, one whose strength is wasted, weak, impotent. —क्षीण-शरीर, अस्, आ, अम्, having a thin or emaciated body. —क्षीण-सुकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, having one's stock of merit exhausted. —क्षीणाङ्ग (°ण-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having emaciated limbs. —क्षीणाज्य-कर्मन् (°ण-आज्°), आ, m. a Buddhist. —क्षीणाष्ट-कर्मन् (°ण-अष्°), आ, m. (with Jainas) an Arhat or inspired teacher.
क्षीण क्षीण। See under 4. क्षि 1st col.
क्षीयमाण: क्षीयमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, perishing, wasting away, decaying.
क्षेय: क्षेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be destroyed or removed.
क्षेय क्षेय। See under rt. 4. क्षि, p. 266.
क्षिण्: क्षिण् क्षिण्, cl. 5. P. A. क्षिणोति, -णुते, क्षेणोति, -णुते (?), to kill, to hurt, = 4. क्षि।
क्षिद्र: क्षिद्र क्षिद्र, अस्, m. disease; the sun; a horn.
क्षिप्: क्षिप् 1. क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A., 4. P. क्षि-पति, -ते, क्षिप्यति, चिक्षेप, चिक्षिपे, क्षेप्स्यति, -ते, अक्षैप्सीत्, अक्षिप्त, क्षेप्तुम्, to throw, cast, send, despatch; to put or place any-thing on or in (with loc.), pour on, scatter, strew; to fix or attach to; to throw away, cast away, get rid of; to reject, disdain; to lay (the blame) on; to strike, hit; to strike down, ruin, destroy; to utter abusive words, insult, revile, abuse, scold; A. to throw at each other, destroy one another: Caus. P. क्षेपयति, -यितुम्, to cause to cast &c.; to hurt, injure: Desid. चिक्षिप्सति, -ते: Intens. चेक्षिप्-यते, चेक्षेप्ति; [cf. Lat. sipo, dissipo, for xipo; Gr. ῥίπτω for κρίπτω Cambro-Brit. hipiaw, ‘to cast or dash suddenly;’ Goth. vairpa; Germ. werfe ?].
2. क्षिप्, प्, f. (only used in nom. and inst. pl. क्षिपस् and क्षिपाभिस्), Ved. the fingers.
क्षिप: क्षिप, अस्, आ, अम्, a thrower, striking, hitting; (अस्), m. throwing, casting, insulting, reviling; (आ), f. sending, casting, throwing, &c.; night; (a wrong form for क्षपा।)
क्षिपक: क्षिपक, अस्, m. an archer, a warrior.
क्षिपण: क्षिपण, अम्, n. sending, despatching, throwing, casting; reviling, abusing.
क्षिपणि: क्षिपणि, इस्, m. a stroke or blow with a whip; a missile weapon; (इस् or ई), f. an oar; a kind of net.
क्षिपणु: क्षिपणु, उस्, m. an archer; a weapon; air, wind.
क्षिपण्यु: क्षिपण्यु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. क्षिपण?), fragrant, sweet-smelling; diffusive, what may be sent or scat-tered; (उस्), m. the body; spring, the season of spring.
क्षिपत्: क्षिपत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, throwing, casting; abusing, reproaching.
क्षिपति: क्षिपति or क्षिपस्ति, ई, du., Ved. the arms.
क्षिप्त: क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown, cast; sent, despatched, dismissed, &c.; (आ), f. night, (like क्षिपा, a wrong form for क्षपा); (अम्), n. a wound caused by shooting or throwing. —क्षिप्त-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, distracted in mind, absent. —क्षिप्तचित्त-ता, f. absence of mind. —क्षिप्त-देह, अस्, आ, अम्, pros-trating the body, lying down. —क्षिप्त-भेषज, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. healing wounds caused by missile weapons. —क्षिप्त-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, of despicable descent (?), such a man is not allowed to become a Ṛtvij. —क्षिप्त-लगुड, अस्, आ, अम्, flinging the staff.
क्षिप्ति: क्षिप्ति, इस्, f. throwing; sending; solving a riddle; explaining or understanding a hidden mean-ing; the quantity to be added to the square of the least root multiplied by the multiplicator, to render it capable of yielding an exact square root; (in the latter sense also क्षिप्तिका।)
क्षिप्नु: क्षिप्नु (or क्षिप्णु?), उस्, उस्, उ, throwing, casting, throwing obstacles in the way; obstructive, scornful, or fond of abusing (?).
क्षिप्यत्: क्षिप्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, throwing, sending.
क्षिप्यमाण: क्षिप्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, throwing, tossing; casting aside, throwing off; sending, directing; being thrown, &c.
क्षिप्र: क्षिप्र, अस्, आ, अम् (compar. क्षेपीयस्, superl. क्षेपिष्ठ), springing, flying back with a spring, elastic (as a bow); quick, speedy, swift; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa; (अम्), n. a measure of time equal to (1/15) Muhūrta or 15 Etarhis; the part of the hand between the thumb and fore-finger and the cor-responding part of the foot; (अम्), ind. quickly, immediately, directly; (आत्), ind. shortly afterwards, thereupon; (ए), ind. directly, immediately; [cf. Gr. κραιπνός.] —क्षिप्र-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, acting or work-ing quickly, skilful. —क्षिप्र-धन्वन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. armed with an elastic bow or one which flies back with a spring. —क्षिप्र-पाकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, ripening quickly; (ई), m. the tree Hibiscus Populneoides; [cf. गर्दभाण्ड।] —क्षिप्र-श्येन, अस्, m. a species of bird. —क्षिप्र-सन्धि, इस्, m. a species of Sandhi produced by changing the first of two con-current vowels to its semivowel; also the Svarita accent on a syllable formed by this kind of Sandhi; [cf. क्षैप्र।] —क्षिप्र-हस्त, अस्, m., N. of a Rakṣas (swift-handed).
क्षेप: क्षेप, अस्, m. throwing, casting, tossing; a throw, cast; a stroke of an oar &c.; sending, dis-missing, striking down, depression; laying on (as paint &c.), besmearing; transgressing; passing away time; delay, procrastination, dilatoriness; insult, in-vective, abuse, reviling; disrespect, contempt; pride, haughtiness; a nosegay, a clump of flowers; (in arithmetic) an additive quantity, addendum.
क्षेप क्षेप, क्षेपक, क्षेपण, क्षेपणि, &c. See under rt. क्षिप् at p. 267.
क्षेपक: क्षेपक, अस्, आ, अम्, a thrower, sender; inserted, interpolated; abusive, disrespectful; (अस्), m. a spu-rious or interpolated passage; an additive quantity, addendum; N. of a prince.
क्षेपण: क्षेपण, अम्, n. the act of throwing, casting, shooting off (of an arrow &c.); sending, directing; sending away; passing away time, spending time; omitting; abusing; a sling; (ई), f. a sling or any instrument with which missiles are thrown; an oar; a kind of net.
क्षेपणि: क्षेपणि, इस्, f. an oar; a net, a fishing-net.
क्षेपणीय: क्षेपणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be thrown or cast; (अम्), n. a sling, any instrument for casting missiles.
क्षेपिमन्: क्षेपिमन्, आ, m. great velocity, speed.
क्षेपिष्ठ: क्षेपिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (see क्षिप्र), quickest, speediest.
क्षेपीयस्: क्षेपीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (see क्षिप्र), more quick, speedier.
क्षेप्तव्य: क्षेप्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cast or thrown, to be reviled or abused.
क्षेप्तृ: क्षेप्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a thrower, caster, sender.
क्षेप्य: क्षेप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be thrown; to be thrown round (as a garment).
क्षिल्लिका: क्षिल्लिका क्षिल्लिका, f., N. of the grand-mother of king Cakra-varman.
क्षिव्: क्षिव् क्षिव्, cl. 1. 4. P. क्षेवति, क्षी-व्यति, to eject from the mouth, spit, spit out, vomit; [cf. ष्ठिव् and क्षीव्।]
क्षी: क्षी क्षी, another form for 4. क्षि, q. v.
क्षीज्: क्षीज् क्षीज्, cl. 1. P. क्षीजति, चिक्षीज, क्षीजितुम्, to sound inarticulately, to sigh or groan as in distress.
क्षीजन: क्षीजन, अम्, n. the whistling of hollow reeds or bamboos.
क्षीब्: क्षीब् क्षीब् and क्षीब। See क्षीव्, क्षीव।
क्षीर: क्षीर क्षीर, अस्, अम्, m. n. (probably fr. क्षर्, but according to Uṇādi IV. 34. fr. घस्), milk, thickened milk; the milky juice or sap of plants; the resin of the plant Pinus Longifolia; water; (अस्), m., N. of a grammarian [cf. क्षीर-स्वामिन्]; (आ), f., N. of a plant [cf. काकोली]; (ई), f., N. of several plants containing a milky sap; a small shrub, Asclepia Rosea, also दुग्धिका; a species of Mimosa, M. Kauki [cf. क्षीरिका]; gigantic swallow-wort; Euphorbia &c. —क्षीर-कञ्चुकिन्, ई, m., N. of a reed, Lipeocercis Serrata (क्षीरीश). —क्षीर-कण्ठ or क्षीर-कण्ठक, अस्, m. an infant, a young child, ‘having milk in its throat.’ —क्षीर-कन्द, अस्, आ, m. f. a kind of pot-herb, black Bhuin-coönra, Convolvulus Paniculatus; [cf. क्षीर-विदा-री।] —क्षीर-कलम्भ, see क्षैरकलम्भि। —क्षीर-काकोलिका or क्षीर-काकोली, f. a drug, one of the eight principal medicaments of the Hindūs; it is a root from the Himālaya yielding a milky juice; [cf. काकोली।] —क्षीर-काण्डक, अस्, m. the plant Tithymalus Antiquorum (स्नुही), and Calotropis Gigantea (अर्क). —क्षीर-काष्ठा, f., N. of a plant, = वटी. —क्षीर-कीट, अस्, m. an insect or animalcule generated by the fermentation of milk. —क्षीर-क्षव, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = दुद्घ-पाषाण. —क्षीर-खर्जूर, अस्, m. a species of Datura tree. —क्षीर-गर्भ, अस्, m., N. of a certain Brāhman who was born again as a flamingo. —क्षीर-घृत, अम्, n. purified butter mixed with milk. —क्षीर-ज, अम्, n. coagulated milk. —क्षीर-तरङ्गिणी, f. title of a grammar com-posed by Kṣīra-svāmin. —क्षीर-तैल, अम्, n. a kind of unguent prepared with milk, oil, &c. —क्षीर-तोयधि, इस्, m. the ocean of milk. —क्षीर-द, अस्, आ, अम्, milk-giving, what yields milk. —क्षीर-दल, अस्, m. the plant Calotropis Gigantea (= अर्क), the leaves &c. of which yield a milky juice. —क्षीर-दात्री, f. yielding milk as a cow. —क्षीर-द्रुम, अस्, m. the tree Ficus Re-ligiosa; [cf. अश्वत्थ।] —क्षीर-धर, अस्, m., N. of a king. —क्षीर-धात्री, f. a wet-nurse. —क्षीर-धेनु, उस्, f. a milch-cow, symbolically represented by milk &c. offered as a gift to a Brāh-man. —क्षीर-नाश, अस्, m. the tree Trophis Aspera (= शाखोट). —क्षीर-निधि, इस्, m. the ocean of milk. —क्षीर-नीर, अम्, n. milk and water; em-bracing, embrace (i. e. a union like the mixing of milk and water). —क्षीर-प, अस्, आ, अम्, drinking milk, who or what drinks milk; epithet of a class of ascetics; an infant, a young child. —क्षीर-पर्णिन्, ई, m. the plant Calotropis Gigantea; [cf. अर्क and क्षीर-दल।] —क्षीर-पलाण्डु, उस्, m. a kind of onion. —क्षीर-पाक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. cooked in milk. —क्षीर-पाण, आस्, m. pl. the milk-drinkers, an epithet of the Uśīnaras; (अम्), n. drinking milk; (अस्, ई, अम्), any vessel out of which milk is drunk. —क्षीर-पाणि, इस्, m., N. of a physician. —क्षीर-पायिन्, ई, इणी, इ, drinking or sucking milk; drinking or imbibing water repeatedly; (इणस्), m. pl. the milk-drinkers, an epithet of the Uśīnaras. —क्षीर-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, supported by milk, receiving wages in the form of milk. —क्षीर-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, composed of milk. —क्षीर-मोचक, अस्, m. a kind of Moringa, M. Hyperanthera; [cf. मोचक।] —क्षीर-मोरट, अस्, m. a kind of creeping plant; [cf. सितद्रु, सुदल, क्षीरक।] —क्षीर-यष्-टिक, अम्, n. a dish of liquorice and milk; (perhaps a wrong form for क्षीर-षष्टिक?). —क्षीर-लता, f. the plant Batatas Paniculata; [cf. क्षीर-विदारी।] —क्षीर-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. furnished with milk; (ती), f., N. of a river. —क्षीर-वल्ली, f. the dark Bhuincoönra, Convolvulus Paniculatus. —क्षीर-वारि, इस्, m. the sea of milk; [cf. क्षी-रोद।] —क्षीर-वारिधि, इस्, m. the sea of milk. —क्षीर-विकृति, इस्, f. inspissated milk. —क्षीर-विदारिका or क्षीर-विदारी, f. the plant Batatas Paniculata. —क्षीर-विषाणिका, f. the plants Tragia Involucrata (= वृश्चिकाली) and क्षीर-काकोली। —क्षीर-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the glomerous fig tree, Ficus Glomerata [cf. उदुम्बर]; a common N. for the four trees न्यग्रोध, उदुम्बर, अश्वत्थ, and मधूक. —क्षीर-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, living upon milk in consequence of a vow. —क्षीर-शर, अस्, m. cream, the surface or skim of milk, curds; [cf. आमिक्षा।] —क्षीर-शीर्ष, अस्, m. the resin of the plant Pinus Longifolia; [cf. श्री-वास।] —क्षीर-शुक्रा, f. = क्षीर-विदारी and क्षीर-काकोली. —क्षीर-शुक्ल, अस्, m. the plant Trapa Bispinosa [cf. जल-कण्टक]; another plant, = राजादनी; (आ), f. the plant Batatas Paniculata. —क्षीर-श्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. mixed with milk. —क्षीर-षष्टिक, अम्, n. Ṣaṣṭika rice cooked in milk. —क्षीर-सन्तानिका, f. curds mixed with milk; (a various reading has °सन्तालिका।) —क्षीर-समुद्र, अस्, m. the sea of milk in Śveta-dīpa. —क्षीर-सर्पिस्, इस्, n. clarified butter mixed with milk. —क्षीर-सागर, अस्, m. the ocean of milk; also N. of a place. —क्षीरसागर-सुता, f. an epi-thet of Lakṣmī as produced from the ocean of milk. —क्षीर-सार, अस्, m. essence of milk, any product of milk, (in Hindī पालजिनु), butter. —क्षीर-स्फटिक, अस्, m. a precious stone, de-scribed as a kind of milky crystal (opal or cat's eye?); [cf. आकाश-स्फटिक and तैल-स्फटिक।] —क्षीर-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a grammarian and commen-tator on the Amara-koṣa. —क्षीर-ह्रद, अस्, m., N. of a man. —क्षीराद (°र-अद), अस्, m. an infant at the breast, a sucking child. —क्षीरान्-नाद (°र-अन्न-अद), अस्, m. an infant which is both fed and suckled. —क्षीराब्धि (°र-अब्धि), इस्, m. the sea of milk, one of the seven seas sur-rounding the seven divisions of the terrestrial world. —क्षीराब्धि-ज, अस्, m. the moon; the Amṛta or any one of the precious objects produced at the churning of the ocean; an epithet of Śeṣa; an epithet of Tārkṣya; (आ), f. an epithet of Lakṣmī; (अम्), n. sea-salt, a pearl. —क्षीराब्धि-तनया, f. or क्षीराब्धि-मानुषी, f. an epithet of Lakṣmī as the daughter of the ocean of milk. —क्षीराह्व or क्षीराह्वय (°र-आह्°), अस्, m. the resin of the plant Pinus Longifolia. —क्षीरोद (°र-उद), अस्, आ, अम्, containing milk instead of water; (अस्), m. the sea of milk; the sea in general. —क्षीरोद-तनया, f. the daughter of the sea of milk; an epi-thet of Lakṣmī. —क्षीरोद-तनया-पति, इस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu. —क्षीरोदधि (°र-उद्°), इस्, m. the sea of milk. —क्षीरोद-नन्दन, अस्, m. the son of the sea of milk, an epithet of the moon. —क्षीरोद-मथन, अम्, n. the churning of the ocean of milk undertaken by the Devas and Asuras to obtain the Amṛta &c. —क्षीरोर्मि (°र-ऊर्°), इस्, m. a wave of milk, a wave of the sea of milk. —क्षीरौदन (°र-ओद्°), अस्, m. rice boiled with milk.
क्षीरक: क्षीरक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = क्षीर-मोरट।
क्षीरय: क्षीरय, nom. P. क्षीरयति, -यितुम्, to have the appearance of milk, look like milk.
क्षीरस: क्षीरस, अस्, m. = क्षीर-सार, q. v.
क्षीरस्य: क्षीरस्य, nom. P. क्षीरस्यति, -यितुम्, to long for milk or for the breast.
क्षीरावी: क्षीरावी or क्षीराविका, f. a sort of Asclepias, A. Rosea, = दुग्धिका।
क्षीरिक: क्षीरिक, अस्, m. a kind of serpent; a kind of tree (आ), f. a dish prepared with milk; a kind of Datura tree; [cf. क्षीर-खर्जूर and पिण्ड-खर्जूर।]
क्षीरिन्: क्षीरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, milky, yielding milk, abounding in milk, having plenty of milk; containing milky juice or sap (as a tree); (ई), m. a species of tree, the Udumbara (?); according to native lexicographers many plants have this epithet; (इणी), f. a tree bear-ing an edible fruit, = Mimusops Kauki; a species of the moon-plant or acid Asclepias used in medicine.
क्षीरीय: क्षीरीय, nom. P. क्षीरीयति, -यितुम्, to desire milk.
क्षीरेयी: क्षीरेयी, f. an oblation of milk, rice, and sugar.
क्षीव्: क्षीव् क्षीव्, cl. 1. 4. P. क्षीवति, क्षेवति and क्षीव्यति, -वितुम्, to spit, sputter, eject from the mouth; to be drunk or intoxicated; [cf. क्षिव्, क्षेव्, क्षीब्, ष्ठिव्; cf. also Hib. siobhas, ‘rage, madness.’]
क्षीव: क्षीव or क्षीब, अस्, आ, अम्, excited, drunk, intoxicated. —क्षीव-ता, f. or क्षीव-त्व, अम्, n. intoxication, drunkenness.
क्षु: क्षु 1. क्षु, cl. 2. P. क्षौति, चुक्षाव, क्षविष्यति, अक्षावीत्, क्षवितुम्, to sneeze, to make any sound like sneezing; to cough: Caus. क्षावयति: Desid. of Caus. चुक्षावयिषति; [cf. Lith. czaudmi.]
क्षु 2. क्षु, n. (fr. घस्?), Ved. food. —क्षु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. abounding in food, nourishing, nutritious; strong; powerful, robust, valiant.
क्षवक: क्षवक, अस्, m. the plant Achyranthes Aspera, = अपामार्ग, black mustard; (अम्), n. a kind of pot-herb; (इका), f. a kind of Solanum; a species of rice; a woman.
क्षवथु: क्षवथु, उस्, m. sneezing; catarrh; cough; irritation of the throat; sore throat.
क्षुत्: क्षुत्, त्, f. a sneeze, sneezing. —क्षुत्-करी, f., N. of a plant, commonly कङ्कालिका, black mustard (?).
क्षुत: क्षुत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has sneezed; sneezed upon; (as a less correct form for क्ष्णुत), sharp; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. a sneeze, sneezing, cough. —क्षुत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, sneezing. —क्षुता-भिजनन (°त-अभ्°), अस्, m. black mustard; [cf. क्षुधाभिजनन।]
क्षुवत्: क्षुवत्, अन्, अती, अत्, sneezing, coughing, &c.
क्षुवत् क्षुवत्। See under rt. 1. क्षु।
क्षुण: क्षुण क्षुण, अस्, m. the soap-berry plant, Sapindus Saponaria; [cf. अरिष्ट।]
क्षुण्ण: क्षुण्ण क्षुण्ण। See below under क्षुद्।

क्षुण्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, pounded, bruised, crushed, stamped or trampled upon; broken to pieces, pul-verized, shattered, pierced; violated (as a vow); ex-ercised, practised, skilful; one versed in sacred science but unable to explain or teach it; defeated, overcome. —क्षुण्ण-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, contrite in heart, penitent.
क्षुद्: क्षुद् क्षुद्, cl. 7. P. A. and Ved. cl. 1. P. क्षुणत्ति, क्षुन्ते, क्षोदति, चुक्षोद, चुक्षुदे, क्षोत्स्यति, -ते, अक्षुदत्, अक्षौत्सीत्, अक्षुत्त, क्षोत्तुम्, to strike against, stamp or trample upon, pound; to bruise, crush, shiver, shatter, reduce to powder, dash to pieces, shake by stamping on; A. to move, to be agitated or shaken: Caus. P. क्षोदयति, -यितुम्, to crush, pound, comminute, pulverize, reduce to powder, diminish; shake or agitate by stamping; [cf. Gr. ξύω, ξέω, for ξεύω, ξυστός, ξεστός; Lith. skausti?].
क्षुण्णक: क्षुण्णक, अस्, m. a kind of drum beaten at a funeral.
क्षुद्र: क्षुद्र, अस्, आ, अम् (compar. क्षोदीयस्, superl. क्षोदिष्ठ), minute, diminutive, tiny, very small, small, little, trifling; mean, low, vile, niggardly, base, avaricious; wicked; cruel; poor, indigent; (अस्), m. a small particle of rice; a bee or wasp; the plant Artocarpus Lacucha [cf. लकुच and डहु]; (आस्), m. pl. a peculiar class of writings, see क्षुद्र-कल्प; (आ), f. a woman maimed or crippled; a base or despicable woman; a whore, a harlot; a dancing girl; a quarrel-some woman; a bee, fly, gnat; several plants, Sola-num Jacquini, = वृहती; also = चाङ्गेरिका; also = गवेधुका; (अम्), n., Ved. a particle of dust, flour, meal; [cf. Lith. kûdikis, ‘an infant;’ Pers. كودك kūdak, ‘small, a boy.’] —क्षुद्र-कण्टकारी, f. the plant Solanum Jacquini, = अग्नि-दमनी. —क्षुद्र-कण्टकी, f. a kind of Solanum, = बृहती. —क्षु-द्रक-मानस, अम्, n., N. of a lake. —क्षुद्र-कम्बु, उस्, m. a small shell. —क्षुद्र-कल्प, अस्, m. ‘the smaller ritual,’ title of a class of works. —क्षुद्र-कारलिका, f. (for क्षुद्र-करालिका?), and क्षुद्र-कारवेल्ली, f. a kind of Cucurbitaceous plant. —क्षुद्र-कुलिश, अस्, m. a precious stone; [cf. वैक्रान्त।] —क्षुद्र-कुष्ठ, अम्, n. a mild form of leprosy, (comprising eleven varieties, whereas the महा-कुष्ठ contains seven severe forms of leprosy.) —क्षुद्र-क्षुर and क्षुद्र-गोक्षु-रक, अस्, m. a variety of the plant Asteracantha Longifolia. —क्षुद्र-घण्टिका, f. a tinkling orna-ment, a girdle of small bells. —क्षुद्र-घोली, f., N. of a plant, = चिविल्लिका. —क्षुद्र-चञ्चु, उस्, f., N. of a plant. —क्षुद्र-चन्दन, अम्, n. red sandal-wood. —क्षुद्र-चिर्भिटा, f., N. of a plant, = गोपाल-कर्कटी. —क्षुद्र-चूड, अस्, m. a kind of small bird, commonly called गोसालिक. —क्षुद्र-जन्तु, उस्, m. any small animal; a kind of worm, Julus (शत-पदी). —क्षुद्र-जातीफल, अम्, n. a kind of Myrobalan; [cf. आमलक।] —क्षुद्र-जीर, अस्, m. small cummin. —क्षुद्र-जीवा, f., N. of a plant, = जीवन्ती. —क्षुद्रञ्-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, following small or minute or trifling matters. —क्षु-द्र-तण्डुल, अस्, m. a grain of rice. —क्षुद्र-ता, f. or क्षुद्र-त्व, अम्, n. minuteness, smallness; inferiority, insignificance; meanness. —क्षुद्र-तुलसी, f. a kind of Ocimum, = अर्जक. —क्षुद्र-दंशिका or क्षुद्र-दंशी, f. a small gad-fly. —क्षुद्र-दुरालभा, f., N. of a thorny plant much eaten by camels. —क्षुद्र-दुःस्पर्शा, f. the plant Solanum Jacquini, = अग्नि-दमनी. —क्षुद्र-धात्री, f., N. of a plant; [cf. कर्कट।] —क्षुद्र-धान्य, अम्, n. shrivelled grain. —क्षुद्र-नासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, having a small nose. —क्षुद्र-पक्-षिक, अस्, m. a small bird. —क्षुद्र-पत्त्रा, f. a kind of wood-sorrel, Oxalis Monadelpha, = चाङ्गेरी; (ई), f., N. of another plant, = वचा. —क्षुद्र-प-नस, अस्, m. the plant Artocarpus Lacucha (लकुच)। —क्षुद्र-पर्ण, अस्, m. a kind of Ocimum, = अर्जक. —क्षुद्र-पाषाण-भेदा or ई, f., N. of a plant, = चतुः-पत्त्री, पार्वती, नग-भू, &c. —क्षुद्र-पिप्पली, f. wild pepper (= वन-पिप्पली). —क्षुद्र-पृषती, f., Ved. covered with small spots. —क्षुद्र-पोतिका, f., N. of a pot-herb. —क्षुद्र-फलक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = जीवन, Celtis Orientalis. —क्षुद्र-फला, f., N. of several plants, Ardisia Solanacea, = भूमि-जम्बु, and others. —क्षुद्र-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, of little understanding, simple, silly, ignorant; (इस्), m., N. of a jackal in the Hitopadeśa. —क्षुद्रबुद्धि-नामन्, आ, आ, अ, named Kṣudra-buddhi. —क्षुद्र-भण्टाकी, f., N. of a plant, a kind of Solanum, = बृहती; [cf. क्षुद्र-कण्टकी।] —क्षुद्र-मीन, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —क्षुद्र-मुस्ता, f. the plant Scirpus Kysoor; [cf. कसेरु।] —क्षुद्र-रस, अस्, m. honey; (आ), f. the plant Pongamia Glabra; [cf. करञ्ज।] —क्षुद्र-रोग, अस्, m. a minor disease, one of little importance; a name applied to various local diseases, especially exanthemas of different kinds; there are forty-four such diseases. —क्षुद्ररोगिक, अस्, आ, अम्, affected with such a disease. —क्षुद्र-वंशा, f., N. of a plant, Dios-corea, = वराह-क्रान्ता. —क्षुद्र-वर्वणा, f. a small gad-fly; [cf. वरटा।] —क्षुद्र-वल्ली, f., N. of a pot-herb; [cf. मूल-पोती।] —क्षुद्र-वार्ताकिनी, f. a kind of Solanum with white blossoms, = श्वेत-कण्टकारी. —क्षुद्र-वार्ताकी, f. a kind of Sola-num, = बृहती. —क्षुद्र-शङ्ख, अस्, m. a small conch shell. —क्षुद्र-शर्करा or क्षुद्र-शर्-करिका, f. a kind of sugar-cane, = यावनाल-शर्-करा. —क्षुद्र-शार्दूल, अस्, m. a kind of tiger, = चित्र-व्याघ्र. —क्षुद्र-शीर्ष, अस्, m. the tree Celosia Cristata, = मयूर-शिखा. —क्षुद्र-शुक्ति, इस्, m. a bivalve shell, = जल-शुक्ति. —क्षुद्र-श्यामा, f., N. of a plant, = कटभी. —क्षुद्र-श्लेष्मान्तक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = भूकर्बु-दारक. —क्षुद्र-श्वास, अस्, m. short breath. —क्षुद्र-श्वेता, f., N. of a plant; [cf. महा-श्वेता।] —क्षुद्र-सहा, f. the plant Phaseolus Tri-lobus; the Coloquintida, = इन्द्र-वारुणी; [cf. म-हा-सहा।] —क्षुद्र-सुवर्ण, अम्, n. bad gold, prince's metal. —क्षुद्र-हन्, आ, m. killing the wicked; an epithet of Śiva. —क्षुद्र-हिङ्गुलिका, f. a small species of prickly nightshade, Solanum Jacquini; [cf. कण्टकारी।] —क्षुद्र-हिङ्गुली, f. = the preceding. —क्षुद्राग्निमन्थ (°र-अग्°), अस्, m. the plant Premna Spinosa used for kindling fire; [cf. अरणि।] —क्षुद्राञ्जन (°र-अञ्°), अम्, n. a kind of unguent applied to the eyes in certain diseases. —क्षुद्राण्ड (°र-अण्°), अस्, आ, अम्, born from minute eggs. —क्षुद्राण्ड-मत्स्य-सङ्घात, अस्, m. small fry. —क्षुद्रान्त्र (°र-अन्°), अम्, n. the small cavity of the heart. —क्षुद्रापामार्ग (°र-अप्°), अस्, m., N. of the plant Desmochæta Atropurpurea (= रक्तापामार्ग), a biennial plant. —क्षुद्रामलक (°र-आम्°), अम्, n. क्षोत्तृ: क्षोत्तृ, ता, m. a pestle, any implement for grinding.

क्षुधित: क्षुधित, अस्, आ, अम्, hungry, hungered.
क्षोधुक: क्षोधुक, अस्, इका, अम्, Ved. hungry.

[cf. क्षुम्प], a bush, a shrub; a small tree, one with short branches and roots; N. of an old king, a son of Prasandhi and father of Ikṣvāku; N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa from Satya-bhāmā; N. of a mountain westward from Dvārakā. —क्षुप-डोडमुष्टि, इस्, m., N. of a plant. —क्षुपालु (°प-आलु), उस्, m. a kind of bulbous plant, = पानीयालु।

2. क्षुभ्, प्, f., Ved. a blow, a shake, a push.
क्षुब्ध: क्षुब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, shaken, tossed, stirred up; agitated (mentally), excited, disturbed; (अस्), m. the churning-stick; a kind of coitus. —क्षुब्ध-ता, f. agitation. —क्षुब्धार्णव (°ध-अर्°), अस्, m. a stormy ocean.
क्षुभा: क्षुभा, f. a kind of weapon.
क्षुभित: क्षुभित, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, tossed, set in motion; agitated (mentally), disturbed, anxious; frightened, alarmed, afraid; angry, enraged.

क्षोभण: क्षोभण, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking, agitating, dis-turbing, causing emotion; (अस्), m., N. of one of the five arrows of the god of love.
क्षोभ्य: क्षोभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be shaken or agitated or disturbed.

क्षुम्प: क्षुम्प क्षुम्प, अस्, m. [cf. क्षुप], Ved. a bush, a shrub.

क्षुर: क्षुर, अस्, m. (connected with the preceding, perhaps related to क्षर् ?; cf. Gr. ξυρόν), a razor; a razor-like barb or sharp blade attached to an arrow; N. of several plants, Asteracantha Longifolia; also Tribulus Lanuginosus, see गो-क्षुर; also = महा-पिण्डीतक, and Saccharum Sara (शर); the hoof of a cow &c.; a horse's hoof; the foot of a bedstead [cf. खुर]; (ई), f. a knife, a dagger; (अस्, आ, अम्), Ved. (Sāy.) having claws. —क्षुर-कर्मन्, अ, n. the operation of shaving. —क्षुर-कॢप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, shaved. —क्षुर-क्रिया, f. the operation of shaving, the employment of a razor. —क्षुर-चतुष्टय, अम्, n. four things necessary for shaving. —क्षुर-धान, अम्, n. a razor-case. —क्षुर-धार, अस्, आ, अम्, razor-edged, sharp as a razor; any very sharp instrument for cutting. —क्षुर-धारा, f. the edge of a razor; N. of a hell. —क्षु-रधाराभ (°र-आभा), अस्, आ, अम्, sharp as a razor. —क्षुर-पत्त्र, अस्, m., N. of the plant Saccharum Sara (शर). —क्षुर-पत्त्रिका, f., N. of a pot-herb, = पालङ्क्य. —क्षुर-पवि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. sharp-angled, sharp-edged, very sharp; (इस्), m., N. of a sacrifice performed in one day (एकाह). —क्षुर-प्र, अस्, m. a razor shot as an arrow; a kind of arrow, one with a sharp horse-shoe-shaped head; a sort of hoe or weeding spade. —क्षुर-प्रग, अम्, n. according to some authorities = क्षुर-प्र। —क्षुर-भाण्ड, अम्, n. a razor-case. —क्षुर-भृष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. furnished with sharp angles. —क्षुर-मर्दिन्, ई, m. a barber. —क्षुराङ्ग (°र-अङ्°), अस्, m., N. of a plant; [cf. गो-क्षुरक।] —क्षुरार्पण (°र-अर्°), अस्, m., N. of a moun-tain.

क्षुरिका: क्षुरिका, f. a small razor; a knife, a dagger; a sort of earthen vessel, a kind of pot-herb (= पालङ्-क्य). —क्षुरिका-पत्त्र, अस्, m. the plant Saccha-rum Sara (शर). —क्षुरिकोपनिषद् (°का-उप्°), त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad belonging to the Atharva-veda.
क्षुरिन्: क्षुरिन्, ई, m. a barber; (इणी), f. the wife of a barber; a kind of yam, see वराह-क्रान्ता।
क्षौर: क्षौर क्षौर, अम्, n. (fr. क्षुर), shaving the head, shaving in general; (ई), f. a razor. —क्षौ-र-करण, अम्, n. the operation of shaving.
क्षुलिक: क्षुलिक क्षुलिक, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
क्षुल्ल: क्षुल्ल क्षुल्ल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. क्षुद्र ?), small, little, minute. —क्षुल्ल-तात, अस्, m. the younger brother of a father. —क्षुल्ल-तातक, अस्, m. the brother of a father.
क्षुल्लक: क्षुल्लक, अस्, आ, अम्, little, small; low, vile, poor, indigent; wicked, malicious, abandoned; hard; young, youngest; pained, distressed; (अस्), m. a small shell; N. of a prince.
क्षेत्र: क्षेत्र क्षेत्र, अम्, n. (fr. 1. or 2. क्षि), landed property, land, soil, a field (e. g. क्षेत्रं कृ, to cultivate the soil; क्षेत्रस्य पति, lord of the soil, N. for a kind of genius or tutelary deity regarded in the Veda as the guardian of cultivated fields); place, region, country; a sacred spot or dis-trict, a place of pilgrimage, as Benares &c.; an enclosed plot of ground, portion of space, superficies, circuit, circumference; fertile soil; the fertile womb, a wife; place of origin; department, sphere of action, the body considered as the field of the indwelling and working of the soul; a sign of the zodiac; (in geometry) a plane figure, as a triangle, circle, &c. enclosed by lines, any figure considered as having geometrical dimensions; a diagram; a house, town; [cf. अन्य-क्षेत्र, कुरु-क्षेत्र, &c.; cf. also Goth. haithi, Them. haithjo; Germ. Heide.] —क्षेत्र-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, cultivating a field; a husbandman. —क्षेत्र-कर्कटी, f. a kind of gourd; [cf. बालुकी।] —क्षेत्रकर्म-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, one who cultivates the soil, a husbandman. —क्षेत्र-कर्-मन्, अ, n. cultivation of the soil. —क्षेत्र-गणित, अम्, n. geometry. —क्षेत्र-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, geo-metrical. —क्षेत्रगतोपपत्ति (°त-उप्°), इस्, f. geometrical proof. —क्षेत्र-चिर्भिटा, f. a kind of gourd, = चिर्भिटा. —क्षेत्र-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, pro-duced in a field, as corn &c.; born from the body; (अस्), m., scil. पुत्र, a son, the offspring of the wife by a kinsman or person duly appointed to raise up issue to the husband, (this is one of the twelve kinds of issue allowed by the old Hindū law); (आ), f., N. of several plants, = श्वेत-कण्टकारी, शशाण्डुली, गोमूत्रिका, शिल्पिका, चणिका. —क्षेत्र-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, begotten on the wife of another. —क्षेत्र-जेष, अस्, m., Ved. contest for landed property, acquisition of land. —क्षेत्र-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing localities; familiar with the cultivation of the soil, a husbandman &c.; clever, dexterous, skil-ful, cunning; (अस्), m. ‘knowing the body,’ i. e. the soul, the conscious principle in the corporeal frame; a libertine, a whoremonger; a form of Śiva; N. of a prince; (आ), f. a girl fifteen years old who personates the goddess Durgā at a festival of this deity. —क्षेत्र-तत्त्व, अम्, n. a part of the work Smṛti-tattva. —क्षेत्र-तर, अम्, n., Ved. a spot very fit for cultivation or for habitation. —क्षेत्र-ता, f. the state of being a seat or residence, a seat, a place of residence. —क्षेत्र-दूती, f. a kind of Solanum (श्वेत-कण्टकारी). —क्षेत्र-देवता, f. ‘the deity of the fields,’ epithet of a serpent in the Pañca-tantra. —क्षेत्र-पति, इस्, m. the owner of a field, a landowner, a landlord, a farmer; a deity protecting the fields; an epithet of Śiva. —क्षेत्र-फल, अम्, n. (in geometry) the superficial contents of a figure. —क्षेत्र-भक्ति, इस्, f. the division of a field. —क्षेत्र-भूमि, इस्, f. cultivated land. —क्षेत्र-यमानिका, f., N. of a plant, = वचा. —क्षेत्र-रक्ष, अस्, m. a man employed to guard fields from depredation. —क्षेत्र-राशि, इस्, m. quantity represented by geometrical figures. —क्षेत्र-रुहा, f. a kind of gourd, = बालुकी. —क्षेत्र-वसुधा, f. cultivated land. —क्षेत्र-विद्, त्, त्, त्, familiar with localities; experienced, clever, skilful; (त्), m. a husbandman; a sage, one who possesses spiritual knowledge; the soul. —क्षेत्र-व्यवहार, अस्, m. drawing a figure in geometry; geometrical demon-stration. —क्षेत्र-सम्भव, अस्, m., N. of either of the shrubs Cañcu and Bhiṇḍā; (आ), f. a kind of gourd, = शशाण्डुली. —क्षेत्र-सम्भूत, अस्, m. a kind of grass, = कुन्दर. —क्षेत्र-साति, इस्, f., Ved. acquisition of field or land. —क्षेत्र-साधस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. arriving at or coming to a place. —क्षेत्र-सीमा, f. the boundary of a meadow or field or holy place. —क्षेत्र-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, residing at a sacred place. —क्षेत्राजीव (°र-आज्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who gains a livelihood by cultivating the soil; a cultivator, a peasant. —क्षेत्राधिदेवता (°र-अध्°), f. the tutelary deity of any consecrated piece of ground. —क्षेत्राधिप (°र-अध्°), अस्, m. = the preceding; the regent of a sign of the zodiac. —क्षेत्रामलकी, the plant Flacourtia Ca-taphracta; [cf. भूम्य्-आमलकी।] —क्षेत्रा-सा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. acquiring or gaining land. —क्षेत्रे-क्षु (°र-इक्°), उस्, m. a kind of grain, = यावनाल। —क्षेत्रोपेक्ष (°र-उप्°), अस्, m., N. of a son of Śvaphalka.
क्षेत्रिक: क्षेत्रिक, अस्, ई, अम्, having a field, relating to a field &c., agrarian; (अस्), m. the owner of a field, a farmer, a cultivator, a husband.
क्षेत्रिन्: क्षेत्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, owning a field, cultivating land, agricultural; (ई), m. an agriculturist, a husbandman, a cultivator; a husband; the soul.
क्षेत्रिय: क्षेत्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to a field, belonging to land; curable in a future body, i. e. incurable in the present life; (आणि), n. pl. the environs of any place; (अम्), n. a chronic or organic disease, an incurable one; meadow grass, herbage, pasturage; (अस्), m. a medicament, anything fit to be adminis-tered in medicine (?); an incurable disease; one who has carnal knowledge of other men's wives, an adulterer; physicking, operating. —क्षेत्रिय-ना-शन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. removing a chronic disease.
क्षेत्रीय: क्षेत्रीय, nom. P. क्षेत्रीयति, to desire another man's wife.
क्षेद: क्षेद क्षेद, अस्, m. (?) sorrowing, moan-ing (?).
क्षेम: क्षेम क्षेम, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 2. क्षि), habit-able, giving rest, giving ease or security or comfort; conferring happiness; at ease, prosperous, safe, secure, well, happy, right; (अस्, अम्), m. n. (Ved. always m.) basis, foundation; residence, place of rest; abiding at ease; safety, tranquillity, peace, rest, security, any secure, easy or comfortable state, well-being, weal, happiness (e. g. क्षेमेण, at ease, in security, safely; क्षेमे — योगे, Ved. both in rest and exertion  — in enjoying and acquiring); preserving, protecting, keeping what is acquired; final emancipation, eternal happiness; (अस्), m. a kind of perfume (= चण्डा); ease or prosperity personified as a son of Dharma and Śānti; also a son of Titikṣā; N. of a prince, a son of Śuci and father of Suvrata; N. of a son of the third Manu Sāvarṇa; N. of a kind of college or association [cf. मठ]; the proper term (according to Manu II. 127) of civil address to a Vaiśya, asking him whether his property is secure; (आ), f., N. of an Apsaras; an epithet of Durgā; N. of another deity; a kind of perfume; (अम्), n., N. of one of the seven Varṣas in Jambu-dvīpa. —क्षेम-कर, अस्, आ, अम्, causing peace and security, conferring happiness or good fortune, propitious. —क्षेम-कर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a son of Maheśa, who composed, A. D. 1570, the work Rāga-mālā. —क्षेम-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, one whose work is peace and security, creating tran-quillity and security; (आ), m., N. of a prince. —क्षेम-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. longing for rest. —क्षेम-कार, अस्, ई, अम्, granting peace and security, conferring happiness or good fortune, pro-pitious, auspicious. —क्षेम-कुतूहल, अम्, n. title of a medical work of Kṣema-śarman. —क्षेम-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing peace and security. —क्षेम-गुप्त, अस्, m., N. of a king of Kāśmīra. —क्षेमङ्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, promoting well-being, causing peace and security, propitious, &c.; (अस्), m., N. of a king of Trigarta; N. of a mythical Buddha; N. of a son of Brahma-datta (Udayana); (ई), f. the Brāhmaṇī kite or Coromandel eagle, considered as a bird of good omen, Falco Ponticerianus; a form of the goddess Durgā; N. of another goddess; N. of a sister of Kṣemaṅ-kara. —क्षेम-जित्, त्, m., N. of a prince. —क्षेम-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, better, happier. —क्षेम-दर्शिन्, ई, m., N. of a prince of the Kosalas. —क्षेमदर्शीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to this prince. —क्षेम-धन्वन्, आ, m., N. of a prince, a son of Puṇḍarīka. —क्षेम-धर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a prince. —क्षेम-धूर्त, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —क्षेम-धूर्ति, इस्, m., N. of a warrior. —क्षेम-धृत्वन्, आ, m., N. of a man with the patronymic Pauṇḍarīka. —क्षेम-फला, see क्षेमा-फला. —क्षेम-भूमि, इस्, m., N. of a prince. —क्षेम-मूर्ति, इस्, m., N. of a prince. —क्षेम-युक्तम्, ind. both quietly and energetically; in rest and exertion. —क्षेम-राज, अस्, m., N. of a man. —क्षेम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, accompanied with tranquillity and security; prosper-ous, happy; (ती), f., N. of a woman. —क्षेम-वृद्धि, इस्, m., N. of a general of the Śālvas. —क्षेम-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of an author. —क्षेमादित्य (°म-आद्°), अस्, m., N. of a man. —क्षेमाधि (°म-आधि), इस्, m., N. of a prince of Mithilā. —क्षेमा-फला, f. the tree Ficus Oppositifolia; [cf. उदुम्बर।] —क्षेमारि (°म-अरि), इस्, m., N. of a prince of Mithilā, = क्षेमाधि। —क्षेमार्चिस् (°म-अर्°), इस्, m. = क्षेम-जित्। —क्षेमेन्द्र (°म-इन्°), अस्, m., N. of the author of a list of regents of Kāśmīra; N. of a lexico-grapher; also of the author of a Buddhist work. —क्षेमेन्द्र-प्रकाश, अस्, m., N. of a work by Kṣemendra.
क्षेमक: क्षेमक, अस्, m. a kind of perfume, = चौर; N. of a Nāga; N. of a Rakṣas; N. of an attendant of Śiva; N. of an old king; of a son of Alarka; of the last descendant of Parīkṣit in the Kali-yuga; N. of a son of Nirāmitra.
क्षेमयत्: क्षेमयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. resting; granting rest or an abode.
क्षेमिन्: क्षेमिन्, ई, इणी, इ, enjoying peace and security, safe, secure, happy, well.
क्षेम्य: क्षेम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, resting, at leisure, at ease; habitable, comfortable; healthy, salubrious; lucky, prosperous, thriving; giving peace and tranquillity; (अस्), m., N. of Śiva; N. of several princes, a son of Sunītha and father of Ketumat; of a son of Ugrā-yudha and father of Suvīra; of a son of Śuci and father of Suvrata; (अम्), n., Ved. resting.
क्षेव्: क्षेव् क्षेव्, cl. 1. P. क्षेवति, another form for क्षिव् or क्षीव्, ‘to spit,’ q. v.
क्षै: क्षै क्षै, cl. 1. P. क्षायति, चक्षौ, क्षा-स्यति, क्षातुम्, to wane; to waste away, dry up, decline, become emaciated; [cf. 4. क्षि।]
क्षैण्य: क्षैण्य क्षैण्य, अम्, n. (fr. क्षीण), destruc-tion, wasting away; leanness, slenderness, emaciation.
क्षैत: क्षैत क्षैत, अस्, m. (fr. 1. क्षिति), Ved. the chief of a race, a prince. —क्षैत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. princely.
क्षैत्र: क्षैत्र क्षैत्र, अम्, n. (fr. क्षेत्र), a mul-titude of fields &c.
क्षैत्रजित्य: क्षैत्रजित्य, अम्, n. (fr. क्षेत्र-जित्), Ved. acquisition of land, a victorious battle.
क्षैत्रज्ञ: क्षैत्रज्ञ or क्षैत्रज्ञ्य, अम्, n. (fr. क्षेत्र-ज्ञ), spirituality, the nature of the soul; the know-ledge of the soul &c.
क्षैत्रपत्य: क्षैत्रपत्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. क्षेत्र-पति), Ved. belonging to the lord of the soil.
क्षैप्र: क्षैप्र क्षैप्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. क्षिप्र), a term for a kind of Sandhi, produced by changing the first of two concurrent vowels to its semivowel; the Svarita accent on a syllable formed with this Sandhi; (अम्), n. quickness, speediness. —क्षैप्र-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, joined by the Kṣaipra Sandhi. —क्षैप्र-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, containing a semi-vowel.
क्षैरकलम्भि: क्षैरकलम्भि क्षैरकलम्भि, इस्, m. (a pa-tronymic fr. क्षीर-कलम्भ), N. of a teacher.
क्षैरेय: क्षैरेय क्षैरेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. क्षीर), pre-pared with milk, milky; (ई), f. milk and rice or any preparation of or dish prepared with milk.
क्षोट्: क्षोट् क्षोट्, cl. 10. P. क्षोटयति, -यितुम्, to throw, cast; [cf. खोट् and खोड्।]
क्षोड: क्षोड क्षोड, अस्, m. the post to which an elephant is fastened; [cf. अ-क्षोभ।]
क्षोण: क्षोण क्षोण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. immovable; or (अस्), m. a kind of lute; (perhaps the word is re-lated to the following.)
क्षोणी: क्षोणी क्षोणी, f., Ved. the earth; (यौ), du. heaven and earth; (according to some the sing. of this word and sometimes the plur. may be used col-lectively, and the original meaning may be ‘a multitude of men’ or ‘the people’ (as opposed to the chief); the du. may then mean ‘the two sets of people,’ i. e. the inhabitants of heaven and earth; sometimes a form क्षोणि occurs); [cf. Gr. χθών.] —क्षोणी-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, containing the earth in himself, ‘the source of everything in the earth;’ an epithet of Viṣṇu in his fish-incarnation.
क्षोम: क्षोम क्षोम, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. rt. क्षु), a room on the top of a house; (अम्), n. wove silk; [cf. क्षौम।]
क्षोमक: क्षोमक क्षोमक, अस्, m. a kind of perfume (गणहासक); [cf. क्षेम and क्षौमक।]
क्षौणी: क्षौणी क्षौणी, ई or इस्, f. the earth; [cf. क्षोणी।] —क्षौणी-तल, अम्, n. the surface of the earth. —क्षौणी-प्राचीर, अस्, m. the ocean. —क्षौणी-भुज्, क्, m. earth-possessor, a king; [cf. क्षिति-भुज्।]
क्षौद्र: क्षौद्र क्षौद्र, अस्, m. (fr. क्षुद्र and क्षुद्रा), the tree Michelia Champaca (चम्पक); N. of a mixed caste, the son of a Vaideha and a Māgadhī; (अम्), n. smallness, minuteness; N. of a Sūtra of the Sāma-veda; honey, a species of honey; water. —क्षौद्र-ज, अम्, n. wax. —क्षौद्र-धातु, उस्, m. a kind of mineral substance; [cf. मा-क्षिक।] —क्षौद्र-प्रिय, अस्, m., N. of a tree; [cf. जल-मधूक।] —क्षौद्र-मेह, अस्, m. the disease diabetes mellitus. —क्षौद्रमेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, affected with this disease.
क्षौद्रक्य: क्षौद्रक्य क्षौद्रक्य, अस्, ई, m. f. (fr. क्षु-द्रक), a prince or princess of the Kṣudrakas, a man belonging to the Kṣudrakas; (अस्, ई, अम्), small, minute.
क्षौद्रकमालवी: क्षौद्रकमालवी, f., scil. सेना, the army of Kṣudraka and Mālava.
क्षौमक: क्षौमक, अस्, ई, अम्, linen; (अस्), m. a parti-cular perfume; [cf. चोर।]
क्षौरपव्य: क्षौरपव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. क्षुर-पवि), formed out of razors and thunderbolts, very sharp, very hard.
क्षौरिक: क्षौरिक, अस्, m. a barber, a shaver.
क्ष्णु: क्ष्णु क्ष्णु, cl. 2. P. क्ष्णौति, चुक्ष्णाव, क्ष्णवितुम्, to whet, sharpen.
क्ष्णुत्: क्ष्णुत्, त्, त्, त्, (at the end of compounds) sharp (e. g. उभयतः-क्ष्णुत्, sharp on both sides).
क्ष्णुत: क्ष्णुत, अस्, आ, अम्, whetted, sharpened.
क्ष्णोत्र: क्ष्णोत्र, अम्, n., Ved. a grind-stone, a whet-stone.
क्ष्मा: क्ष्मा क्ष्मा, f. (fr. rt. क्षम्), the earth, (Ved. only inst. sing. क्ष्मया); [cf. क्षमा।] क्ष्मा-ज, अस्, m. ‘earth-born,’ the planet Mars. —क्ष्मा-तल, अम्, n. the surface of the earth. —क्ष्मा-धृति, इस्, m. one who has to support the earth, a king. —क्ष्मा-प, अस्, m. earth-protector, a king. —क्ष्मा-पति, इस्, m. lord of the earth, a king. —क्ष्मा-पाल, अस्, m. earth-protector, a king. —क्ष्मा-भुज्, क्, m. possessor of the earth, a king. —क्ष्मा-भृत्, त्, m. supporter of the earth; a mountain; a king. —क्ष्मा-वृष, अस्, m. ‘earth-bull,’ i. e. a mighty king.
क्ष्माय्: क्ष्माय् क्ष्माय्, cl. 1. A. क्ष्मायते, च-क्ष्माये, क्ष्मायितुम्, to shake, tremble: Caus. क्ष्मापयति, -यितुम्, अचिक्ष्म-पत्, to cause to shake, to make tremble: Desid. चिक्ष्मायिषते: Intens. चाक्ष्माय्यते, चाक्ष्-माति (?).
क्ष्मायित: क्ष्मायित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, made to tremble, trembling.
क्ष्मायितृ: क्ष्मायितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, trembling, shaking.
क्ष्मील्: क्ष्मील् क्ष्मील्, cl. 1. P. क्ष्मीलति, चिक्ष्-मील, क्ष्मीलितुम्, to wink, to twinkle, to close the eyelids; [cf. मील्।]
क्ष्रौम्: क्ष्रौम् क्ष्रौम्, ind. a mystical exclamation.
क्ष्विङ्का: क्ष्विङ्का क्ष्विङ्का, f., Ved. a kind of bird.
क्ष्विड्: क्ष्विड् क्ष्विड् or क्ष्विद्, cl. 1. P. क्ष्वे-डति or क्ष्वेदति, -डितुम् or -दितुम्, to utter an inarticulate sound, to hum, murmur, growl, roar, hiss, whiz, whistle; A. क्ष्वेडते or क्ष्वेदते, or cl. 4. P. क्ष्विद्यति, to be wet or unctuous; to exude, discharge juice, emit sap: Caus. क्ष्वेडयति or -दयति, -यितुम्, to sound inarticulately, hum, &c.
क्ष्विण्ण: क्ष्विण्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded inarticulately; soft, unctuous.
क्ष्वेड: क्ष्वेड, अस्, आ, अम् (in some senses perhaps con-nected with rt. क्ष्वेल्), curved, crooked, bending, bent; wicked, depraved; difficult to be approached; (अस्), m. singing or buzzing in the ear from harden-ing of the wax &c.; sound, noise; venom, poison; a Cucurbitaceous plant, Luffa Pentandra or Acutangula, = पीतघोषा; a mystical N. of the letter म्; (अम्), n. the flower of the Ghoṣa plant; the fruit of a red kind of swallow-wort; (आ), f. the roaring of a lion, a war-whoop, a battle-cry; a bamboo rod or stake; a kind of Cucurbitaceous plant.
क्ष्वेडन: क्ष्वेडन, अम्, n. murmuring, hissing, whistling, sibilating; a hissing pronunciation.
क्ष्वेडित: क्ष्वेडित, अस्, अम्, m. n. humming, murmuring, growling; a growl, roar; a battle-cry, a war-whoop.
क्ष्वेडिन्: क्ष्वेडिन्, ई, इनी, इ, humming, murmuring.
क्ष्वेल्: क्ष्वेल् क्ष्वेल्, cl. 1. P. क्ष्वेलति, &c., to leap, jump; to play; to go, move; to shake, tremble; [cf. Old Germ. suillu, sual, suall.]
क्ष्वेलिका: क्ष्वेलिका, f. or क्ष्वेलित, अस्, अम्, m. n. or क्ष्वेल्य, अम्, n. play, jest, joke, trick.
कट्फल: कट्-फल। See under कटु, p. 196, col. 1.
कण्ट: कण्ट। See under कण्टक; (these words are thought by some to be for original कर्न्त, कर्न्-तक, fr. rt. 2. कृत्, to cut.)
कमलनाभ: कमल-नाभ, अस्, m. ‘lotus-naveled,’ epithet of Viṣṇu.
कर्णस्रोतस्: कर्ण-स्रोतस्, अस्, n. ‘ear-flow,’ the wax of the ear.
कलहत्: कलहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. a Nom. कलह), quar-reling.
काणभुज: काणभुज, अस्, ई, अम्, composed by Kaṇa-bhuj, i. e. Kaṇāda.
काद्रव: काद्रव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कद्रु), dark-yellow, of a reddish-brown colour.
कानिष्ठ्य: कानिष्ठ्य, अम्, n. (fr. कनिष्ठ), the place or position of the youngest (opposed to ज्यैष्ठ्य), juniority.
कामतात: काम-तात, अस्, m. epithet of Śiva [cf. काम-पाल].
कामाख्या: कामाख्या; add — a district in Assam sacred to Durgā.
कायदण्ड: काय-दण्ड, अस्, m. command over the body, control of the actions.
कालपूग: काल-पूग; transfer under 2. काल, and correct thus — a quantity or length of time, a long time.
काष्ठलोष्टमय: काष्ठ-लोष्ट-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of wood and clay.
किञ्चन्य: किञ्चन्य, अम्, n. (fr. किञ्चन, ‘something’), possession, property.
किन्ता: किन्-ता, f. ‘the state of whom?’ any despicable state or condition, contemptibleness; किन्तया, with meanness, contemptibly.
किन्देव: किन्-देव, अस्, m. a demi-god [cf. किन्-नर].
किम्प्रभु: किम्-प्रभु, उस्, m. a bad master.
किम्भृत्य: किम्-भृत्य, अस्, m. a bad servant.
किम्मन्त्रिन्: किम्-मन्त्रिन्, ई, m. a bad minister.
कुक्षिज: कुक्षि-ज, अस्, m. a son, (Raghu-v. XV. 15.)
कुतन्त्री: कु-तन्त्री, ईस् or ई, f. a tail.
कुलधर्म: कुल-धर्म; add — the observances of the Kaulas.
कुलमार्ग: कुल-मार्ग; add — the doctrine of the Kaulas.
कुलवर्त्मन्: कुल-वर्त्मन्, अ, n. the doctrine of the Kaulas.
कृतार्थयत्: कृतार्थयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making successful.
केलिकिल: केलि-किल; add — (अस्, आ, अम्), wanton, arrogant.
कैमुतिकन्याय: कैमुतिक-न्याय, अस्, m. the rule of ‘how much more’ or a fortiori.
क्नोपन: क्नोपन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. Caus. of rt. क्नूय्), wet-ting, moistening.
क्राणा: क्राणा, ind. (according to B. R. inst. of क्राण, ‘desire, eagerness,’ and probably from a form क्रा = rt. 1. कृ), Ved. willingly, gladly.
क्षेत्रसंहिता: क्षेत्र-संहिता, f. any work on geometry.
क्षेपाय: क्षेपाय, Nom. A. क्षेपायते, &c., to revile.
क्षेपायमाण: क्षेपायमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, abusing, reviling.
क्ष्वेलन: क्ष्वेलन, अम्, n. the act of playing, sport, jest.
